# =================================================
# Module 11b: Master PPI Evidence Table
# =================================================

# PPI vulnerability pipeline in iN and iDA LSD mutants from two PPI datasets

Goal: Build a Protein-Protein Interaction (PPI) vulnerability and rewiring landscape for neuronal proteomes (iN and iDA) across 23 lysosomal KOs. Integrate experimental proteome shifts with predicted and experimentally validated interaction data to quantify network destabilization, organelle-specific vulnerabilities, and neuron-type-specific effects.

> Data Sources
>> 1. Baker Lab Human Interactome (Predictome80)**
- Source: https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2024.10.01.615885v1
- ~29k edges, 80% confidence threshold
- Scores: RFprob (RoseTTAFold coevolution), AFMprob (AlphaFold-Multimer)

>> 2. Predictomes.org 16k set**
- Source: https://predictomes.org/downloads
- Paper: https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2025.11.10.687652v1
- ~16.5k edges, top predictions by SPOC score (~90% precision)
- Scores: SPOC (omics integration), ipTM_max (interface quality), KIRC

>> 3. IntAct Database**
- Source: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/intact/
- Experimentally validated interactions (MI-score >= 0.5)
- Used as orthogonal validation, not primary source

>> Overlap Statistics
- Predictome80 only: ~22k edges
- Predictomes16k only: ~9.5k edges  
- In both (convergent): ~7k edges
- With IntAct validation: ~1.7k edges

> Confidence Tier Logic
>> GOLD:
- In both prediction sources (convergent evidence), OR
- AFMprob >= 0.9 AND RFprob >= 0.9 (high structural + coevolution), OR
- SPOC >= 0.95 (high omics integration)

>> SILVER:
- AFMprob >= 0.8 (good structural), OR
- RFprob >= 0.8 (good coevolution), OR
- SPOC >= 0.9 (good omics)

>> BRONZE:
- Remaining edges with lower confidence

> Additional Flags
- high_interface_quality: ipTM_max >= 0.7 (retained for complex analysis)
- has_experimental_validation: present in IntAct (orthogonal QC)

> Key Insight
AFMprob and RFprob correlate; ipTM_max does not correlate with other metrics. ipTM likely measures interface quality specifically, valuable for complex analysis but not for general PPI confidence tiering.



# Merging of two PPI datasets into Master PPI Evidence Table
```{r}
# Integrates Predictome80 (Baker), Predictomes.org 16k (SPOC), and IntAct
# Outputs: master_ppi_evidence.csv with all evidence columns and confidence tiers

# --- Step 0: Setup output directory ---
out_dir_ppi_dual <- file.path(out_dir_PPI, "ppi_dual_evidence")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "qc"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Input paths
path_predictome80 <- "/Users/felix/Desktop/ppi/final_predictions_80.tsv"
path_predictomes16k <- "/Users/felix/Desktop/ppi/Predictomes_16kset.csv"
path_intact_tsv <- "/Users/felix/Desktop/ppi/interact.tsv"

# --- Step 1: Helper functions ---
.make_undirected_key <- function(a, b) {
  ifelse(a <= b, paste(a, b, sep = "::"), paste(b, a, sep = "::"))
}

# --- Step 2: Load Predictome80 (Baker Human Interactome) ---
message("Loading Predictome80...")
predictome80_raw <- data.table::fread(path_predictome80, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, skip = 28, fill = TRUE, quote = "", data.table = FALSE)
predictome80_raw <- predictome80_raw[!grepl("^#", predictome80_raw$Protein1), ]

predictome80 <- predictome80_raw %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Protein1 = Protein1,
    Protein2 = Protein2,
    Gene1 = Name1,
    Gene2 = Name2,
    RFprob = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(RFprob)),
    AFprob = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(AFprob)),
    AFMprob = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(AFMprob)),
    CFprob = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(CFprob)),
    STRING = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(STRING)),
    confDBs = confDBs,
    allDBs = allDBs,
    Source = Source,
    PDBtemp = PDBtemp,
    Locality1 = Locality1,
    Locality2 = Locality2,
    key = .make_undirected_key(Protein1, Protein2)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(in_Predictome80 = TRUE)

message("  Predictome80: ", nrow(predictome80), " unique edges")

# --- Step 3: Load Predictomes.org 16k (SPOC scores) ---
message("Loading Predictomes.org 16k...")
predictomes16k_raw <- read.csv(path_predictomes16k, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

predictomes16k <- predictomes16k_raw %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Protein1 = trimws(sub(" / .*", "", UniProt_ID)),
    Protein2 = trimws(sub(".* / ", "", UniProt_ID)),
    Gene1_16k = trimws(sub(" / .*", "", Gene_Symbol)),
    Gene2_16k = trimws(sub(".* / ", "", Gene_Symbol)),
    SPOC_score = as.numeric(SPOC_score),
    FDR_pct = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", `FDR_...`)),
    ipTM_max = as.numeric(ipTM_max),
    KIRC_score = as.numeric(KIRC_score),
    BioGRID_count = as.numeric(BioGRID),
    STRING_16k = as.numeric(STRING_score),
    key = .make_undirected_key(Protein1, Protein2)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(in_Predictomes16k = TRUE)

message("  Predictomes16k: ", nrow(predictomes16k), " unique edges")

# --- Step 4: Load IntAct ---
message("Loading IntAct...")
intact_raw <- data.table::fread(path_intact_tsv, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, fill = TRUE, quote = "", data.table = FALSE)
colnames(intact_raw) <- trimws(gsub("^#", "", colnames(intact_raw)))

intact <- intact_raw %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Protein1 = sub("^uniprotkb:", "", sub("\\|.*$", "", `ID(s) interactor A`)),
    Protein2 = sub("^uniprotkb:", "", sub("\\|.*$", "", `ID(s) interactor B`)),
    IntAct_MIscore = {
      x <- `Confidence value(s)`
      x <- sub("^.*miscore:", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
    },
    DetectionMethod = gsub('psi-mi:|"', "", `Interaction detection method(s)`)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(key = .make_undirected_key(Protein1, Protein2)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(in_IntAct = TRUE)

message("  IntAct: ", nrow(intact), " unique edges")

#--- Step 5: Merge prediction sources (P80 + 16k) ---
message("Merging prediction sources...")

master_ppi <- predictome80 %>%
  dplyr::select(key, Protein1, Protein2, Gene1, Gene2, RFprob, AFprob, AFMprob, CFprob, STRING, confDBs, allDBs, Source, PDBtemp, Locality1, Locality2, in_Predictome80) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(predictomes16k %>% dplyr::select(key, Gene1_16k, Gene2_16k, SPOC_score, FDR_pct, ipTM_max, KIRC_score, BioGRID_count, STRING_16k, in_Predictomes16k), by = "key")

# Fill missing flags
master_ppi <- master_ppi %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    in_Predictome80 = tidyr::replace_na(in_Predictome80, FALSE),
    in_Predictomes16k = tidyr::replace_na(in_Predictomes16k, FALSE),
    in_both_predictions = in_Predictome80 & in_Predictomes16k
  )

# Fill Protein1/2 and Gene1/2
master_ppi <- master_ppi %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Protein1 = dplyr::case_when(!is.na(Protein1) ~ Protein1, TRUE ~ sub("::.*", "", key)),
    Protein2 = dplyr::case_when(!is.na(Protein2) ~ Protein2, TRUE ~ sub(".*::", "", key)),
    Gene1 = dplyr::coalesce(Gene1, Gene1_16k),
    Gene2 = dplyr::coalesce(Gene2, Gene2_16k)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Gene1_16k, -Gene2_16k)

# Add IntAct as validation flag (left join, not full join)
master_ppi <- master_ppi %>%
  dplyr::left_join(intact %>% dplyr::select(key, IntAct_MIscore, DetectionMethod, in_IntAct), by = "key") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(in_IntAct = tidyr::replace_na(in_IntAct, FALSE))

message("  Master table: ", nrow(master_ppi), " unique edges")
message("  In both P80 and 16k: ", sum(master_ppi$in_both_predictions))
message("  With IntAct validation: ", sum(master_ppi$in_IntAct))

# --- Step 6: Overlap statistics ---
message("\n=== Overlap Statistics ===")
overlap_stats <- data.frame(
  category = c("total_edges", "in_P80_only", "in_16k_only", "in_both_predictions", "with_IntAct_validation"),
  count = c(
    nrow(master_ppi),
    sum(master_ppi$in_Predictome80 & !master_ppi$in_Predictomes16k),
    sum(!master_ppi$in_Predictome80 & master_ppi$in_Predictomes16k),
    sum(master_ppi$in_both_predictions),
    sum(master_ppi$in_IntAct)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
print(overlap_stats)


# --- Step 7: Confidence tier assignment ---
# Tier logic:
# - gold: in both prediction sources (convergent evidence)
#         OR high structural + coevolution (AFMprob >= 0.9 AND RFprob >= 0.9)
#         OR high omics integration (SPOC >= 0.95)
# - silver: good structural (AFMprob >= 0.8)
#           OR good coevolution (RFprob >= 0.8)
#           OR good omics (SPOC >= 0.9)
# - bronze: remaining predictions with lower confidence
# 
# Note: ipTM_max retained for complex analysis (interface quality metric)
# IntAct experimental validation tracked separately as QC flag

master_ppi <- master_ppi %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    confidence_tier = dplyr::case_when(
      in_both_predictions ~ "gold",
      AFMprob >= 0.9 & RFprob >= 0.9 ~ "gold",
      SPOC_score >= 0.95 ~ "gold",
      AFMprob >= 0.8 ~ "silver",
      RFprob >= 0.8 ~ "silver",
      SPOC_score >= 0.9 ~ "silver",
      TRUE ~ "bronze"
    ),
    confidence_tier_rationale = dplyr::case_when(
      in_both_predictions ~ "both_prediction_sources",
      AFMprob >= 0.9 & RFprob >= 0.9 ~ "P80_high_structural_and_coevol",
      SPOC_score >= 0.95 ~ "16k_high_omics",
      AFMprob >= 0.8 ~ "P80_good_structural",
      RFprob >= 0.8 ~ "P80_good_coevol",
      SPOC_score >= 0.9 ~ "16k_good_omics",
      TRUE ~ "low_conf"
    ),
    confidence_tier_description = dplyr::case_when(
      in_both_predictions ~ "Edge found in both Baker Interactome and Predictomes.org - convergent evidence from independent pipelines",
      AFMprob >= 0.9 & RFprob >= 0.9 ~ "High AlphaFold-Multimer probability (>=0.9) AND high RoseTTAFold coevolution (>=0.9)",
      SPOC_score >= 0.95 ~ "High SPOC score (>=0.95) integrating co-localization, co-precipitation, and genetic co-dependency",
      AFMprob >= 0.8 ~ "Good AlphaFold-Multimer structural confidence (>=0.8)",
      RFprob >= 0.8 ~ "Good RoseTTAFold coevolution signal (>=0.8)",
      SPOC_score >= 0.9 ~ "Good SPOC omics integration score (>=0.9)",
      TRUE ~ "Lower confidence - single source with scores below thresholds"
    ),
    high_interface_quality = ipTM_max >= 0.7,
    has_experimental_validation = in_IntAct
  )

tier_summary <- master_ppi %>% 
  dplyr::count(confidence_tier, confidence_tier_rationale, confidence_tier_description) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(confidence_tier, dplyr::desc(n))
message("\nConfidence tiers:")
print(tier_summary)

# Validation overlap by tier
validation_by_tier <- master_ppi %>%
  dplyr::group_by(confidence_tier) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(), 
    n_with_IntAct = sum(has_experimental_validation), 
    pct_validated = round(100 * n_with_IntAct / n, 1),
    n_high_ipTM = sum(high_interface_quality, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_high_ipTM = round(100 * n_high_ipTM / n, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
message("\nValidation and interface quality by tier:")
print(validation_by_tier)

# --- Step 8: Save outputs ---
readr::write_csv(master_ppi, file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "tables", "master_ppi_evidence.csv"))
readr::write_csv(overlap_stats, file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "qc", "overlap_statistics.csv"))
readr::write_csv(tier_summary, file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "qc", "confidence_tier_summary.csv"))
readr::write_csv(validation_by_tier, file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "qc", "validation_by_tier.csv"))

message("\nSaved to: ", out_dir_ppi_dual)
message("Master PPI evidence table complete.")


# --- Step 9: Add subcellular annotations to master_ppi ---
message("Adding subcellular annotations...")

# Get organelle tags from binary_matrix
organelle_tags <- setdiff(colnames(binary_matrix), c("Genes", "NeuroDev"))
gene_to_org <- binary_matrix %>% dplyr::select(Genes, all_of(organelle_tags))

# Add annotations for Gene1
master_ppi <- master_ppi %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_org, by = c("Gene1" = "Genes")) %>%
  dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_prot1"), all_of(organelle_tags))

# Add annotations for Gene2
master_ppi <- master_ppi %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_org, by = c("Gene2" = "Genes")) %>%
  dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_prot2"), all_of(organelle_tags))

# Count how many genes have annotations
n_gene1_annotated <- sum(!is.na(master_ppi[[paste0(organelle_tags[1], "_prot1")]]))
n_gene2_annotated <- sum(!is.na(master_ppi[[paste0(organelle_tags[1], "_prot2")]]))
message("  Gene1 with annotations: ", n_gene1_annotated, " / ", nrow(master_ppi))
message("  Gene2 with annotations: ", n_gene2_annotated, " / ", nrow(master_ppi))

# --- Step 10: Create shared_long for master_ppi (edges with shared organelle) ---
message("Creating shared organelle edge table...")

org1_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot1")
org2_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot2")

# Filter to columns that exist
existing_org1_cols <- intersect(org1_cols, colnames(master_ppi))
existing_org2_cols <- intersect(org2_cols, colnames(master_ppi))

shared_long_master <- {
  if (length(existing_org1_cols) == 0 || length(existing_org2_cols) == 0) {
    message("No organelle columns found, creating empty shared_long_master")
    data.frame(key = character(0), tag = character(0), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else {
    m1 <- master_ppi[, existing_org1_cols, drop = FALSE] %>% 
      lapply(function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x))) %>% 
      as.data.frame()
    m2 <- master_ppi[, existing_org2_cols, drop = FALSE] %>% 
      lapply(function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x))) %>% 
      as.data.frame()
    
    shared_mat <- as.matrix(m1) & as.matrix(m2)
    existing_tags <- sub("_prot1$", "", existing_org1_cols)
    
    dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(shared_mat)), function(i) {
      idx <- which(shared_mat[i, ])
      if (!length(idx)) return(NULL)
      data.frame(key = master_ppi$key[i], tag = existing_tags[idx], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }))
  }
}
message("  Shared organelle edges: ", length(unique(shared_long_master$key)), " unique edges")
message("  Total key-tag pairs: ", nrow(shared_long_master))

# --- Step 11: Save updated master table ---
readr::write_csv(master_ppi, file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "tables", "master_ppi_evidence.csv"))
readr::write_csv(shared_long_master, file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "tables", "shared_organelle_edges.csv"))

message("Annotations added and saved.")

```



# QC vizualiztions on dual PPI database evidence
```{r}
# =================================================
# QC Visualization for Master PPI Evidence Table
# =================================================

dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "qc/plots"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- QC Plot 1: Score correlation heatmap ---
message("Generating score correlation heatmap...")

score_cols <- c("RFprob", "AFprob", "AFMprob", "SPOC_score", "ipTM_max", "KIRC_score")
score_cols_present <- intersect(score_cols, colnames(master_ppi))

cor_matrix <- master_ppi %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(score_cols_present)) %>%
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  cor_matrix,
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.2f",
  color = colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(101),
  breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 102),
  main = "Spearman correlation between PPI confidence scores",
  fontsize = 8,
  cellwidth = 40,
  cellheight = 40,
  border_color = "black",
  filename = file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "qc/plots", "heatmap_score_correlations.pdf"),
  width = 6,
  height = 5
)

# --- QC Plot 2: Score distributions by confidence tier ---
message("Generating score distributions by tier...")

scores_long <- master_ppi %>%
  dplyr::select(key, confidence_tier, all_of(score_cols_present)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = all_of(score_cols_present), names_to = "score_type", values_to = "score_value") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(score_value)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(confidence_tier = factor(confidence_tier, levels = c("gold", "silver", "bronze")))

p_tier_boxplot <- ggplot(scores_long, aes(x = confidence_tier, y = score_value, fill = confidence_tier)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3, outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~score_type, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("gold" = "#FFD700", "silver" = "#C0C0C0", "bronze" = "#CD7F32"), guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Score distributions by confidence tier", x = NULL, y = "Score") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA), 
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"))

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "qc/plots", "boxplot_scores_by_tier.pdf"), p_tier_boxplot, width = 7, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)


# --- QC Plot 3: Source overlap bar plot ---
message("Generating source overlap plot...")

source_summary <- master_ppi %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    source_category = dplyr::case_when(
      in_both_predictions & in_IntAct ~ "P80 + 16k + IntAct",
      in_both_predictions ~ "P80 + 16k",
      in_Predictome80 & in_IntAct ~ "P80 + IntAct",
      in_Predictomes16k & in_IntAct ~ "16k + IntAct",
      in_Predictome80 ~ "P80 only",
      in_Predictomes16k ~ "16k only",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(source_category) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(source_category = factor(source_category, levels = c("P80 + 16k + IntAct", "P80 + 16k", "P80 + IntAct", "16k + IntAct", "P80 only", "16k only")))

p_source_bar <- ggplot(source_summary, aes(x = reorder(source_category, -n), y = n, fill = source_category)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(n)), vjust = -0.3, size = 2) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "PPI edges by evidence source", x = NULL, y = "Number of edges") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "qc/plots", "barplot_source_overlap.pdf"), p_source_bar, width = 4, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)


# --- QC Plot 4: Tier validation summary ---
message("Generating tier validation plot...")

validation_summary <- master_ppi %>%
  dplyr::group_by(confidence_tier) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    pct_IntAct = 100 * sum(has_experimental_validation) / n,
    pct_high_ipTM = 100 * sum(high_interface_quality, na.rm = TRUE) / n,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(pct_IntAct, pct_high_ipTM), names_to = "metric", values_to = "percentage") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(metric = dplyr::case_when(metric == "pct_IntAct" ~ "IntAct validated", metric == "pct_high_ipTM" ~ "High ipTM (>=0.7)"))

p_validation <- ggplot(validation_summary, aes(x = confidence_tier, y = percentage, fill = metric)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 1), "%")), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = -0.3, size = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("IntAct validated" = "#4DAF4A", "High ipTM (>=0.7)" = "#377EB8"), name = NULL) +
  labs(title = "Validation metrics by confidence tier", x = NULL, y = "Percentage of edges") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA), 
        legend.position = "top")

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "qc/plots", "barplot_tier_validation.pdf"), p_validation, width = 4, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)


# --- QC Plot 5: Key score scatter plots ---
message("Generating score scatter plots...")

# AFMprob vs SPOC (for overlapping edges)
overlap_for_scatter <- master_ppi %>% dplyr::filter(in_both_predictions)

p_afm_spoc <- ggplot(overlap_for_scatter, aes(x = AFMprob, y = SPOC_score)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.5, color = "dodgerblue3") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = paste0("AFMprob vs SPOC (n=", nrow(overlap_for_scatter), ", r=", round(cor(overlap_for_scatter$AFMprob, overlap_for_scatter$SPOC_score, use = "complete.obs"), 2), ")"), x = "AFMprob (Baker)", y = "SPOC score (Predictomes.org)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "qc/plots", "scatter_AFMprob_vs_SPOC.pdf"), p_afm_spoc, width = 4, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)

# AFMprob vs ipTM
p_afm_iptm <- ggplot(overlap_for_scatter, aes(x = AFMprob, y = ipTM_max)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.5, color = "dodgerblue3") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = paste0("AFMprob vs ipTM (n=", nrow(overlap_for_scatter), ", r=", round(cor(overlap_for_scatter$AFMprob, overlap_for_scatter$ipTM_max, use = "complete.obs"), 2), ")"), x = "AFMprob (Baker)", y = "ipTM max (Predictomes.org)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(panel.grid= element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "qc/plots", "scatter_AFMprob_vs_ipTM.pdf"), p_afm_iptm, width = 4, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)

# RFprob vs AFMprob
p_rf_afm <- ggplot(master_ppi %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(RFprob) & !is.na(AFMprob)), aes(x = RFprob, y = AFMprob)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size = 0.5, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = paste0("RFprob vs AFMprob (Baker scores)"), x = "RFprob (coevolution)", y = "AFMprob (structural)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "qc/plots", "scatter_RFprob_vs_AFMprob.pdf"), p_rf_afm, width = 4, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)


# --- QC Plot 6: Edge counts by organelle ---
message("Generating organelle distribution plots...")

n_tags <- length(unique(shared_long_master$tag))
organelle_colors <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Set3"))(n_tags)
```

# Baseline PPI Network for Neuronal Proteome
```{r}
# =================================================
# Module 1: Baseline PPI Network for Neuronal Proteome
# =================================================
# Filters master_ppi to edges where both partners are detected in neuronal proteome
# Generates QC metrics and plots for baseline characterization

# --- Setup ---
out_dir_baseline <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "baseline")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_baseline, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_baseline, "qc"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Step 1: Define neuronal proteome and filter ---
message("=== Filtering master_ppi to neuronal proteome ===")

neuronal_genes <- unique(complete_data_annotated_day50$Genes)
message("Neuronal proteome: ", length(neuronal_genes), " proteins")

# Pre-filter stats
n_pre <- nrow(master_ppi)
n_gene1_in <- sum(master_ppi$Gene1 %in% neuronal_genes)
n_gene2_in <- sum(master_ppi$Gene2 %in% neuronal_genes)
n_both_in <- sum(master_ppi$Gene1 %in% neuronal_genes & master_ppi$Gene2 %in% neuronal_genes)

message("Pre-filter edges: ", n_pre)
message("  Gene1 in proteome: ", n_gene1_in, " (", round(100 * n_gene1_in / n_pre, 1), "%)")
message("  Gene2 in proteome: ", n_gene2_in, " (", round(100 * n_gene2_in / n_pre, 1), "%)")
message("  Both in proteome: ", n_both_in, " (", round(100 * n_both_in / n_pre, 1), "%)")

# Filter
baseline_ppi <- master_ppi %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene1 %in% neuronal_genes & Gene2 %in% neuronal_genes)

message("Post-filter edges: ", nrow(baseline_ppi))

# Unique proteins in baseline network
baseline_proteins <- unique(c(baseline_ppi$Gene1, baseline_ppi$Gene2))
message("Unique proteins in baseline network: ", length(baseline_proteins))

# --- Step 2: Pre/post filter comparison stats ---
filter_comparison <- data.frame(
  metric = c("total_edges", "gene1_in_proteome", "gene2_in_proteome", "both_in_proteome", "unique_proteins_in_network", "proteome_coverage_pct"),
  pre_filter = c(n_pre, n_gene1_in, n_gene2_in, n_both_in, length(unique(c(master_ppi$Gene1, master_ppi$Gene2))), NA),
  post_filter = c(nrow(baseline_ppi), nrow(baseline_ppi), nrow(baseline_ppi), nrow(baseline_ppi), length(baseline_proteins), round(100 * length(baseline_proteins) / length(neuronal_genes), 1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
readr::write_csv(filter_comparison, file.path(out_dir_baseline, "tables", "filter_comparison.csv"))

# --- Step 3: Tier distribution pre/post filter ---
tier_pre <- master_ppi %>% dplyr::count(confidence_tier, name = "n_pre")
tier_post <- baseline_ppi %>% dplyr::count(confidence_tier, name = "n_post")

tier_comparison <- tier_pre %>%
  dplyr::full_join(tier_post, by = "confidence_tier") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_pre = tidyr::replace_na(n_pre, 0),
    n_post = tidyr::replace_na(n_post, 0),
    pct_retained = round(100 * n_post / n_pre, 1),
    confidence_tier = factor(confidence_tier, levels = c("gold", "silver", "bronze"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(confidence_tier)

message("\nConfidence tier comparison:")
print(tier_comparison)
readr::write_csv(tier_comparison, file.path(out_dir_baseline, "tables", "tier_comparison_pre_post.csv"))

# --- Step 4: Source distribution in baseline ---
source_summary_baseline <- baseline_ppi %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    source_category = dplyr::case_when(
      in_both_predictions & in_IntAct ~ "P80 + 16k + IntAct",
      in_both_predictions ~ "P80 + 16k",
      in_Predictome80 & in_IntAct ~ "P80 + IntAct",
      in_Predictomes16k & in_IntAct ~ "16k + IntAct",
      in_Predictome80 ~ "P80 only",
      in_Predictomes16k ~ "16k only",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(source_category) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n))

readr::write_csv(source_summary_baseline, file.path(out_dir_baseline, "tables", "source_distribution_baseline.csv"))

# --- Step 5: Validation rates in baseline ---
validation_baseline <- baseline_ppi %>%
  dplyr::group_by(confidence_tier) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    n_IntAct = sum(has_experimental_validation),
    pct_IntAct = round(100 * n_IntAct / n, 1),
    n_high_ipTM = sum(high_interface_quality, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_high_ipTM = round(100 * n_high_ipTM / n, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(confidence_tier = factor(confidence_tier, levels = c("gold", "silver", "bronze")))

message("\nValidation rates in baseline:")
print(validation_baseline)
readr::write_csv(validation_baseline, file.path(out_dir_baseline, "tables", "validation_by_tier_baseline.csv"))

# --- Step 6: Organelle coverage in baseline ---
organelle_tags <- c("Mito", "MitoIMS", "MitoMatrix", "MitoMIM", "MitoMOM", "OXPHOS", "mtComplexI", "Golgi", "Lysosome", "ER", "Cytoplasm", "Nucleus", "Autophagy", "Autophagy_det", "SynGO", "Endo_iN_curated_Hundley", "SynapseSVs", "Presynaptic", "Postsynaptic", "EndoDetailLoac", "EndoLyso", "EarlyEndosome", "RecyclingEndosome", "SVfusion", "Svendocytosis", "Svexocytosis", "vATPase", "mtCI_AF")

# Shared organelle edges (long format)
org1_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot1")
org2_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot2")
existing_org1 <- intersect(org1_cols, colnames(baseline_ppi))
existing_org2 <- intersect(org2_cols, colnames(baseline_ppi))
existing_tags <- sub("_prot1$", "", existing_org1)

shared_long_baseline <- {
  m1 <- baseline_ppi[, existing_org1, drop = FALSE] %>% lapply(function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x))) %>% as.data.frame()
  m2 <- baseline_ppi[, existing_org2, drop = FALSE] %>% lapply(function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x))) %>% as.data.frame()
  shared_mat <- as.matrix(m1) & as.matrix(m2)
  
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(shared_mat)), function(i) {
    idx <- which(shared_mat[i, ])
    if (!length(idx)) return(NULL)
    data.frame(key = baseline_ppi$key[i], tag = existing_tags[idx], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}

organelle_edge_counts <- shared_long_baseline %>% dplyr::count(tag, name = "n_edges") %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_edges))
message("\nOrganelle edge counts in baseline:")
print(organelle_edge_counts)
readr::write_csv(organelle_edge_counts, file.path(out_dir_baseline, "tables", "organelle_edge_counts_baseline.csv"))
readr::write_csv(shared_long_baseline, file.path(out_dir_baseline, "tables", "shared_organelle_edges_baseline.csv"))

# --- Step 7: Node degree distribution ---
degree_df <- data.frame(gene = c(baseline_ppi$Gene1, baseline_ppi$Gene2), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::count(gene, name = "degree") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(degree))

degree_summary <- data.frame(
  metric = c("min_degree", "median_degree", "mean_degree", "max_degree", "n_hubs_deg10plus", "n_hubs_deg50plus"),
  value = c(min(degree_df$degree), median(degree_df$degree), round(mean(degree_df$degree), 2), max(degree_df$degree), sum(degree_df$degree >= 10), sum(degree_df$degree >= 50))
)
message("\nNode degree summary:")
print(degree_summary)
readr::write_csv(degree_df, file.path(out_dir_baseline, "tables", "node_degree_baseline.csv"))
readr::write_csv(degree_summary, file.path(out_dir_baseline, "tables", "node_degree_summary.csv"))

# --- Step 8: Summary table for methods ---
baseline_summary <- data.frame(
  metric = c(
    "neuronal_proteome_proteins",
    "master_ppi_edges",
    "baseline_ppi_edges",
    "baseline_unique_proteins",
    "proteome_coverage_pct",
    "gold_tier_edges",
    "silver_tier_edges", 
    "bronze_tier_edges",
    "edges_in_both_sources",
    "edges_with_IntAct_validation",
    "edges_with_high_ipTM",
    "median_node_degree",
    "max_node_degree"
  ),
  value = c(
    length(neuronal_genes),
    n_pre,
    nrow(baseline_ppi),
    length(baseline_proteins),
    round(100 * length(baseline_proteins) / length(neuronal_genes), 1),
    sum(baseline_ppi$confidence_tier == "gold"),
    sum(baseline_ppi$confidence_tier == "silver"),
    sum(baseline_ppi$confidence_tier == "bronze"),
    sum(baseline_ppi$in_both_predictions),
    sum(baseline_ppi$has_experimental_validation),
    sum(baseline_ppi$high_interface_quality, na.rm = TRUE),
    median(degree_df$degree),
    max(degree_df$degree)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
readr::write_csv(baseline_summary, file.path(out_dir_baseline, "tables", "baseline_summary_for_methods.csv"))

message("\n=== Baseline summary ===")
print(baseline_summary)

# Save baseline_ppi
readr::write_csv(baseline_ppi, file.path(out_dir_baseline, "tables", "baseline_ppi.csv"))
message("\nBaseline PPI saved to: ", file.path(out_dir_baseline, "tables", "baseline_ppi.csv"))
```

```{r}
tags_to_keep <- shared_long_baseline %>%
  dplyr::count(tag) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n >= min_edges_for_density) %>%
  dplyr::pull(tag)

message("Organelles with >= ", min_edges_for_density, " edges: ", length(tags_to_keep))

# Filter scores to those tags
scores_org_baseline <- baseline_ppi %>%
  dplyr::select(key, dplyr::all_of(score_cols)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(shared_long_baseline, by = "key") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag), tag %in% tags_to_keep)

# Update colors for filtered set
organelle_colors_filtered <- organelle_colors[names(organelle_colors) %in% tags_to_keep]

plot_score_density_by_organelle <- function(df, score_col, org_colors, out_dir) {
  df_plot <- df %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(!!sym(score_col)))
  if (nrow(df_plot) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  
  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = !!sym(score_col), fill = tag)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors, name = "Organelle") +
    labs(title = paste(score_col, "density by organelle (baseline, n >= 50)"), x = score_col, y = "Density") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), 
          panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA), 
          legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"), legend.position = "right")
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("density_", score_col, "_by_organelle.pdf")), p, width = 5, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
}

for (sc in score_cols) {
  plot_score_density_by_organelle(scores_org_baseline, sc, organelle_colors_filtered, file.path(out_dir_baseline, "qc"))
}

# --- QC Plot 6: Score boxplot by organelle ---
plot_score_boxplot_by_organelle <- function(df, score_col, org_colors, out_dir) {
  df_plot <- df %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(!!sym(score_col)))
  if (nrow(df_plot) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  
  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = reorder(tag, !!sym(score_col), median), y = !!sym(score_col), fill = tag)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3, outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors, guide = "none") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = paste(score_col, "by organelle (baseline)"), x = NULL, y = score_col) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), 
          panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("boxplot_", score_col, "_by_organelle.pdf")), p, width = 5, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
}

  dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2, confidence_tier) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(Gene1, Gene2), values_to = "gene") %>%

  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(total_degree = sum(degree), .groups = "drop")

  scale_fill_manual(values = tier_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 30)) +
  labs(title = "Node degree distribution by confidence tier", x = "Degree (interactions per tier)", y = "Count") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA), strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"))

  dplyr::filter(gene %in% high_degree_genes) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(total = sum(degree), pct = 100 * degree / total) %>%

# Summarize: for hubs, what fraction of edges are gold/silver/bronze?
hub_tier_summary <- tier_composition_hubs %>%
  dplyr::group_by(confidence_tier) %>%

  dplyr::mutate(pct = round(100 * total_edges / sum(total_edges), 1))

message("Hub proteins (degree >= 10) tier composition:")
print(hub_tier_summary)
```

# Trimer Detection and Validation
```{r}
# =================================================
# Module 2: Trimer Detection and Validation
# =================================================

library(igraph)

# --- Setup ---
out_dir_trimer <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "trimers")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_trimer, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_trimer, "qc"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Step 1: Filter baseline to gold + silver ---
message("=== Filtering baseline_ppi to gold + silver tiers ===")

baseline_gs <- baseline_ppi %>%
  dplyr::filter(confidence_tier %in% c("gold", "silver"))

message("Gold + silver edges: ", nrow(baseline_gs), " / ", nrow(baseline_ppi), " (", round(100 * nrow(baseline_gs) / nrow(baseline_ppi), 1), "%)")

# --- Step 2: Load and parse ComplexPortal ---
message("Loading ComplexPortal...")

path_complexportal <- "/Users/felix/Desktop/ppi/9606.tsv"
complexportal_raw <- data.table::fread(path_complexportal, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, fill = TRUE, quote = "", data.table = FALSE)

# Parse protein identifiers and stoichiometry
# Column: "Identifiers (and stoichiometry) of molecules in complex" contains e.g. "P84022(1)|Q13485(1)|Q15796(1)"
complexportal <- complexportal_raw %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    complex_id = `#Complex ac`,
    complex_name = `Recommended name`,
    proteins_raw = `Identifiers (and stoichiometry) of molecules in complex`,
    go_annotations = `Go Annotations`,
    description = Description
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Extract UniProt IDs (remove stoichiometry)
    proteins_list = stringr::str_extract_all(proteins_raw, "[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{5}(?=\\()"),
    n_proteins = purrr::map_int(proteins_list, length)
  )

message("ComplexPortal complexes loaded: ", nrow(complexportal))
message("Complexes with 3+ proteins: ", sum(complexportal$n_proteins >= 3))

# Create lookup: protein -> complex_ids
protein_to_complex <- complexportal %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_id, proteins_list) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(proteins_list) %>%
  dplyr::rename(protein = proteins_list) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(protein) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(complex_ids = list(unique(complex_id)), .groups = "drop")

# Create lookup: complex_id -> all proteins
complex_to_proteins <- complexportal %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_id, proteins_list) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(proteins_list) %>%
  dplyr::rename(protein = proteins_list) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(complex_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(proteins = list(unique(protein)), .groups = "drop")

# --- Step 3: Build UniProt to Gene mapping ---
# Need to map ComplexPortal (UniProt) to our data (Gene symbols)
uniprot_to_gene <- baseline_ppi %>%
  dplyr::select(Protein1, Gene1) %>%
  dplyr::rename(uniprot = Protein1, gene = Gene1) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    baseline_ppi %>% dplyr::select(Protein2, Gene2) %>% dplyr::rename(uniprot = Protein2, gene = Gene2)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(uniprot, .keep_all = TRUE)

gene_to_uniprot <- uniprot_to_gene %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, uniprot)

message("UniProt-Gene mappings: ", nrow(uniprot_to_gene))

# --- Step 4: Build igraph ---
message("Building graph from gold + silver edges...")

g <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
  baseline_gs %>% dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2),
  directed = FALSE
)

# Remove multi-edges and loops
g <- igraph::simplify(g)

message("Graph: ", igraph::vcount(g), " nodes, ", igraph::ecount(g), " edges")

# --- Step 5: Find all triangles (trimers) ---
message("Finding triangles...")

triangles_raw <- igraph::triangles(g)
n_triangles <- length(triangles_raw) / 3

message("Triangles found: ", n_triangles)

# Convert to matrix (each row = 1 triangle)
if (n_triangles > 0) {
  triangle_matrix <- matrix(igraph::V(g)$name[triangles_raw], ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  
  # Sort each row alphabetically for consistent trimer_id
  triangle_matrix_sorted <- t(apply(triangle_matrix, 1, sort))
  
  # Create trimer dataframe
  trimers_df <- data.frame(
    Gene1 = triangle_matrix_sorted[, 1],
    Gene2 = triangle_matrix_sorted[, 2],
    Gene3 = triangle_matrix_sorted[, 3],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(trimer_id = paste(Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, sep = "::")) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(trimer_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  message("Unique trimers: ", nrow(trimers_df))
} else {
  stop("No triangles found. Check graph connectivity.")
}

# --- Step 6: Get edge keys for each trimer ---
message("Retrieving edge scores for trimers...")

# Helper function to get edge key
.get_edge_key <- function(a, b) {
  ifelse(a <= b, paste(a, b, sep = "::"), paste(b, a, sep = "::"))
}

trimers_df <- trimers_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    edge1_key = .get_edge_key(Gene1, Gene2),
    edge2_key = .get_edge_key(Gene1, Gene3),
    edge3_key = .get_edge_key(Gene2, Gene3)
  )

# Create edge score lookup from baseline_gs
edge_scores <- baseline_gs %>%
  dplyr::mutate(edge_key = .get_edge_key(Gene1, Gene2)) %>%
  dplyr::select(edge_key, confidence_tier, RFprob, AFMprob, SPOC_score, ipTM_max)

# Join scores for each edge
trimers_df <- trimers_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(edge_scores %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_e1"), -edge_key), by = c("edge1_key" = "edge_key")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(edge_scores %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_e2"), -edge_key), by = c("edge2_key" = "edge_key")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(edge_scores %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_e3"), -edge_key), by = c("edge3_key" = "edge_key"))

# --- Step 7: Compute trimer-level scores ---
message("Computing trimer scores...")

trimers_df <- trimers_df %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mean_AFMprob = mean(c(AFMprob_e1, AFMprob_e2, AFMprob_e3), na.rm = TRUE),
    min_AFMprob = min(c(AFMprob_e1, AFMprob_e2, AFMprob_e3), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_RFprob = mean(c(RFprob_e1, RFprob_e2, RFprob_e3), na.rm = TRUE),
    min_RFprob = min(c(RFprob_e1, RFprob_e2, RFprob_e3), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ipTM = mean(c(ipTM_max_e1, ipTM_max_e2, ipTM_max_e3), na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ipTM = min(c(ipTM_max_e1, ipTM_max_e2, ipTM_max_e3), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_SPOC = mean(c(SPOC_score_e1, SPOC_score_e2, SPOC_score_e3), na.rm = TRUE),
    min_SPOC = min(c(SPOC_score_e1, SPOC_score_e2, SPOC_score_e3), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_gold_edges = sum(c(confidence_tier_e1, confidence_tier_e2, confidence_tier_e3) == "gold", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_silver_edges = sum(c(confidence_tier_e1, confidence_tier_e2, confidence_tier_e3) == "silver", na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# --- Step 8: Assign shared organelle ---
message("Assigning shared organelle annotations...")

# Get organelle annotations per gene
gene_to_organelles <- complete_data_annotated_day50 %>%
  dplyr::select(Genes, dplyr::all_of(organelle_tags)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Genes, names_to = "organelle", values_to = "present") %>%
  dplyr::filter(present == 1) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genes) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(organelles = list(organelle), .groups = "drop")

# Function to find shared organelles for 3 genes (with NA handling)
.shared_organelles <- function(g1, g2, g3, lookup) {
  o1_idx <- which(lookup$Genes == g1)
  o2_idx <- which(lookup$Genes == g2)
  o3_idx <- which(lookup$Genes == g3)
  
  # Check if all genes are in lookup
  if (length(o1_idx) == 0 || length(o2_idx) == 0 || length(o3_idx) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  
  o1 <- lookup$organelles[[o1_idx]]
  o2 <- lookup$organelles[[o2_idx]]
  o3 <- lookup$organelles[[o3_idx]]
  
  # Check if organelle lists are empty
  if (length(o1) == 0 || length(o2) == 0 || length(o3) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  
  shared <- intersect(intersect(o1, o2), o3)
  if (length(shared) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  return(paste(shared, collapse = ";"))
}

# Re-run
trimers_df <- trimers_df %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(shared_organelle = .shared_organelles(Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, gene_to_organelles)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

message("Trimers with shared organelle: ", sum(!is.na(trimers_df$shared_organelle)))
# --- Step 9: ComplexPortal validation ---
message("Validating against ComplexPortal...")

# Map genes to UniProt for matching
trimers_df <- trimers_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_uniprot %>% dplyr::rename(Protein1 = uniprot), by = c("Gene1" = "gene")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_uniprot %>% dplyr::rename(Protein2 = uniprot), by = c("Gene2" = "gene")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_uniprot %>% dplyr::rename(Protein3 = uniprot), by = c("Gene3" = "gene"))

# Function to check if trimer is in a complex
.check_complex_match <- function(p1, p2, p3, complex_to_proteins) {
  if (is.na(p1) || is.na(p2) || is.na(p3)) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_character_))
  
  proteins <- c(p1, p2, p3)
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(complex_to_proteins))) {
    complex_proteins <- complex_to_proteins$proteins[[i]]
    n_match <- sum(proteins %in% complex_proteins)
    
    if (n_match == 3) {
      return(list(strict = TRUE, relaxed = TRUE, complex_id = complex_to_proteins$complex_id[i]))
    }
    if (n_match >= 2) {
      return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = TRUE, complex_id = complex_to_proteins$complex_id[i]))
    }
  }
  
  return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_character_))
}

# Apply matching (this may take a moment for large datasets)
message("Matching trimers to ComplexPortal (this may take a moment)...")

complex_matches <- purrr::pmap(
  list(trimers_df$Protein1, trimers_df$Protein2, trimers_df$Protein3),
  ~ .check_complex_match(..1, ..2, ..3, complex_to_proteins)
)

trimers_df$complexportal_strict <- purrr::map_lgl(complex_matches, "strict")
trimers_df$complexportal_relaxed <- purrr::map_lgl(complex_matches, "relaxed")
trimers_df$complexportal_id <- purrr::map_chr(complex_matches, "complex_id")

message("Trimers with strict ComplexPortal match (3/3): ", sum(trimers_df$complexportal_strict))
message("Trimers with relaxed ComplexPortal match (2/3): ", sum(trimers_df$complexportal_relaxed))

# --- Step 10: Tier composition classification ---
trimers_df <- trimers_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    tier_composition = dplyr::case_when(
      n_gold_edges == 3 ~ "all_gold",
      n_gold_edges == 2 ~ "2gold_1silver",
      n_gold_edges == 1 ~ "1gold_2silver",
      n_gold_edges == 0 ~ "all_silver",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    )
  )

# --- Step 11: Save trimer evidence table ---
# Select and order columns for output
trimer_evidence <- trimers_df %>%
  dplyr::select(
    trimer_id, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3,
    edge1_key, edge2_key, edge3_key,
    mean_AFMprob, min_AFMprob,
    mean_RFprob, min_RFprob,
    mean_ipTM, min_ipTM,
    mean_SPOC, min_SPOC,
    n_gold_edges, n_silver_edges, tier_composition,
    shared_organelle,
    complexportal_strict, complexportal_relaxed, complexportal_id,
    Protein1, Protein2, Protein3
  )

readr::write_csv(trimer_evidence, file.path(out_dir_trimer, "tables", "trimer_evidence.csv"))
message("Trimer evidence table saved: ", nrow(trimer_evidence), " trimers")

# --- Step 12: Summary statistics ---
trimer_stats <- data.frame(
  metric = c(
    "total_trimers",
    "trimers_all_gold",
    "trimers_2gold_1silver",
    "trimers_1gold_2silver",
    "trimers_all_silver",
    "trimers_with_shared_organelle",
    "trimers_complexportal_strict",
    "trimers_complexportal_relaxed",
    "median_mean_AFMprob",
    "median_min_AFMprob",
    "median_mean_ipTM",
    "median_min_ipTM"
  ),
  value = c(
    nrow(trimer_evidence),
    sum(trimer_evidence$tier_composition == "all_gold"),
    sum(trimer_evidence$tier_composition == "2gold_1silver"),
    sum(trimer_evidence$tier_composition == "1gold_2silver"),
    sum(trimer_evidence$tier_composition == "all_silver"),
    sum(!is.na(trimer_evidence$shared_organelle)),
    sum(trimer_evidence$complexportal_strict),
    sum(trimer_evidence$complexportal_relaxed),
    round(median(trimer_evidence$mean_AFMprob, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    round(median(trimer_evidence$min_AFMprob, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    round(median(trimer_evidence$mean_ipTM, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    round(median(trimer_evidence$min_ipTM, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

readr::write_csv(trimer_stats, file.path(out_dir_trimer, "tables", "trimer_stats.csv"))




# =================================================
# ComplexPortal Validation
# =================================================
# --- ComplexPortal matched trimers export ---
cp_matched <- trimer_evidence %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(complexportal_id)) %>%
  dplyr::select(trimer_id, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, complexportal_strict, complexportal_relaxed, complexportal_id) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    complexportal %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, complex_name, n_proteins, description),
    by = c("complexportal_id" = "complex_id")
  )

readr::write_csv(cp_matched, file.path(out_dir_trimer, "tables", "trimers_complexportal_matched.csv"))

# --- Complex counts ---

message("Top 10 ComplexPortal complexes by trimer count:")

# --- Unique complexes recovered ---
n_unique_complexes <- trimer_evidence %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(complexportal_id)) %>%

# --- Coverage by complex size ---

  dplyr::mutate(recovered = complex_id %in% trimer_evidence$complexportal_id) %>%
```

```{r}
    dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, tier_composition) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(Gene1, Gene2, Gene3), values_to = "gene") %>%
    dplyr::select(-name)
  
  # Build graph from trimer proteins only
  trimer_proteins <- unique(c(trimer_evidence$Gene1, trimer_evidence$Gene2, trimer_evidence$Gene3))
  
  g_trimer <- igraph::induced_subgraph(g, vids = which(igraph::V(g)$name %in% trimer_proteins))
  
  # Add organelle as node attribute for coloring
  node_org <- gene_to_organelles %>%
    dplyr::filter(Genes %in% trimer_proteins) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(primary_org = purrr::map_chr(organelles, ~ if (length(.x) > 0) .x[1] else NA_character_))
  
  igraph::V(g_trimer)$organelle <- node_org$primary_org[match(igraph::V(g_trimer)$name, node_org$Genes)]
  
  # Plot
  pdf(file.path(out_dir_trimer, "qc", "network_trimers.pdf"), width = 10, height = 10)
  plot(g_trimer, 
       vertex.size = 3, 
       vertex.label = NA, 
       vertex.color = organelle_colors[igraph::V(g_trimer)$organelle],
       edge.width = 0.3,
       main = paste0("Trimer network (", nrow(trimer_evidence), " trimers, ", igraph::vcount(g_trimer), " proteins)"))
  dev.off()
  
  message("Network plot saved.")
} else {
  message("Too many trimers for network plot (", nrow(trimer_evidence), "). Skipping.")
}



print(quality_by_cp)
message("\nTrimer QC plots saved to: ", file.path(out_dir_trimer, "qc"))
```




# Tetramer Extraction & Validation
```{r}
# =================================================
# Module 3: Tetramer Detection (de novo) + Scoring + QC
# =================================================

out_dir_tetramer <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "tetramers")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_tetramer, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_tetramer, "qc"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Step 1: Find tetramers de novo (4-cliques) ---
message("=== Finding tetramers de novo ===")

cliques_4 <- igraph::cliques(g, min = 4, max = 4)
message("Complete 4-cliques found: ", length(cliques_4))

tetramers_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cliques_4, function(cl) {
  genes <- sort(igraph::V(g)$name[cl])
  data.frame(
    tetramer_id = paste(genes, collapse = "::"),
    Gene1 = genes[1],
    Gene2 = genes[2],
    Gene3 = genes[3],
    Gene4 = genes[4],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(tetramer_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

message("Unique de novo tetramers: ", nrow(tetramers_df))

# --- Step 2: Get edge keys for each tetramer (6 edges) ---
message("Retrieving edge scores for tetramers...")

tetramers_df <- tetramers_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    edge1_key = .get_edge_key(Gene1, Gene2),
    edge2_key = .get_edge_key(Gene1, Gene3),
    edge3_key = .get_edge_key(Gene1, Gene4),
    edge4_key = .get_edge_key(Gene2, Gene3),
    edge5_key = .get_edge_key(Gene2, Gene4),
    edge6_key = .get_edge_key(Gene3, Gene4)
  )

# Join edge scores
for (j in 1:6) {
  edge_col <- paste0("edge", j, "_key")
  suffix <- paste0("_e", j)
  
  tetramers_df <- tetramers_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      edge_scores %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, suffix), -edge_key),
      by = setNames("edge_key", edge_col)
    )
}

# --- Step 3: Compute tetramer-level scores ---
message("Computing tetramer scores...")

tetramers_df <- tetramers_df %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_edges = sum(!is.na(c(confidence_tier_e1, confidence_tier_e2, confidence_tier_e3, confidence_tier_e4, confidence_tier_e5, confidence_tier_e6))),
    n_gold_edges = sum(c(confidence_tier_e1, confidence_tier_e2, confidence_tier_e3, confidence_tier_e4, confidence_tier_e5, confidence_tier_e6) == "gold", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_silver_edges = sum(c(confidence_tier_e1, confidence_tier_e2, confidence_tier_e3, confidence_tier_e4, confidence_tier_e5, confidence_tier_e6) == "silver", na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_AFMprob = safe_mean(c(AFMprob_e1, AFMprob_e2, AFMprob_e3, AFMprob_e4, AFMprob_e5, AFMprob_e6)),
    min_AFMprob = safe_min(c(AFMprob_e1, AFMprob_e2, AFMprob_e3, AFMprob_e4, AFMprob_e5, AFMprob_e6)),
    mean_RFprob = safe_mean(c(RFprob_e1, RFprob_e2, RFprob_e3, RFprob_e4, RFprob_e5, RFprob_e6)),
    min_RFprob = safe_min(c(RFprob_e1, RFprob_e2, RFprob_e3, RFprob_e4, RFprob_e5, RFprob_e6)),
    mean_ipTM = safe_mean(c(ipTM_max_e1, ipTM_max_e2, ipTM_max_e3, ipTM_max_e4, ipTM_max_e5, ipTM_max_e6)),
    min_ipTM = safe_min(c(ipTM_max_e1, ipTM_max_e2, ipTM_max_e3, ipTM_max_e4, ipTM_max_e5, ipTM_max_e6)),
    mean_SPOC = safe_mean(c(SPOC_score_e1, SPOC_score_e2, SPOC_score_e3, SPOC_score_e4, SPOC_score_e5, SPOC_score_e6)),
    min_SPOC = safe_min(c(SPOC_score_e1, SPOC_score_e2, SPOC_score_e3, SPOC_score_e4, SPOC_score_e5, SPOC_score_e6))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Quality scores
tetramers_df <- tetramers_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    quality_A = min_AFMprob,
    quality_B = mean_AFMprob * mean_ipTM,
    quality_C = min_AFMprob * min_ipTM,
    quality_D = 0.5 * min_AFMprob + 0.3 * min_ipTM + 0.2 * (n_gold_edges / 6)
  )

# Tier composition
tetramers_df <- tetramers_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    tier_composition = dplyr::case_when(
      n_gold_edges == 6 ~ "all_gold",
      n_gold_edges >= 4 ~ "gold_majority",
      n_silver_edges >= 4 ~ "silver_majority",
      n_silver_edges == 6 ~ "all_silver",
      TRUE ~ "mixed"
    )
  )

# --- Step 4: Assign shared organelle ---
message("Assigning shared organelle annotations...")

.shared_organelles_4 <- function(g1, g2, g3, g4, lookup) {
  o1_idx <- which(lookup$Genes == g1)
  o2_idx <- which(lookup$Genes == g2)
  o3_idx <- which(lookup$Genes == g3)
  o4_idx <- which(lookup$Genes == g4)
  
  if (length(o1_idx) == 0 || length(o2_idx) == 0 || length(o3_idx) == 0 || length(o4_idx) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  
  o1 <- lookup$organelles[[o1_idx]]
  o2 <- lookup$organelles[[o2_idx]]
  o3 <- lookup$organelles[[o3_idx]]
  o4 <- lookup$organelles[[o4_idx]]
  
  if (length(o1) == 0 || length(o2) == 0 || length(o3) == 0 || length(o4) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  
  shared <- Reduce(intersect, list(o1, o2, o3, o4))
  if (length(shared) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  return(paste(shared, collapse = ";"))
}

tetramers_df <- tetramers_df %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(shared_organelle = .shared_organelles_4(Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, Gene4, gene_to_organelles)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

message("Tetramers with shared organelle: ", sum(!is.na(tetramers_df$shared_organelle)))

# --- Step 5: ComplexPortal validation ---
message("Validating tetramers against ComplexPortal...")

tetramers_df <- tetramers_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_uniprot %>% dplyr::rename(Protein1 = uniprot), by = c("Gene1" = "gene")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_uniprot %>% dplyr::rename(Protein2 = uniprot), by = c("Gene2" = "gene")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_uniprot %>% dplyr::rename(Protein3 = uniprot), by = c("Gene3" = "gene")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_uniprot %>% dplyr::rename(Protein4 = uniprot), by = c("Gene4" = "gene"))

.check_complex_match_4 <- function(p1, p2, p3, p4, complex_to_proteins) {
  if (is.na(p1) || is.na(p2) || is.na(p3) || is.na(p4)) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_character_))
  
  proteins <- c(p1, p2, p3, p4)
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(complex_to_proteins))) {
    complex_proteins <- complex_to_proteins$proteins[[i]]
    n_match <- sum(proteins %in% complex_proteins)
    
    if (n_match == 4) return(list(strict = TRUE, relaxed = TRUE, complex_id = complex_to_proteins$complex_id[i]))
    if (n_match >= 3) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = TRUE, complex_id = complex_to_proteins$complex_id[i]))
  }
  
  return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_character_))
}

message("Matching tetramers to ComplexPortal...")
complex_matches_4 <- purrr::pmap(
  list(tetramers_df$Protein1, tetramers_df$Protein2, tetramers_df$Protein3, tetramers_df$Protein4),
  ~ .check_complex_match_4(..1, ..2, ..3, ..4, complex_to_proteins)
)

tetramers_df$complexportal_strict <- purrr::map_lgl(complex_matches_4, "strict")
tetramers_df$complexportal_relaxed <- purrr::map_lgl(complex_matches_4, "relaxed")
tetramers_df$complexportal_id <- purrr::map_chr(complex_matches_4, "complex_id")

tetramers_df <- tetramers_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cp_status = dplyr::case_when(
      complexportal_strict ~ "Strict (4/4)",
      complexportal_relaxed ~ "Relaxed (3/4)",
      TRUE ~ "Novel"
    )
  )

message("Tetramers with strict ComplexPortal match (4/4): ", sum(tetramers_df$complexportal_strict))
message("Tetramers with relaxed ComplexPortal match (3/4): ", sum(tetramers_df$complexportal_relaxed))

# --- Step 6: Save tetramer evidence table ---
tetramer_evidence <- tetramers_df %>%
  dplyr::select(
    tetramer_id, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, Gene4,
    edge1_key, edge2_key, edge3_key, edge4_key, edge5_key, edge6_key,
    mean_AFMprob, min_AFMprob,
    mean_RFprob, min_RFprob,
    mean_ipTM, min_ipTM,
    mean_SPOC, min_SPOC,
    quality_A, quality_B, quality_C, quality_D,
    n_gold_edges, n_silver_edges, tier_composition,
    shared_organelle,
    complexportal_strict, complexportal_relaxed, complexportal_id, cp_status,
    Protein1, Protein2, Protein3, Protein4
  )

readr::write_csv(tetramer_evidence, file.path(out_dir_tetramer, "tables", "tetramer_evidence.csv"))
message("Tetramer evidence table saved: ", nrow(tetramer_evidence), " tetramers")

# --- Step 7: Summary statistics ---
tetramer_stats <- data.frame(
  metric = c(
    "total_tetramers",
    "tetramers_all_gold",
    "tetramers_gold_majority",
    "tetramers_silver_majority",
    "tetramers_all_silver",
    "tetramers_with_shared_organelle",
    "tetramers_complexportal_strict",
    "tetramers_complexportal_relaxed",
    "median_mean_AFMprob",
    "median_min_AFMprob",
    "median_mean_ipTM",
    "median_min_ipTM",
    "median_quality_C"
  ),
  value = c(
    nrow(tetramer_evidence),
    sum(tetramer_evidence$tier_composition == "all_gold"),
    sum(tetramer_evidence$tier_composition == "gold_majority"),
    sum(tetramer_evidence$tier_composition == "silver_majority"),
    sum(tetramer_evidence$tier_composition == "all_silver"),
    sum(!is.na(tetramer_evidence$shared_organelle)),
    sum(tetramer_evidence$complexportal_strict),
    sum(tetramer_evidence$complexportal_relaxed),
    round(median(tetramer_evidence$mean_AFMprob, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    round(median(tetramer_evidence$min_AFMprob, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    round(median(tetramer_evidence$mean_ipTM, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    round(median(tetramer_evidence$min_ipTM, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    round(median(tetramer_evidence$quality_C, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

readr::write_csv(tetramer_stats, file.path(out_dir_tetramer, "tables", "tetramer_stats.csv"))
message("\n=== Tetramer Summary ===")
print(tetramer_stats)

```

```{r}
# --- Parse stoichiometry from ComplexPortal ---
# Format: "P84022(1)|Q13485(1)|Q15796(1)" or "P84022(2)|Q13485(1)"
complexportal_stoich <- complexportal %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_id, complex_name, proteins_raw, n_proteins) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    stoich_list = stringr::str_extract_all(proteins_raw, "[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{5}\\(\\d+\\)"),
    stoich_parsed = purrr::map(stoich_list, function(x) {
      if (length(x) == 0) return(data.frame(protein = character(), copies = integer()))
      proteins <- stringr::str_extract(x, "^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{5}")
      copies <- as.integer(stringr::str_extract(x, "(?<=\\()\\d+(?=\\))"))
      data.frame(protein = proteins, copies = copies, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }),
    n_unique_proteins = purrr::map_int(stoich_parsed, ~length(unique(.x$protein))),
    n_total_subunits = purrr::map_int(stoich_parsed, ~if(nrow(.x) == 0) 0L else sum(.x$copies)),
    has_multimeric = purrr::map_lgl(stoich_parsed, ~if(nrow(.x) == 0) FALSE else any(.x$copies > 1)),
    max_copies = purrr::map_int(stoich_parsed, ~if(nrow(.x) == 0) 0L else max(.x$copies))
  )

# Summary

  dplyr::summarise(
    total_complexes = dplyr::n(),
    n_with_multimeric = sum(has_multimeric),

    n_homomeric_2plus = sum(max_copies >= 2),

  )
```

# Complex Growing from Trimers and Tetramers
```{r}
# =================================================
# Complex Growing from Trimers and Tetramers
# =================================================

out_dir_complex <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "complexes")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_complex, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_complex, "qc"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


# --- Step 1: Setup adjacency list for fast lookup ---
message("=== Complex Growing ===")
message("Building adjacency structures...")

# Adjacency list from gold+silver edges
adj_list <- baseline_gs %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2) %>%
  {
    edges <- rbind(
      data.frame(from = .$Gene1, to = .$Gene2, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
      data.frame(from = .$Gene2, to = .$Gene1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    )
    split(edges$to, edges$from)
  }

message("Adjacency list: ", length(adj_list), " nodes")


# --- Step 2: Function to grow a complex by one step ---
.grow_complex <- function(members, adj_list, min_edges = 2) {
  # Find all neighbors of current members
  all_neighbors <- unlist(adj_list[members])
  if (is.null(all_neighbors) || length(all_neighbors) == 0) return(character(0))
  
  # Count how many members each neighbor connects to
  neighbor_counts <- table(all_neighbors)
  
  # Keep only those with >= min_edges connections to current members
  candidates <- names(neighbor_counts)[neighbor_counts >= min_edges]
  
  # Exclude current members
  candidates <- setdiff(candidates, members)
  
  return(candidates)
}


# --- Step 3: Function to iteratively grow until no more can be added ---
.grow_complex_iterative <- function(seed_members, adj_list, min_edges = 2, max_size = 100) {
  current <- seed_members
  
  repeat {
    if (length(current) >= max_size) break
    
    candidates <- .grow_complex(current, adj_list, min_edges)
    
    if (length(candidates) == 0) break
    
    # Add all valid candidates
    current <- c(current, candidates)
  }
  
  return(sort(current))
}


# --- Step 4: Grow from trimers ---
message("Growing complexes from trimers...")

trimer_seeds <- trimer_evidence %>%
  dplyr::select(trimer_id, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(seed_members = list(c(Gene1, Gene2, Gene3))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Grow each trimer
grown_from_trimers <- trimer_seeds %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    grown_members = list(.grow_complex_iterative(seed_members, adj_list, min_edges = 2)),
    grown_size = length(grown_members),
    complex_id = paste(sort(grown_members), collapse = "::")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

message("Trimers grown: ", nrow(grown_from_trimers))
message("Unique complexes from trimers: ", length(unique(grown_from_trimers$complex_id)))


# --- Step 5: Grow from tetramers ---
message("Growing complexes from tetramers...")

tetramer_seeds <- tetramer_evidence %>%
  dplyr::select(tetramer_id, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, Gene4) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(seed_members = list(c(Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, Gene4))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

grown_from_tetramers <- tetramer_seeds %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    grown_members = list(.grow_complex_iterative(seed_members, adj_list, min_edges = 2)),
    grown_size = length(grown_members),
    complex_id = paste(sort(grown_members), collapse = "::")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

message("Tetramers grown: ", nrow(grown_from_tetramers))
message("Unique complexes from tetramers: ", length(unique(grown_from_tetramers$complex_id)))


# --- Step 6: Internal QC - compare trimer+1 with de novo tetramers ---
message("\n=== Internal QC: Trimer+1 vs Tetramer ===")

# Get trimers that grew to size 4
trimer_plus_one <- grown_from_trimers %>%
  dplyr::filter(grown_size == 4)

message("Trimers that grew to size 4: ", nrow(trimer_plus_one))

# Check overlap with de novo tetramers
tetramer_ids <- tetramer_evidence %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(complex_id = paste(sort(c(Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, Gene4)), collapse = "::")) %>%
  dplyr::pull(complex_id)

trimer_plus_one_overlap <- trimer_plus_one %>%
  dplyr::mutate(matches_tetramer = complex_id %in% tetramer_ids)

message("Trimer+1 that match de novo tetramers: ", sum(trimer_plus_one_overlap$matches_tetramer), " / ", nrow(trimer_plus_one_overlap))
message("Match rate: ", round(100 * mean(trimer_plus_one_overlap$matches_tetramer), 1), "%")


# --- Step 7: Combine and deduplicate complexes ---
message("\nCombining complexes from all seeds...")

all_grown <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  grown_from_trimers %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, grown_members, grown_size) %>% dplyr::mutate(seed_type = "trimer"),
  grown_from_tetramers %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, grown_members, grown_size) %>% dplyr::mutate(seed_type = "tetramer")
)

# Count how many seeds led to each complex
complex_seed_counts <- all_grown %>%
  dplyr::group_by(complex_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_trimer_seeds = sum(seed_type == "trimer"),
    n_tetramer_seeds = sum(seed_type == "tetramer"),
    n_total_seeds = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Deduplicate to unique complexes
unique_complexes <- all_grown %>%
  dplyr::distinct(complex_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(complex_seed_counts, by = "complex_id")

message("Unique complexes (before merging): ", nrow(unique_complexes))


# --- Step 8: Merge overlapping complexes (80% threshold) ---
message("\nMerging overlapping complexes (80% threshold)...")

.jaccard <- function(a, b) {
  length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
}

.overlap_fraction <- function(a, b) {
  # Fraction of smaller set contained in larger
  length(intersect(a, b)) / min(length(a), length(b))
}

# Sort by size (largest first) for greedy merging
unique_complexes <- unique_complexes %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(grown_size))

# Greedy merge
merged_complexes <- list()
used <- rep(FALSE, nrow(unique_complexes))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(unique_complexes))) {
  if (used[i]) next
  
  current <- unique_complexes$grown_members[[i]]
  current_seeds <- c(unique_complexes$n_trimer_seeds[i], unique_complexes$n_tetramer_seeds[i])
  
  # Find all complexes with >80% overlap
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(unique_complexes))) {
    if (i == j || used[j]) next
    
    other <- unique_complexes$grown_members[[j]]
    overlap <- .overlap_fraction(current, other)
    
    if (overlap >= 0.8) {
      # Merge: take union of members
      current <- union(current, other)
      current_seeds <- current_seeds + c(unique_complexes$n_trimer_seeds[j], unique_complexes$n_tetramer_seeds[j])
      used[j] <- TRUE
    }
  }
  
  merged_complexes[[length(merged_complexes) + 1]] <- list(
    members = sort(current),
    size = length(current),
    n_trimer_seeds = current_seeds[1],
    n_tetramer_seeds = current_seeds[2]
  )
  used[i] <- TRUE
}

message("Complexes after merging: ", length(merged_complexes))


# --- Step 9: Convert to dataframe ---
complex_evidence <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(merged_complexes), function(i) {
  data.frame(
    complex_id = paste(merged_complexes[[i]]$members, collapse = "::"),
    complex_size = merged_complexes[[i]]$size,
    n_trimer_seeds = merged_complexes[[i]]$n_trimer_seeds,
    n_tetramer_seeds = merged_complexes[[i]]$n_tetramer_seeds,
    members = I(list(merged_complexes[[i]]$members)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

# Add complex index
complex_evidence <- complex_evidence %>%
  dplyr::mutate(complex_idx = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_idx, complex_id, complex_size, n_trimer_seeds, n_tetramer_seeds, members)

message("Final complex count: ", nrow(complex_evidence))


# --- Step 10: Size distribution ---
size_dist <- complex_evidence %>%
  dplyr::count(complex_size, name = "n_complexes") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(complex_size)

message("\nComplex size distribution:")
print(size_dist)


# --- Step 11: ComplexPortal validation ---
message("\nValidating complexes against ComplexPortal...")

.check_complex_match_any <- function(members, complex_to_proteins, gene_to_uniprot) {
  # Convert genes to UniProt
  uniprots <- gene_to_uniprot$uniprot[match(members, gene_to_uniprot$gene)]
  uniprots <- uniprots[!is.na(uniprots)]
  
  if (length(uniprots) == 0) return(list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_character_, match_fraction = 0))
  
  best_match <- list(strict = FALSE, relaxed = FALSE, complex_id = NA_character_, match_fraction = 0)
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(complex_to_proteins))) {
    complex_proteins <- complex_to_proteins$proteins[[i]]
    n_match <- sum(uniprots %in% complex_proteins)
    match_frac <- n_match / length(uniprots)
    
    if (match_frac > best_match$match_fraction) {
      best_match$match_fraction <- match_frac
      best_match$complex_id <- complex_to_proteins$complex_id[i]
      best_match$strict <- (n_match == length(uniprots) && n_match == length(complex_proteins))
      best_match$relaxed <- (match_frac >= 0.5)
    }
  }
  
  return(best_match)
}

complex_evidence <- complex_evidence %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cp_match = list(.check_complex_match_any(members, complex_to_proteins, gene_to_uniprot)),
    complexportal_strict = cp_match$strict,
    complexportal_relaxed = cp_match$relaxed,
    complexportal_id = cp_match$complex_id,
    complexportal_match_fraction = cp_match$match_fraction
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-cp_match) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

message("Complexes with strict ComplexPortal match: ", sum(complex_evidence$complexportal_strict))
message("Complexes with relaxed ComplexPortal match (>=50%): ", sum(complex_evidence$complexportal_relaxed))


# --- Step 12: Assign shared organelle ---
message("Assigning shared organelle annotations...")

.shared_organelles_complex <- function(members, lookup) {
  org_lists <- lapply(members, function(g) {
    idx <- which(lookup$Genes == g)
    if (length(idx) == 0) return(character(0))
    lookup$organelles[[idx]]
  })
  
  # Find intersection of all
  if (length(org_lists) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  
  shared <- Reduce(intersect, org_lists)
  if (length(shared) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  return(paste(shared, collapse = ";"))
}

complex_evidence <- complex_evidence %>%
```

### Complex Scoring: Add metrics and organelle analysis
```{r}
# =================================================
# Complex Scoring: Add metrics and organelle analysis
# =================================================

# --- Step 1: Get all edges for each complex ---
message("Computing edge-level scores for complexes...")

.get_complex_edges <- function(members, edge_scores) {
  # Generate all pairwise combinations
  if (length(members) < 2) return(data.frame())
  
  pairs <- combn(members, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  
  edges <- lapply(pairs, function(p) {
    key <- .get_edge_key(p[1], p[2])
    edge_scores %>% dplyr::filter(edge_key == key)
  })
  
  dplyr::bind_rows(edges)
}

# Compute scores per complex
complex_evidence <- complex_evidence %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    edge_data = list(.get_complex_edges(members, edge_scores)),
    n_edges = nrow(edge_data),
    n_edges_with_ipTM = sum(!is.na(edge_data$ipTM_max)),
    mean_AFMprob = if (nrow(edge_data) > 0) mean(edge_data$AFMprob, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    min_AFMprob = if (nrow(edge_data) > 0) safe_min(edge_data$AFMprob) else NA_real_,
    mean_RFprob = if (nrow(edge_data) > 0) mean(edge_data$RFprob, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    min_RFprob = if (nrow(edge_data) > 0) safe_min(edge_data$RFprob) else NA_real_,
    mean_ipTM = if (n_edges_with_ipTM > 0) mean(edge_data$ipTM_max, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    min_ipTM = if (n_edges_with_ipTM > 0) safe_min(edge_data$ipTM_max) else NA_real_,
    pct_edges_with_ipTM = if (n_edges > 0) round(100 * n_edges_with_ipTM / n_edges, 1) else 0,
    high_interface_quality = !is.na(mean_ipTM) & mean_ipTM >= 0.7
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-edge_data) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

message("Edge scores computed.")


# --- Step 2: Dominant organelles (>50% of members) ---
message("Computing dominant organelles...")

.get_dominant_organelles <- function(members, lookup, threshold = 0.5) {
  n_members <- length(members)
  if (n_members == 0) return(NA_character_)
  
  # Count organelle occurrences
  all_orgs <- unlist(lapply(members, function(g) {
    idx <- which(lookup$Genes == g)
    if (length(idx) == 0) return(character(0))
    lookup$organelles[[idx]]
  }))
  
  if (length(all_orgs) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  
  org_counts <- table(all_orgs)
  org_fracs <- org_counts / n_members
  
  # Keep those above threshold
  dominant <- names(org_fracs)[org_fracs >= threshold]
  
  if (length(dominant) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  return(paste(sort(dominant), collapse = ";"))
}

complex_evidence <- complex_evidence %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dominant_organelles = .get_dominant_organelles(members, gene_to_organelles, threshold = 0.5)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

message("Complexes with dominant organelle(s): ", sum(!is.na(complex_evidence$dominant_organelles)))


# --- Step 3: Origin classification ---
complex_evidence <- complex_evidence %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    origin = dplyr::case_when(
      n_trimer_seeds > 0 & n_tetramer_seeds > 0 ~ "both",
      n_trimer_seeds > 0 ~ "trimer_only",
      n_tetramer_seeds > 0 ~ "tetramer_only",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    )
  )

origin_summary <- complex_evidence %>% dplyr::count(origin)
message("\nComplex origin:")
print(origin_summary)


# --- Step 4: Quality score for complexes ---
complex_evidence <- complex_evidence %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    quality_A = min_AFMprob,
    quality_B = mean_AFMprob * ifelse(is.na(mean_ipTM), 1, mean_ipTM),
    quality_C = min_AFMprob * ifelse(is.na(min_ipTM), 1, min_ipTM)
  )


# --- Step 5: Update summary stats ---
complex_stats_updated <- data.frame(
  metric = c(
    "total_complexes",
    "complexes_size_3",
    "complexes_size_4",
    "complexes_size_5_10",
    "complexes_size_11_plus",
    "max_complex_size",
    "median_complex_size",
    "complexes_with_dominant_organelle",
    "complexes_high_interface_quality",
    "complexes_from_trimer_only",
    "complexes_from_tetramer_only",
    "complexes_from_both",
    "complexes_complexportal_strict",
    "complexes_complexportal_relaxed",
    "median_mean_AFMprob",
    "median_mean_ipTM"
  ),
  value = c(
    nrow(complex_evidence),
    sum(complex_evidence$complex_size == 3),
    sum(complex_evidence$complex_size == 4),
    sum(complex_evidence$complex_size >= 5 & complex_evidence$complex_size <= 10),
    sum(complex_evidence$complex_size >= 11),
    max(complex_evidence$complex_size),
    median(complex_evidence$complex_size),
    sum(!is.na(complex_evidence$dominant_organelles)),
    sum(complex_evidence$high_interface_quality, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(complex_evidence$origin == "trimer_only"),
    sum(complex_evidence$origin == "tetramer_only"),
    sum(complex_evidence$origin == "both"),
    sum(complex_evidence$complexportal_strict),
    sum(complex_evidence$complexportal_relaxed),
    round(median(complex_evidence$mean_AFMprob, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    round(median(complex_evidence$mean_ipTM, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

message("\n=== Updated Complex Summary ===")
print(complex_stats_updated)


# --- Step 6: Save updated evidence ---
complex_evidence_flat <- complex_evidence %>%
  dplyr::mutate(members_str = sapply(members, paste, collapse = ";")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-members)

readr::write_csv(complex_evidence_flat, file.path(out_dir_complex, "tables", "complex_evidence.csv"))
readr::write_csv(complex_stats_updated, file.path(out_dir_complex, "tables", "complex_stats.csv"))
saveRDS(complex_evidence, file.path(out_dir_complex, "tables", "complex_evidence.rds"))

message("Updated complex evidence saved.")
```

```{r}
# =================================================
# QC: Trimer and Tetramer enrichment per organelle
# =================================================

# --- PPIs per organelle (from baseline) ---
ppi_per_org <- shared_long_baseline %>%
  dplyr::count(tag, name = "n_ppi")

# --- Trimers per organelle ---
trimer_per_org <- trimer_evidence %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(shared_organelle)) %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(shared_organelle, sep = ";") %>%
  dplyr::count(shared_organelle, name = "n_trimers") %>%
  dplyr::rename(tag = shared_organelle)

# --- Tetramers per organelle ---
tetramer_per_org <- tetramer_evidence %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(shared_organelle)) %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(shared_organelle, sep = ";") %>%
  dplyr::count(shared_organelle, name = "n_tetramers") %>%
  dplyr::rename(tag = shared_organelle)

# --- Combine and compute ratios ---
organelle_enrichment <- ppi_per_org %>%
  dplyr::left_join(trimer_per_org, by = "tag") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(tetramer_per_org, by = "tag") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_trimers = tidyr::replace_na(n_trimers, 0),
    n_tetramers = tidyr::replace_na(n_tetramers, 0),
    trimer_per_ppi = round(n_trimers / n_ppi, 4),
    tetramer_per_ppi = round(n_tetramers / n_ppi, 4)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(trimer_per_ppi))

message("\n=== Organelle Enrichment ===")
```
