### Network plots of Complex
```{r}
# Network plots for complexes
library(igraph)
library(tidyverse)

# Create output directory
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "complexes", "network_plots"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Filter complexes ≤50 members
complexes_to_plot <- complex_evidence %>% filter(complex_size <= 50)

# AFMprob color palette (light blue to dark blue)
afm_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("#E3F2FD", "#90CAF9", "#1976D2", "#0D47A1"))(100)

# Loop through complexes
for (i in seq_len(nrow(complexes_to_plot))) {
  cx <- complexes_to_plot[i, ]
  members <- cx$members[[1]]
  
  # Filter PPIs to edges within this complex
  edges <- master_ppi %>%
    filter(Gene1 %in% members & Gene2 %in% members) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2, AFMprob, RFprob)
  
  if (nrow(edges) == 0) next
  
  # Build igraph object
  g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, directed = FALSE, vertices = data.frame(name = members))
  
  # Layout: circle for small, FR for larger
  if (cx$complex_size <= 15) {
    layout <- layout_in_circle(g)
  } else {
    layout <- layout_with_fr(g)
  }
  
  # Edge color from AFMprob
  afm_idx <- pmax(1, pmin(100, round(E(g)$AFMprob * 100)))
  edge_colors <- afm_palette[afm_idx]
  
  # Edge width from RFprob
  edge_widths <- scales::rescale(E(g)$RFprob, to = c(0.5, 4))
  
  # ComplexPortal status for title

  cp_status <- case_when(
    cx$complexportal_strict ~ "ComplexPortal: strict match",
    cx$complexportal_relaxed ~ "ComplexPortal: relaxed match",
    TRUE ~ "ComplexPortal: no match"
  )
  
  plot_title <- paste0(cx$complex_id, "\n", "Size: ", cx$complex_size, " | ", cp_status)
  
  # Output PDF
  pdf_path_complexes <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_dual, "complexes", "network_plots", paste0(sprintf("%03d", cx$complex_idx), "_", gsub("::", "_", substr(cx$complex_id, 1, 30)), ".pdf"))
  pdf(pdf_path_complexes, width = 8, height = 8)
  
  par(mar = c(1, 1, 3, 1))
  plot(g, layout = layout, vertex.size = 8, vertex.label.cex = 0.5, vertex.color = "grey80", vertex.frame.color = NA, edge.color = edge_colors, edge.width = edge_widths, main = plot_title)
  
  # Legends
  legend("bottomleft", legend = c("AFMprob: 0", "0.5", "1"), col = afm_palette[c(1, 50, 100)], lwd = 3, bty = "n", cex = 0.7, title = "Edge color")
  legend("bottomright", legend = c("RFprob: low", "high"), lwd = c(0.5, 4), col = "gray50", bty = "n", cex = 0.7, title = "Edge width")
  
  dev.off()
}

message("Done. Generated ", nrow(complexes_to_plot), " network plots.")
```



# KO x Neuron PPI Vulnerability Analysis
```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Purpose: Analyze PPI/trimer/tetramer/complex vulnerability across 23 LSD KOs
# Input: Dual-evidence baseline PPIs (gold+silver), proteome log2FC data
# Output: Vulnerability plots, heatmaps, ternary plots, source data CSVs
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Module 0: Setup and Configuration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggtern)  # for ternary plots
library(scales)
library(igraph)

# --- Configuration ---
drop_thresh <- -0.5    # PPI lost if either partner log2FC < this
conf_tiers_use <- c("gold", "silver")  # exclude bronze for vulnerability analysis

# Disease class color palette (consistent across all plots)
disease_class_palette <- c(
  Sphingolipidoses = "#D53E4F",
  Mucopolysaccharidoses = "#F46D43",
  Glycoproteinoses = "#FDAE61",
  Neuronal.ceroid.lipofuscinoses = "#FEE08B",
  Integral.membrane.protein.disorders = "#E6F598",
  PTM.defects = "#ABDDA4",
  Lipid.storage.diseases = "#66C2A5"
)

# Neuron type palette
neuron_palette <- c(iN = "#7570B3", iDA = "#D95F02")

# Organelle annotation tags (for vulnerability analysis)
organelle_tags <- c(
  "Mito", "MitoIMS", "MitoMatrix", "MitoMIM", "MitoMOM", "OXPHOS",
  "mtComplexI", "Golgi", "Lysosome", "ER", "Cytoplasm", "Nucleus",
  "Autophagy", "SynGO", "Endo_iN_curated_Hundley", "SynapseSVs",
  "Presynaptic", "Postsynaptic", "EndoLyso", "EarlyEndosome",
  "RecyclingEndosome", "SVfusion", "Svendocytosis", "Svexocytosis", "vATPase"
)

# Generate organelle color palette
n_orgs <- length(organelle_tags)
organelle_colors <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Set3"))(n_orgs),
  organelle_tags
)

# --- Directory Setup ---
out_dir_vuln <- file.path(out_dir_PPI, "KOxNeuron_eval")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_vuln, "plots/global"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_vuln, "plots/by_ko"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_vuln, "plots/ternary"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_vuln, "plots/disease_class"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_vuln, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_vuln, "sourcedata"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Helper Functions ---

# Save plot with accompanying source data CSV
save_plot_with_sourcedata <- function(plot, filename, data, width = 6, height = 5, ...) {
  # Save PDF
  pdf_path <- file.path(out_dir_vuln, paste0(filename, ".pdf"))
  ggsave(pdf_path, plot, width = width, height = height, device = cairo_pdf, ...)


  # Save source data CSV
  csv_path <- file.path(out_dir_vuln, "sourcedata", paste0(filename, "_sourcedata.csv"))
  write_csv(data, csv_path)

  message("Saved: ", basename(pdf_path), " + sourcedata")
  invisible(list(pdf = pdf_path, csv = csv_path))
}

# Create undirected PPI key
make_undirected_key <- function(a, b) {
  ifelse(a <= b, paste(a, b, sep = "::"), paste(b, a, sep = "::"))
}

# Identify shared organelle for a PPI edge
get_shared_organelles <- function(df, org_tags) {
  # df must have columns like Mito_prot1, Mito_prot2, etc.
  shared <- character(nrow(df))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
    matches <- c()
    for (tag in org_tags) {
      p1_col <- paste0(tag, "_prot1")
      p2_col <- paste0(tag, "_prot2")
      if (p1_col %in% names(df) && p2_col %in% names(df)) {
        v1 <- df[[p1_col]][i]
        v2 <- df[[p2_col]][i]
        if (!is.na(v1) && !is.na(v2) && v1 == TRUE && v2 == TRUE) {
          matches <- c(matches, tag)
        }
      }
    }
    shared[i] <- if (length(matches) > 0) paste(matches, collapse = ",") else NA_character_
  }
  shared
}


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Module 1: Build KO Edge States Table
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Purpose: For each PPI edge (gold+silver), determine state per KO x neuron
# State: "lost" if either partner log2FC < drop_thresh, else "retained"
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

message("Building KO edge states table...")

# Filter baseline PPIs to gold + silver only
baseline_filtered <- baseline_ppi %>%
  dplyr::filter(confidence_tier %in% conf_tiers_use)

message("  Baseline PPIs (gold+silver): ", nrow(baseline_filtered))

# Parse proteome data to long format
# Column pattern: {KO}_{neuron}_log2_fold_change
prot_cols <- names(complete_data_annotated_day50)[grepl("_log2_fold_change$", names(complete_data_annotated_day50))]

prot_long <- complete_data_annotated_day50 %>%
  dplyr::select(Genes, all_of(prot_cols)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Genes, names_to = "sample_col", values_to = "log2FC") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Extract genotype and neuron from column name
    genotype = sub("^(.+)_(iN|iDA)_log2_fold_change$", "\\1", sample_col),
    neuron = sub("^.+_(iN|iDA)_log2_fold_change$", "\\1", sample_col),
    genotype_neuron = paste(genotype, neuron, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Genes, genotype, neuron, genotype_neuron, log2FC)

# Get unique KO x neuron combinations
ko_neuron_grid <- prot_long %>%
  dplyr::distinct(genotype, neuron, genotype_neuron)

message("  KO x Neuron combinations: ", nrow(ko_neuron_grid))

# Expand baseline edges to all KO x neuron contexts
baseline_expanded <- baseline_filtered %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dummy = 1) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(ko_neuron_grid %>% mutate(dummy = 1), by = "dummy", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  dplyr::select(-dummy)

# Join log2FC for both partners
ko_edge_states <- baseline_expanded %>%
  dplyr::left_join(prot_long %>% dplyr::select(Genes, genotype, neuron, log2FC),
                   by = c("Gene1" = "Genes", "genotype", "neuron")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(log2FC_A = log2FC) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(prot_long %>% dplyr::select(Genes, genotype, neuron, log2FC),
                   by = c("Gene2" = "Genes", "genotype", "neuron")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(log2FC_B = log2FC) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # PPI state: lost if either partner below threshold
    state = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(log2FC_A) & log2FC_A < drop_thresh ~ "lost",
      !is.na(log2FC_B) & log2FC_B < drop_thresh ~ "lost",
      !is.na(log2FC_A) | !is.na(log2FC_B) ~ "retained",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    )
  )

# Add disease class mapping
disease_map <- disease_class_df %>%
  dplyr::distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE)

ko_edge_states <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("genotype_neuron" = "sample"))

# Add shared organelle information (vectorized for speed)
message("  Computing shared organelle annotations...")
org1_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot1")
org2_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot2")
existing_org1 <- intersect(org1_cols, names(ko_edge_states))
existing_org2 <- intersect(org2_cols, names(ko_edge_states))

if (length(existing_org1) > 0 && length(existing_org2) > 0) {
  existing_tags <- sub("_prot1$", "", existing_org1)

  # Vectorized shared organelle computation
  m1 <- as.matrix(ko_edge_states[, existing_org1])
  m2 <- as.matrix(ko_edge_states[, existing_org2])
  m1[is.na(m1)] <- FALSE
  m2[is.na(m2)] <- FALSE
  shared_mat <- m1 & m2

  # Any shared = "same", else "cross"
  ko_edge_states$OrgPair <- ifelse(rowSums(shared_mat) > 0, "same", "cross")

  # Get first shared organelle for annotation-level analysis
  ko_edge_states$shared_organelle <- apply(shared_mat, 1, function(row) {
    idx <- which(row)
    if (length(idx) > 0) existing_tags[idx[1]] else NA_character_
  })
} else {
  ko_edge_states$OrgPair <- NA_character_
  ko_edge_states$shared_organelle <- NA_character_
}

# Save KO edge states table
write_csv(ko_edge_states, file.path(out_dir_vuln, "tables", "ko_edge_states.csv"))
message("  Saved: ko_edge_states.csv (", nrow(ko_edge_states), " rows)")


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Module 1b: Summary Statistics Tables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Per KO x Neuron summary
ko_summary_global <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, genotype_neuron, DiseaseClass) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_edges = n(),
    n_lost = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_retained = sum(state == "retained", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_unknown = sum(state == "unknown", na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_lost = n_lost / total_edges,
    frac_retained = n_retained / total_edges,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(ko_summary_global, file.path(out_dir_vuln, "tables", "ko_summary_global.csv"))

# Per KO x Neuron x Organelle summary
ko_summary_by_organelle <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::filter(OrgPair == "same", !is.na(shared_organelle)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, genotype_neuron, DiseaseClass, shared_organelle) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_edges = n(),
    n_lost = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_lost = n_lost / n_edges,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(ko_summary_by_organelle, file.path(out_dir_vuln, "tables", "ko_summary_by_organelle.csv"))

message("Module 1 complete: KO edge states table built")


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Module 2: PPI Vulnerability Visualizations
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

message("Generating PPI vulnerability visualizations...")

# --- 2.1 Stacked Barplot: Lost/Retained per KO x Neuron (absolute counts) ---
plot_data_2_1 <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, state) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(state = factor(state, levels = c("retained", "lost", "unknown")))

p_2_1 <- ggplot(plot_data_2_1, aes(x = genotype, y = n, fill = state)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~neuron, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(retained = "grey80", lost = "#C51B7D", unknown = "grey50")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of PPI edges", title = "PPI edge states per KO (absolute)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

save_plot_with_sourcedata(p_2_1, "plots/global/barplot_ppi_states_absolute", plot_data_2_1, width = 10, height = 8)


# --- 2.2 Stacked Barplot: Lost/Retained per KO x Neuron (percentage) ---
plot_data_2_2 <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, state) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(state = factor(state, levels = c("retained", "lost", "unknown")))

p_2_2 <- ggplot(plot_data_2_2, aes(x = genotype, y = pct, fill = state)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~neuron, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(retained = "grey80", lost = "#C51B7D", unknown = "grey50")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Percentage of PPI edges", title = "PPI edge states per KO (percentage)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

save_plot_with_sourcedata(p_2_2, "plots/global/barplot_ppi_states_percentage", plot_data_2_2, width = 10, height = 8)


# --- 2.3 Global Heatmap: KO x KO correlation based on PPI loss pattern ---
make_ko_correlation_heatmap <- function(df_states, neuron_filter, suffix) {

  lost_df <- df_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == neuron_filter) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(genotype, key, lost = as.integer(state == "lost"))

  if (nrow(lost_df) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

  lost_wide <- tidyr::pivot_wider(lost_df, names_from = key, values_from = lost, values_fill = 0)
  lost_mat <- as.data.frame(lost_wide)
  rownames(lost_mat) <- lost_mat$genotype
  lost_mat$genotype <- NULL

  if (nrow(lost_mat) < 2 || ncol(lost_mat) < 2) return(invisible(NULL))

  rho <- cor(t(as.matrix(lost_mat)), method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

  # Annotation for disease class
  annotation_df <- data.frame(genotype = rownames(rho), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(disease_map %>% mutate(genotype = sub("_(iN|iDA)$", "", sample)), by = "genotype") %>%
    dplyr::distinct(genotype, .keep_all = TRUE)
  rownames(annotation_df) <- annotation_df$genotype
  annotation_df <- annotation_df %>% dplyr::select(DiseaseClass)

  ann_colors <- list(DiseaseClass = disease_class_palette[intersect(names(disease_class_palette), unique(na.omit(annotation_df$DiseaseClass)))])

  # Save source data
  write_csv(as.data.frame(rho) %>% rownames_to_column("genotype"),
            file.path(out_dir_vuln, "sourcedata", paste0("heatmap_ko_corr_", suffix, "_sourcedata.csv")))

  pheatmap(
    mat = rho,
    color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(101),
    breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 102),
    clustering_distance_rows = as.dist(1 - rho),
    clustering_distance_cols = as.dist(1 - rho),
    clustering_method = "ward.D2",
    annotation_col = annotation_df,
    annotation_row = annotation_df,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors,
    main = paste0("KO x KO correlation (", neuron_filter, ")"),
    fontsize = 7,
    cellwidth = 12, cellheight = 12,
    border_color = NA,
    filename = file.path(out_dir_vuln, paste0("plots/global/heatmap_ko_corr_", suffix, ".pdf")),
    width = 10, height = 9

  )
  message("  Saved: heatmap_ko_corr_", suffix, ".pdf")
}

make_ko_correlation_heatmap(ko_edge_states, "iN", "iN")
make_ko_correlation_heatmap(ko_edge_states, "iDA", "iDA")


# --- 2.4 Combined iN + iDA correlation heatmap ---
lost_long_combined <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lost = as.integer(state == "lost")) %>%
  dplyr::select(genotype_neuron, genotype, neuron, key, lost)

lost_wide_combined <- tidyr::pivot_wider(lost_long_combined, names_from = key, values_from = lost, values_fill = 0)

rn_comb <- lost_wide_combined$genotype_neuron
X_comb <- as.matrix(lost_wide_combined[, setdiff(names(lost_wide_combined), c("genotype_neuron", "genotype", "neuron"))])
rownames(X_comb) <- rn_comb

if (nrow(X_comb) >= 2 && ncol(X_comb) >= 2) {
  rho_comb <- cor(t(X_comb), method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

  annotation_comb <- data.frame(genotype_neuron = rownames(rho_comb), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(neuron = sub("^.+_", "", genotype_neuron)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("genotype_neuron" = "sample"))
  rownames(annotation_comb) <- annotation_comb$genotype_neuron
  annotation_comb <- annotation_comb %>% dplyr::select(neuron, DiseaseClass)

  ann_colors_comb <- list(
    neuron = neuron_palette,
    DiseaseClass = disease_class_palette[intersect(names(disease_class_palette), unique(na.omit(annotation_comb$DiseaseClass)))]
  )

  write_csv(as.data.frame(rho_comb) %>% rownames_to_column("genotype_neuron"),
            file.path(out_dir_vuln, "sourcedata", "heatmap_ko_corr_combined_sourcedata.csv"))

  pheatmap(
    mat = rho_comb,
    color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(101),
    breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 102),
    clustering_distance_rows = as.dist(1 - rho_comb),
    clustering_distance_cols = as.dist(1 - rho_comb),
    clustering_method = "ward.D2",
    annotation_col = annotation_comb,
    annotation_row = annotation_comb,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors_comb,
    main = "KO x KO correlation (combined iN + iDA)",
    fontsize = 5,
    cellwidth = 8, cellheight = 8,
    border_color = NA,
    filename = file.path(out_dir_vuln, "plots/global/heatmap_ko_corr_combined.pdf"),
    width = 14, height = 13
  )
  message("  Saved: heatmap_ko_corr_combined.pdf")
}


# --- 2.5 Heatmap: Lost PPIs per annotation (organelle x KO) ---
make_organelle_ko_heatmap <- function(df_summary, neuron_filter, suffix) {

  hm_data <- df_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == neuron_filter) %>%
    dplyr::select(genotype, shared_organelle, frac_lost) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = shared_organelle, values_from = frac_lost, values_fill = NA)

  if (nrow(hm_data) < 2) return(invisible(NULL))

  hm_mat <- as.matrix(hm_data[, -1])
  rownames(hm_mat) <- hm_data$genotype

  # Annotation
  annotation_row <- data.frame(genotype = rownames(hm_mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(disease_map %>% mutate(genotype = sub("_(iN|iDA)$", "", sample)), by = "genotype") %>%
    dplyr::distinct(genotype, .keep_all = TRUE)
  rownames(annotation_row) <- annotation_row$genotype
  annotation_row <- annotation_row %>% dplyr::select(DiseaseClass)

  ann_colors <- list(DiseaseClass = disease_class_palette[intersect(names(disease_class_palette), unique(na.omit(annotation_row$DiseaseClass)))])

  write_csv(hm_data, file.path(out_dir_vuln, "sourcedata", paste0("heatmap_organelle_ko_", suffix, "_sourcedata.csv")))

  pheatmap(
    mat = hm_mat,
    color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#FEE0D2", "#FC9272", "#DE2D26"))(50),
    na_col = "grey95",
    cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
    clustering_method = "ward.D2",
    annotation_row = annotation_row,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors,
    main = paste0("Fraction PPIs lost by organelle (", neuron_filter, ")"),
    fontsize = 7,
    cellwidth = 14, cellheight = 10,
    border_color = "grey80",
    filename = file.path(out_dir_vuln, paste0("plots/global/heatmap_organelle_ko_", suffix, ".pdf")),
    width = 12, height = 10
  )
  message("  Saved: heatmap_organelle_ko_", suffix, ".pdf")
}

make_organelle_ko_heatmap(ko_summary_by_organelle, "iN", "iN")
make_organelle_ko_heatmap(ko_summary_by_organelle, "iDA", "iDA")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Module 3: Trimer Vulnerability Analysis
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Purpose: Determine which trimers are disrupted per KO x neuron
# A trimer is "disrupted" if any of its 3 edges is lost (any member log2FC < thresh)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

message("Analyzing trimer vulnerability...")

# Get trimer members and their genes
trimer_genes <- trimer_evidence %>%
  dplyr::select(trimer_id, Gene1, Gene2, Gene3, tier_composition, shared_organelle,
                complexportal_strict, complexportal_relaxed, quality_C)

# For each trimer, check if any member is below threshold
trimer_vuln_list <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(ko_neuron_grid))) {
  geno <- ko_neuron_grid$genotype[i]
  neur <- ko_neuron_grid$neuron[i]
  gn <- ko_neuron_grid$genotype_neuron[i]

  # Get log2FC for this KO x neuron
  fc_data <- prot_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype == geno, neuron == neur) %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, log2FC)

  # Check each trimer
  trimer_status <- trimer_genes %>%
    dplyr::left_join(fc_data, by = c("Gene1" = "Genes")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(fc1 = log2FC) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(fc_data, by = c("Gene2" = "Genes")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(fc2 = log2FC) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(fc_data, by = c("Gene3" = "Genes")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(fc3 = log2FC) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      genotype = geno,
      neuron = neur,
      genotype_neuron = gn,
      n_affected = (fc1 < drop_thresh) + (fc2 < drop_thresh) + (fc3 < drop_thresh),
      n_affected = replace_na(n_affected, 0),
      state = dplyr::case_when(
        n_affected >= 1 ~ "disrupted",
        TRUE ~ "intact"
      )
    )

  trimer_vuln_list[[i]] <- trimer_status
}

trimer_ko_states <- dplyr::bind_rows(trimer_vuln_list)

# Add disease class
trimer_ko_states <- trimer_ko_states %>%
  dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("genotype_neuron" = "sample"))

write_csv(trimer_ko_states, file.path(out_dir_vuln, "tables", "trimer_ko_states.csv"))
message("  Saved: trimer_ko_states.csv")

trimer_summary_ko <- trimer_ko_states %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, genotype_neuron, DiseaseClass) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_trimers = n(),
    n_disrupted = sum(state == "disrupted"),
    frac_disrupted = n_disrupted / total_trimers,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(trimer_summary_ko, file.path(out_dir_vuln, "tables", "trimer_summary_ko.csv"))

p_3_2 <- ggplot(plot_data_3_2, aes(x = genotype, y = n, fill = state)) +

# Module 5: Complex Vulnerability Analysis

message("Analyzing complex vulnerability...")

# Parse complex members
# Note: complex_evidence$members is a list column containing character vectors of gene names
complex_members_parsed <- complex_evidence %>%
  dplyr::mutate(members_list = members) %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_idx, complex_id, complex_size, origin, dominant_organelles,
                complexportal_strict, complexportal_relaxed, quality_C, members_list)

complex_vuln_list <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(ko_neuron_grid))) {
  geno <- ko_neuron_grid$genotype[i]
  neur <- ko_neuron_grid$neuron[i]
  gn <- ko_neuron_grid$genotype_neuron[i]

  fc_data <- prot_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype == geno, neuron == neur) %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, log2FC) %>%
    tibble::deframe()

  # For each complex, count affected members
  complex_status <- complex_members_parsed %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_members = length(members_list),
      n_affected = sum(fc_data[members_list] < drop_thresh, na.rm = TRUE),
      frac_affected = n_affected / n_members,
      # Complex disrupted if >= 25% members affected (or at least 1 for small complexes)
      state = dplyr::case_when(
        n_members <= 4 & n_affected >= 1 ~ "disrupted",
        n_members > 4 & frac_affected >= 0.25 ~ "disrupted",
        TRUE ~ "intact"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      genotype = geno,
      neuron = neur,
      genotype_neuron = gn
    )

  complex_vuln_list[[i]] <- complex_status
}

complex_ko_states <- dplyr::bind_rows(complex_vuln_list) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("genotype_neuron" = "sample"))

# Remove list column for CSV export
complex_ko_states_export <- complex_ko_states %>%
  dplyr::select(-members_list)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Module 6: Ternary Plots
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Purpose: Visualize PPI loss distribution across 3 annotation categories
# Creates both user-selected triplets and all possible combinations
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

message("Generating ternary plots...")

# Prepare data for ternary plots: need PPI loss counts per organelle per KO x neuron
# Use ko_summary_by_organelle which has: genotype, neuron, shared_organelle, n_lost

# Function to create ternary plot for a given triplet
make_ternary_plot <- function(df_org_summary, org1, org2, org3, neuron_filter = NULL, dc_filter = NULL) {

  # Filter data
  tern_data <- df_org_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(shared_organelle %in% c(org1, org2, org3))

  if (!is.null(neuron_filter)) {
    tern_data <- tern_data %>% dplyr::filter(neuron == neuron_filter)
  }

  if (!is.null(dc_filter)) {
    tern_data <- tern_data %>% dplyr::filter(DiseaseClass == dc_filter)
  }

  if (nrow(tern_data) == 0) return(NULL)

  # Pivot to wide format with 3 columns for the triplet
  tern_wide <- tern_data %>%
    dplyr::select(genotype, neuron, DiseaseClass, shared_organelle, n_lost) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = shared_organelle, values_from = n_lost, values_fill = 0)

  # Check if all three organelles exist
  if (!all(c(org1, org2, org3) %in% names(tern_wide))) return(NULL)

  # Normalize to fractions
  tern_wide <- tern_wide %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      total = .data[[org1]] + .data[[org2]] + .data[[org3]],
      f1 = .data[[org1]] / total,
      f2 = .data[[org2]] / total,
      f3 = .data[[org3]] / total
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(total > 0)  # exclude rows with no loss in any category

  if (nrow(tern_wide) == 0) return(NULL)

  # Rename for ggtern
  names(tern_wide)[names(tern_wide) == "f1"] <- org1
  names(tern_wide)[names(tern_wide) == "f2"] <- org2
  names(tern_wide)[names(tern_wide) == "f3"] <- org3

  # Create ternary plot
  p <- ggtern(tern_wide, aes_string(x = org1, y = org2, z = org3)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = DiseaseClass, size = total), shape = 21, stroke = 0.4, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = genotype), size = 2, vjust = -0.8, check_overlap = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = disease_class_palette) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8), name = "Total lost") +
    labs(title = paste0("PPI loss: ", org1, " / ", org2, " / ", org3,
                        ifelse(!is.null(neuron_filter), paste0(" (", neuron_filter, ")"), ""),
                        ifelse(!is.null(dc_filter), paste0(" - ", dc_filter), ""))) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
    theme_showarrows() +
    theme(legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"))

  return(list(plot = p, data = tern_wide))
}

# --- 6.1 User-selected priority triplet: Mito / Endo_iN_curated_Hundley / SynapseSVs ---
priority_triplet <- c("Mito", "Endo_iN_curated_Hundley", "SynapseSVs")

    filename <- paste0("plots/ternary/ternary_", paste(priority_triplet, collapse = "_"), "_", nt)
    save_plot_with_sourcedata(result$plot, filename, result$data, width = 8, height = 7)
  }
}

for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {
  for (dc in unique(na.omit(ko_summary_by_organelle$DiseaseClass))) {
    result <- make_ternary_plot(ko_summary_by_organelle, priority_triplet[1], priority_triplet[2], priority_triplet[3],
                                 neuron_filter = nt, dc_filter = dc)
    if (!is.null(result)) {

}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Module 9: User-Defined Ternary Plot Function
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Purpose: Provide function for user to create custom ternary plots
# Usage: plot_custom_ternary(c("Mito", "Lysosome", "SynGO"), neuron = "iDA")
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

#' Create custom ternary plot for user-specified organelle triplet
#'
#' @param triplet Character vector of 3 organelle names
#' @param neuron "iN", "iDA", or NULL for both
#' @param disease_class Specific disease class or NULL for all
#' @param save_path Optional path to save plot
#' @return ggplot object
plot_custom_ternary <- function(triplet, neuron = NULL, disease_class = NULL, save_path = NULL) {

  if (length(triplet) != 3) stop("triplet must be exactly 3 organelle names")

  result <- make_ternary_plot(
    ko_summary_by_organelle,
    triplet[1], triplet[2], triplet[3],
    neuron_filter = neuron,
    dc_filter = disease_class
  )

  if (is.null(result)) {
    message("No data available for this triplet/filter combination")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(save_path, result$plot, width = 8, height = 7, device = cairo_pdf)
    # Also save source data
    csv_path <- sub("\\.pdf$", "_sourcedata.csv", save_path)
    write_csv(result$data, csv_path)
    message("Saved: ", basename(save_path))
  }

  return(result$plot)
}
```

# =================================================
# OLD Module 11: PPI Vulnerability Analysis - Neuronal nDIA
# =================================================


# PPI vulnerability pipeline in iN and iDA LSD mutants
Build a Protein–Protein Interaction (PPI) vulnerability and rewiring landscape for neuronal proteomes (iN and iDA) across 23 lysosomal KOs. The goal is to integrate experimental proteome shifts with predicted and experimentally validated interaction data (Predictome 80% and IntAct) to quantify network destabilization, organelle-specific vulnerabilities, and neuron-type–specific effects.

use of the Baker lab's Human interactome
https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2024.10.01.615885v1.full
and InterAct Database

# PPI input and merging of evidence
## Load Human Interactome & parse
```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 1.  Define Paths and input tables 
out_dir_ppi_vuln <- out_dir_PPI
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/global"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/by_ko"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "qc"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

path_predictome80 <- "/Users/felix/Desktop/ppi/final_predictions_80.tsv"
path_intact_tsv    <- "/Users/felix/Desktop/ppi/interact.tsv"

drop_thresh      <- -0.5    # partner considered dropped if log2FC < drop_thresh
gain_up_thresh   <-  0.5    # optional: partner considered gained if log2FC > gain_up_thresh
conf_bins        <- c(0, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 1)
org_min_n        <- 20
top_n_links      <- 3000


# reformat disease class list to dataframe
# disease_classes_dataframe <- stack(disease_classes)
# colnames(disease_classes_dataframe) <- c("sample", "DiseaseClass")
disease_classes_dataframe <- bind_rows(
  disease_class_df %>% mutate(sample = paste0(sample, "_iN")),
  disease_class_df %>% mutate(sample = paste0(sample, "_iDA"))
) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, DiseaseClass)


# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 2: Make helper Functions 
# Purpose: create a unique, order-independent identifier for each protein pair.
.make_undirected_key <- function(a, b) {
  ifelse(a <= b, paste(a, b, sep = "::"), paste(b, a, sep = "::"))
}

# Purpose: convert a continuous confidence score (0–1) into discrete bins.
.bin_conf <- function(x, bins) {
  cut(x, breaks = bins, include.lowest = TRUE, right = TRUE, labels = FALSE)
}


# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 3. load Predictome80 dataframe into environment 
predictome_raw <- data.table::fread(
  path_predictome80,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  skip = 28, 
  fill = TRUE,          # tolerate irregular number of fields
  quote = "",           # ignore quoted entries
  data.table = FALSE
)

# remove metadata rows (those starting with '#')
predictome_raw <- predictome_raw[!grepl("^#", predictome_raw$Protein1), ]

# define probability columns dynamically
prob_candidates <- c("RFprob","AFprob","AFMprob","CFprob","AFprob5")
prob_cols <- intersect(prob_candidates, names(predictome_raw))

# compute composite confidence score
predictome_edges <- predictome_raw %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(prob_cols), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x)))) %>%
  mutate(
    Predictome_conf = do.call(pmax, c(across(all_of(prob_cols)), list(na.rm = TRUE))),
    STRING = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(STRING)),
    key = .make_undirected_key(Protein1, Protein2),
    Predictome_present = TRUE
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    Protein1, Protein2, Name1, Name2,
    across(all_of(prob_cols)),
    Predictome_conf,
    STRING,
    confDBs,
    allDBs,
    Source,
    PDBtemp,
    Known1, Known2,
    Count1, Count2,
    Locality1, Locality2,
    Disease1, Disease2,
    Process1, Process2,
    Function1, Function2,
    Exact_templates, Ortho_templates, Homo_templates,
    key,
    Predictome_present
  ) %>%
  distinct(key, .keep_all = TRUE)

```


## Load InterAct & parse
use select experimental evidence and larger than 0.5 as threshold 
```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 4. Load IntAct (already filtered by your MI methods and MIscore >= 0.5 when exporting)
interact_raw <- data.table::fread(
  path_intact_tsv,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE,          # tolerate irregular number of fields
  quote = "",           # ignore quoted entries
  data.table = FALSE
)


colnames(interact_raw) <- trimws(gsub("^#", "", colnames(interact_raw)))

intact_edges <- interact_raw %>%
  transmute(
    Protein1 = sub("^uniprotkb:", "", sub("\\|.*$", "", `ID(s) interactor A`)),
    Protein2 = sub("^uniprotkb:", "", sub("\\|.*$", "", `ID(s) interactor B`)),
    DetectionMethod = gsub('psi-mi:|"', "", `Interaction detection method(s)`),
    IntAct_MIscore = {
      x <- `Confidence value(s)`
      x <- sub("^.*miscore:", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
    }
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    key = .make_undirected_key(Protein1, Protein2),
    IntAct_present = TRUE
  ) %>%
  distinct(key, .keep_all = TRUE)

```


## Merge PPIs and add subcell annotations
```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 5. Merge Predictome + IntAct into PPI_evidence dataframe
ppi_evidence <- full_join(
  predictome_edges %>% dplyr::select(key, Protein1, Protein2, Name1, Name2, RFprob, AFprob, AFMprob, Predictome_conf, Predictome_present, STRING, confDBs, allDBs),
  intact_edges     %>% dplyr::select(key, IntAct_present, IntAct_MIscore, DetectionMethod),
  by = "key"
) %>%
  mutate(
    Predictome_present = replace_na(Predictome_present, FALSE),
    IntAct_present     = replace_na(IntAct_present, FALSE),
    Overlap_flag       = Predictome_present & IntAct_present
  )

# save csv
write_csv(ppi_evidence,"/Users/felix/Documents/PostDoc/Harvard/03_LSD-PD/Proteomics/d50_diff132/day50/PPI/tables/ppi_evidence.csv")


# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 6. add subcellular annotations for each partner
# Build a UniProt -> Gene map from Predictome (Name1/Name2 are gene symbols)
map_uni_to_gene <- bind_rows(
  predictome_raw %>% dplyr::transmute(uni = Protein1, gene = Name1),
  predictome_raw %>% dplyr::transmute(uni = Protein2, gene = Name2)
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(uni), !is.na(gene), nzchar(uni), nzchar(gene)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(uni, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Add gene symbols for each partner
ppi_evidence <- ppi_evidence %>%
  dplyr::left_join(map_uni_to_gene, by = c("Protein1" = "uni")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Gene1 = gene) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(map_uni_to_gene, by = c("Protein2" = "uni")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Gene2 = gene)

# Step 6.1. add subcellular annotations using Gene1/Gene2 (to match binary_matrix$Genes nomenclature in df)
# expects binary_matrix with columns: Genes and organelle flags
organelle_tags <- setdiff(colnames(binary_matrix), c("Genes", "NeuroDev"))
gene_to_org <- binary_matrix %>% dplyr::select(Genes, all_of(organelle_tags))

ppi_evidence <- ppi_evidence %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_org, by = c("Gene1" = "Genes")) %>%
  dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_prot1"), all_of(organelle_tags)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_org, by = c("Gene2" = "Genes")) %>%
  dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_prot2"), all_of(organelle_tags))

# Step 6.2. filter to union neuronal proteome using gene symbols
neuronal_genes <- complete_data_annotated_day50 %>% dplyr::pull(Genes) %>% unique()
ppi_evidence <- ppi_evidence %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene1 %in% neuronal_genes, Gene2 %in% neuronal_genes)

# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 7. Union baseline edges (unchanged, but Predictome_conf_bin simplified for robustness)
baseline_edges_union <- ppi_evidence %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Predictome_conf_clamped = pmin(pmax(Predictome_conf, 0, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Predictome_conf_bin = cut(Predictome_conf_clamped, breaks = conf_bins, include.lowest = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    key, Protein1, Protein2, Gene1, Gene2, Name1, Name2,
    Predictome_present, IntAct_present, Overlap_flag,
    Predictome_conf, Predictome_conf_bin,
    STRING, confDBs, allDBs, IntAct_MIscore, DetectionMethod,
    everything()
  )

# save as csv
write_csv(baseline_edges_union, file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables", "baseline_edges_union.csv"))


# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 8. Proteome long table (KO/neuron parsed robustly)
prot_long <- complete_data_annotated_day50 %>%
  pivot_longer(-Genes, names_to = "sample", values_to = "log2FC") %>%
  dplyr::filter(str_detect(sample, "log2_fold_change")) %>%
  mutate(
    genotype = sub("_.*$", "", sample),
    neuron = case_when(
      str_detect(sample, "_iDA_") ~ "iDA",
      str_detect(sample, "_iN_")  ~ "iN",
      TRUE                        ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(neuron))

# Ensure baseline has gene symbols for both partners
# Use Name1/Name2 from Predictome (gene symbols) as Gene1/Gene2
baseline_edges_union <- baseline_edges_union %>%
 dplyr::mutate(
    Gene1 = if ("Gene1" %in% names(.)) Gene1 else Name1,
    Gene2 = if ("Gene2" %in% names(.)) Gene2 else Name2
  )

# Helper to compute same-organelle flags per row
.same_organelle <- function(df, organelle_tags) {
  prot1_mat <- as.data.frame(df[ paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot1") ])
  prot2_mat <- as.data.frame(df[ paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot2") ])
  # coerce to logical; NA -> FALSE for overlap test
  prot1_mat[] <- lapply(prot1_mat, function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x)))
  prot2_mat[] <- lapply(prot2_mat, function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x)))
  shared <- prot1_mat & prot2_mat
  ifelse(rowSums(shared) > 0, "same", "cross")
}
# explicit organelle column names in ppi_evidence/baseline_edges_union
org1_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot1")
org2_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot2")

# expand baseline to all KO × neuron contexts
ko_neuron_grid <- expand_grid(
  genotype = unique(prot_long$genotype),
  neuron   = unique(prot_long$neuron)
)

## Expand baseline_edges_union to every KO × neuron combination
baseline_expanded <- baseline_edges_union %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dummy = 1) %>%
  left_join(
    ko_neuron_grid %>% mutate(dummy = 1),
    by = "dummy",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-dummy)


# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 9. KO edge states (match by Gene1/Gene2 + genotype + neuron)
# add DiseaseClass mapping here for downstream plotting

# ensure one-to-one mapping for KOs
disease_map <- disease_classes_dataframe %>%
  dplyr::distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE)

ko_edge_states <- baseline_expanded %>%
  dplyr::select(
    key, Protein1, Protein2, Gene1, Gene2,
    Predictome_conf, Predictome_conf_bin, IntAct_present, Overlap_flag,
    tidyselect::all_of(org1_cols),
    tidyselect::all_of(org2_cols),
    genotype, neuron
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    prot_long %>% dplyr::select(Genes, genotype, neuron, log2FC),
    by = c("Gene1" = "Genes", "genotype", "neuron")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(dA = log2FC) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    prot_long %>% dplyr::select(Genes, genotype, neuron, log2FC),
    by = c("Gene2" = "Genes", "genotype", "neuron")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(dB = log2FC) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    state = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(dA) & dA < drop_thresh ~ "lost",
      !is.na(dB) & dB < drop_thresh ~ "lost",
      (!is.na(dA) | !is.na(dB))     ~ "retained",
      TRUE                          ~ "unknown"
    ),
    OrgPair = .same_organelle(., organelle_tags),
    genotype_neuron = paste(genotype, neuron, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("genotype_neuron" = "sample")) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    key, Protein1, Protein2, Gene1, Gene2,
    genotype, neuron, genotype_neuron, DiseaseClass,
    dA, dB, state,
    Predictome_conf, Predictome_conf_bin, IntAct_present, Overlap_flag, OrgPair
  )

# save csv
write_csv(ko_edge_states, file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables", "per_ko_edge_states.csv"))


# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- 10. Summary outputs for both knockout level and also on organelle annotation level 

# 10.1 On each KOxNeuronType level 
#total_baseline_edges = total number of PPI edges considered in the baseline network for that genotype–neuron context.
#n_lost = number of those edges where either protein partner’s log2FC dropped below your drop_thresh.
#fraction_lost = n_lost / total_baseline_edges = the proportion of baseline interactions that were lost.

# per KO × neuron
ko_summary_global <- ko_edge_states %>%
  group_by(genotype, neuron, genotype_neuron) %>%
  summarise(
    total_baseline_edges = n(),
    n_lost     = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_retained = sum(state == "retained", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_unknown  = sum(state == "unknown", na.rm = TRUE),
    fraction_lost = n_lost / total_baseline_edges,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# save as csv
write_csv(ko_summary_global, file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables", "ko_summary_global.csv"))

# 10.1 On each OrganellexKOxNeuronType level 
# tag which organelle shared: pick first TRUE shared among organelle_tags

# per organelle × KO × neuron
ko_summary_by_organelle <- ko_edge_states %>%
  filter(OrgPair == "same") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(shared_organelle = {
    prot1_flags <- baseline_edges_union[match(key, baseline_edges_union$key), paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot1")]
    prot2_flags <- baseline_edges_union[match(key, baseline_edges_union$key), paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot2")]
    shared <- organelle_tags[which(as.logical(prot1_flags) & as.logical(prot2_flags))]
    if (length(shared) == 0) NA_character_ else shared[1]
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(shared_organelle)) %>%
  group_by(genotype, neuron, genotype_neuron, shared_organelle) %>%
  summarise(
    n_edges = n(),
    n_lost  = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    fraction_lost = n_lost / n_edges,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# save as csv
write_csv(ko_summary_by_organelle, file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables", "ko_summary_by_organelle.csv"))


# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- 11. Create shared_long dataframe: PPI edges with shared organelle localization (long format, one row per key-organelle pair)
# Get organelle columns
org1_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot1")
org2_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot2")

# Filter to columns that actually exist
existing_org1_cols <- intersect(org1_cols, colnames(baseline_edges_union))
existing_org2_cols <- intersect(org2_cols, colnames(baseline_edges_union))

shared_long <- {
  if (length(existing_org1_cols) == 0 || length(existing_org2_cols) == 0) {
    message("No organelle columns found, creating empty shared_long")
    data.frame(key = character(0), tag = character(0), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else {
    m1 <- baseline_edges_union[, existing_org1_cols, drop = FALSE] %>% 
      lapply(function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x))) %>% 
      as.data.frame()
    m2 <- baseline_edges_union[, existing_org2_cols, drop = FALSE] %>% 
      lapply(function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x))) %>% 
      as.data.frame()
    
    shared_mat <- as.matrix(m1) & as.matrix(m2)
    existing_tags <- sub("_prot1$", "", existing_org1_cols)
    
    bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(shared_mat)), function(i) {
      idx <- which(shared_mat[i, ])
      if (!length(idx)) return(NULL)
      data.frame(key = baseline_edges_union$key[i], tag = existing_tags[idx], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }))
  }
}
message("Created shared_long with ", nrow(shared_long), " rows")

```


# QC Visualization of prediction mapping based on organelle
```{r}
# --------- PPI QC Scatterplots: Confidence score distributions by organelle ---------

# Step 1: Join baseline edges with organelle annotations
ppi_qc_df <- baseline_edges_union |>
  dplyr::select(key, RFprob, AFprob, AFMprob, Predictome_conf) |>
  left_join(shared_long, by = "key") |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag))  # keep only edges with organelle annotation

# Step 2: Generate color palette for all organelle tags
n_tags <- length(unique(ppi_qc_df$tag))
organelle_colors <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Set3"))(n_tags)
names(organelle_colors) <- sort(unique(ppi_qc_df$tag))

# Step 3: Plotting function for confidence score distributions
plot_confidence_distribution <- function(df, score_col, out_dir, org_colors) {
  
  # Remove NA values for the specific score
  df_plot <- df |>
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(score_col)))
  
  if (nrow(df_plot) == 0) {
    message("No data for ", score_col, "; skipping.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # Plot 1: Density plot by organelle
  p_density <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = !!sym(score_col), fill = tag)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors, name = "Organelle") +
    labs(
      title = paste(score_col, "distribution by organelle"),
      x = score_col,
      y = "Density"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("density_", score_col, "_by_organelle.pdf")),p_density, width = 6, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
  
  # Plot 2: Box plot by organelle
  p_box <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = reorder(tag, !!sym(score_col), median), 
                                 y = !!sym(score_col), fill = tag)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors, guide = "none") +
    labs(
      title = paste(score_col, "by organelle (ordered by median)"),
      x = NULL,
      y = score_col
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("boxplot_", score_col, "_by_organelle.pdf")),p_box, width = 6, height = 4.5, device = cairo_pdf)
  
  # Plot 3: Histogram with facets by organelle
  p_hist <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = !!sym(score_col), fill = tag)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~tag, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors, guide = "none") +
    labs(
      title = paste(score_col, "distribution per organelle"),
      x = score_col,
      y = "Count"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black")
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("histogram_", score_col, "_faceted.pdf")), p_hist, width = 10, height = 8, device = cairo_pdf)
}

# Step 4: Apply to all prediction scores
for (score in c("RFprob", "AFprob", "AFMprob", "Predictome_conf")) {
  plot_confidence_distribution(
    ppi_qc_df, 
    score, 
    file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "qc"),
    organelle_colors
  )
}

    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)
    )

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "qc", "bubble_AFMprob_vs_PredictomeConf_perKey.pdf"),
         p_qc_bubble_key, width = 5, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
}

# Option 2: Aggregated by annotation tag (using ppi_qc_df)
if (exists("ppi_qc_df")) {
  message("QC bubble plot (annotation-level): AFMprob vs Predictome_conf")

  qc_tag_summary <- ppi_qc_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(tag) %>%

      y = "AFM probability by annotation"
    ) +

      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "qc", "bubble_AFMprob_vs_PredictomeConf_byAnnotation.pdf"),p_qc_bubble_ann, width = 7, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
}
```

# Visualization of PPI loss
## Plotting function for correlation heatmaps and summary stacked
```{r}

## set global disease class color maps
disease_class_palette <- c(
  Sphingolipidoses = "#D53E4F",
  Mucopolysaccharidoses = "#F46D43",
  Glycoproteinoses = "#FDAE61",
  Neuronal.ceroid.lipofuscinoses = "#FEE08B",
  Integral.membrane.protein.disorders = "#E6F598",
  PTM.defects = "#ABDDA4",
  Lipid.storage.diseases = "#66C2A5"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------
# Plotting: global bars, KO×KO correlations (iN/iDA + combined), per-KO organelle heatmaps
plot_ppi_vulnerability <- function(df_edges,
                                   df_states,
                                   out_dir,
                                   plot_set = c("global_bar","global_corr","global_corr_combined","organelle"),
                                   neuron = "both",
                                   disease_class_df = NULL,
                                   top_n_links = 3000,   # kept for API compatibility
                                   save = TRUE) {

  # General configurations
  neuron <- match.arg(neuron, c("iN","iDA","both"))
  neuron_levels <- if (neuron == "both") c("iN","iDA") else neuron
  neuron_palette <- c(iN = "grey60", iDA = "grey80")

  # disease class palette (use existing global if present)
  disease_class_palette <- if (exists("disease_class_palette")) {
    get("disease_class_palette", inherits = TRUE)
  } else {
    c(
      Sphingolipidoses="#D53E4F",
      Mucopolysaccharidoses="#F46D43",
      Glycoproteinoses="#FDAE61",
      Neuronal.ceroid.lipofuscinoses="#FEE08B",
      Integral.membrane.protein.disorders="#E6F598",
      PTM.defects="#ABDDA4",
      Lipid.storage.diseases="#66C2A5"
    )
  }

  # one-to-one KO→DiseaseClass map
  disease_map <- NULL
  if (!is.null(disease_class_df)) {
    disease_map <- disease_class_df %>%
      dplyr::select(sample, DiseaseClass) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE)
  }

  # helper: build annotation colors safely to avoid gpar fill errors
  .ann_colors_safe <- function(annotation_df) {
    cols <- colnames(annotation_df)
    ann <- list()
    if ("neuron" %in% cols) ann$neuron <- neuron_palette
    if ("DiseaseClass" %in% cols) {
      present <- unique(stats::na.omit(annotation_df$DiseaseClass))
      present <- intersect(names(disease_class_palette), present)
      if (length(present) > 0) ann$DiseaseClass <- disease_class_palette[present]
    }
    if (length(ann) == 0) NULL else ann
  }

  
  
  # ----- GLOBAL STACKED BARS (separate per neuron) -----
  if ("global_bar" %in% plot_set) {
    for (nt in neuron_levels) {
      ppi_vul_global <- df_states %>%
        dplyr::filter(neuron == nt) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(state = factor(state, levels = c("retained","lost","unknown")))
      if (!is.null(disease_map)) {
        ppi_vul_global <- ppi_vul_global %>%
          dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("genotype" = "sample"))
      }
      ppi_vul_global_sum <- ppi_vul_global %>%
        dplyr::group_by(genotype, state) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
        dplyr::group_by(genotype) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(frac = n / sum(n)) %>%
        dplyr::ungroup()

      bar_ppi_global <- ggplot(ppi_vul_global_sum, aes(x = genotype, y = n, fill = state)) +
        geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(retained = "grey80", lost = "#C51B7D", unknown = "grey50")) +
        labs(x = NULL, y = "edges", title = paste("Edge outcomes per KO –", nt)) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
        theme(
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))

      if (save) {
        ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", paste0("bars_edge_outcomes_", nt, ".pdf")), bar_ppi_global, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
      }
    }
  }


  # ----- GLOBAL iN vs iDA bubble plot of lost PPIs -----
  if ("global_scatter" %in% plot_set && all(c("iN", "iDA") %in% neuron_levels)) {
    ppi_vul_global <- df_states %>%
      dplyr::filter(OrgPair == "same") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(state = factor(state, levels = c("retained","lost","unknown")))
  
    if (!is.null(disease_map)) {
      ppi_vul_global <- ppi_vul_global %>%
        dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("genotype" = "sample"))
    }
  
      loss_summary <- ppi_vul_global %>%
        dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          n_tot = dplyr::n(),
          n_lost = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
          frac_lost = ifelse(n_tot > 0, n_lost / n_tot, NA_real_),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        tidyr::pivot_wider(
          id_cols = genotype,
          names_from = neuron,
          values_from = frac_lost
        ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          ratio_in_ida = iN / iDA,
          ratio_in_ida = dplyr::case_when(
            is.na(ratio_in_ida) ~ NA_real_,
            ratio_in_ida > 3 ~ 3,          # cap high outliers
            ratio_in_ida < 1/3 ~ 1/3,      # cap low outliers
            TRUE ~ ratio_in_ida
          ),
          diff = abs(iDA - iN),
          color = dplyr::case_when(
            is.na(iDA) | is.na(iN) ~ "NA",
            diff <= 0.05 ~ "within_band",
            TRUE ~ "outside_band"
          ),
          color = factor(color, levels = c("within_band", "outside_band"))
        )
          
    print(loss_summary)
    color_map <- c(within_band = "grey60", outside_band = "#C51B7D")
  
    
     # Create polygon data for ±0.1 band around x = y
    band_df <- data.frame(
      x = c(-0.05, 0.4, 0.4, -0.05),
      y = c(-0.05 + 0.05, 0.4 + 0.05, 0.4 - 0.05, -0.05 - 0.05)
    )

    
    # Plot bubble plot
    p <- ggplot(loss_summary, aes(x = iN, y = iDA)) +
      geom_polygon(data = band_df, aes(x = x, y = y),
                   fill = "skyblue", alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
      geom_point(aes(fill = color, size = ratio_in_ida), shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.6, alpha = 0.9) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = genotype), size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 50, seed = 42) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0.05, linetype = "solid", color = "grey80") +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = -0.05, linetype = "solid", color = "grey80") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, drop = FALSE, name = "Deviation") +
      scale_size_continuous(name = "iN/iDA ratio", range = c(2, 6)) +
      coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = c(0, 0.35), ylim = c(0, 0.35), clip = "on") +
      labs(x = "Fraction lost PPIs (iN)", y = "Fraction lost PPIs (iDA)", title = "Genotype-wise PPI loss comparison") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
      )
  
    if (save) {
      ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", "scatter_ppi_loss_iN_vs_iDA.pdf"), p, width = 5.5, height = 5.5, device = cairo_pdf)
    }
  }
  
  
  
  
  # ----- GLOBAL KO×KO CORRELATION HEATMAPS (iN, iDA separately) -----
  if ("global_corr" %in% plot_set) {
    make_corr_for_neuron <- function(nt) {
      lost_df <- df_states %>%
        dplyr::filter(neuron == nt) %>%
        dplyr::transmute(genotype, key, lost = as.integer(state == "lost"))
      if (nrow(lost_df) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

      lost_wide <- tidyr::pivot_wider(lost_df, names_from = key, values_from = lost, values_fill = 0)
      lost_mat <- as.data.frame(lost_wide)
      rownames(lost_mat) <- lost_mat$genotype
      lost_mat$genotype <- NULL
      if (nrow(lost_mat) < 2 || ncol(lost_mat) < 2) return(invisible(NULL))

      rho <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor(t(as.matrix(lost_mat)),
                                         method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))

      # annotations aligned to rho order
      annotation_df <- data.frame(genotype = rownames(rho), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      if (!is.null(disease_map)) {
        annotation_df <- annotation_df %>%
          dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("genotype" = "sample"))
      }
      rownames(annotation_df) <- annotation_df$genotype
      annotation_df$genotype <- NULL
      ann_colors <- .ann_colors_safe(annotation_df)
      colnames(annotation_df) <- tolower(colnames(annotation_df))
      
      # plot heatmap
      pheatmap::pheatmap(
        mat = rho,
        scale = "none",
        color = colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(101),
        breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 102),
        na_col = "grey90",
        clustering_distance_rows = as.dist(1 - rho),
        clustering_distance_cols = as.dist(1 - rho),
        clustering_method = "ward.D2",
        show_rownames = TRUE,
        show_colnames = TRUE,
        use_raster = FALSE,
        annotation_col = annotation_df,
        annotation_row = annotation_df,
        annotation_colors = ann_colors,
        angle_col = "90",
        main = paste0("KO × KO similarity of lost PPIs (", nt, ")"),
        fontsize = 6,
        border_color = NA,
        cellheight = 6,
        cellwidth = 6,
        filename = file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", paste0("heatmap_lost_corr_", nt, ".pdf")), width = 9, height = 7)
      invisible(TRUE)
    }
    make_corr_for_neuron("iN")
    make_corr_for_neuron("iDA")
  }

  

  # ----- GLOBAL KO×KO CORRELATION HEATMAP (combined iN+iDA; all-by-all Spearman across neuron types) -----
  if ("global_corr_combined" %in% plot_set) {
  
    # build shared PPI feature space (same columns for iN and iDA)
    lost_long <- df_states %>%
      dplyr::mutate(lost = as.integer(state == "lost")) %>%
      dplyr::select(genotype_neuron, genotype, neuron, key, lost)
  
    if (nrow(lost_long) > 0) {
      lost_wide <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
        lost_long,
        names_from  = key,   # shared PPI space
        values_from = lost,
        values_fill = 0
      )
  
      rn <- lost_wide$genotype_neuron
      X  <- as.matrix(lost_wide[, setdiff(colnames(lost_wide),
                                          c("genotype_neuron","genotype","neuron")), drop = FALSE])
      rownames(X) <- rn
  
      if (nrow(X) >= 2 && ncol(X) >= 2) {
  
        # compute Spearman across all iN/iDA combinations
        rho <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor(t(X), method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
  
        # build annotation table: neuron + DiseaseClass
        annotation_df <- as.data.frame(lost_wide[, c("genotype_neuron","genotype","neuron"), drop = FALSE])
        rownames(annotation_df) <- annotation_df$genotype_neuron
        annotation_df$genotype_neuron <- NULL
  
        dc_map <- ko_edge_states %>%
          dplyr::distinct(genotype, neuron, DiseaseClass) %>%
          dplyr::mutate(genotype_neuron = paste(genotype, neuron, sep = "_")) %>%
          dplyr::select(genotype_neuron, DiseaseClass)
  
        annotation_df$DiseaseClass <- dc_map$DiseaseClass[match(rownames(annotation_df), dc_map$genotype_neuron)]
  
        # drop empty columns and align to rho
        keep_cols <- vapply(annotation_df, function(x) any(!is.na(x)), logical(1))
        annotation_df <- annotation_df[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
        annotation_df <- annotation_df[rownames(rho), , drop = FALSE]
  
        # color maps
        ann_colors <- list()
        if ("neuron" %in% colnames(annotation_df))
          ann_colors$neuron <- c(iN = "grey60", iDA = "grey80")
        if ("DiseaseClass" %in% colnames(annotation_df)) {
          present <- intersect(unique(stats::na.omit(annotation_df$DiseaseClass)),
                               names(disease_class_palette))
          if (length(present) > 0)
            ann_colors$DiseaseClass <- disease_class_palette[present]
        }
        if (length(ann_colors) == 0) ann_colors <- NULL
  
        
        
        # plot heatmap
        pheatmap::pheatmap(
          mat = rho,
          scale = "none",
          color = colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(101),
          breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 102),
          na_col = "grey90",
          clustering_distance_rows = as.dist(1 - rho),
          clustering_distance_cols = as.dist(1 - rho),
          clustering_method = "ward.D2",
          show_rownames = TRUE,
          show_colnames = TRUE,
          use_raster = FALSE,
          annotation_col = annotation_df,
          annotation_row = annotation_df,
          annotation_colors = ann_colors,
          angle_col = "90",
          main = "KO × KO similarity of lost PPIs (combined iN + iDA)",
          fontsize = 6,
          cellheight = 6,
          cellwidth  = 6,
          border_color = NA,
          filename = file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", "heatmap_lost_corr_combined.pdf"),width = 8, height = 8)
      }
    }
  }
  
  
  # ----- PER-KO ORGANELLE HEATMAPS (rows=organelles; cols=iN,iDA; 0..1) -----
  if ("organelle" %in% plot_set) {
    org1_cols <- grep("_prot1$", names(df_edges), value = TRUE)
    org2_cols <- grep("_prot2$", names(df_edges), value = TRUE)
    if (length(org1_cols) == 0 || length(org2_cols) == 0) {
      message("No organelle flags (*_prot1/_prot2) found in df_edges; skipping organelle heatmaps.")
    } else {
      organelle_flags <- sub("_prot1$", "", org1_cols)

      # per-edge organelle membership (both partners TRUE)
      edges_org_flags <- df_edges %>%
        dplyr::select(key, dplyr::all_of(org1_cols), dplyr::all_of(org2_cols))
      m1 <- as.data.frame(edges_org_flags[, org1_cols, drop = FALSE])
      m2 <- as.data.frame(edges_org_flags[, org2_cols, drop = FALSE])
      m1[] <- lapply(m1, function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x)))
      m2[] <- lapply(m2, function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x)))
      shared_mat <- as.matrix(m1) & as.matrix(m2)

      shared_long <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(shared_mat)), function(i) {
        idx <- which(shared_mat[i, ])
        if (length(idx) == 0) return(NULL)
        data.frame(key = edges_org_flags$key[i],
                   organelle = organelle_flags[idx],
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      })
      shared_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(shared_long)

      # fraction lost per (KO, neuron, organelle)
      frac_by_ko_neuron_org <- df_states %>%
        dplyr::filter(OrgPair == "same") %>%
        dplyr::select(key, genotype, neuron, state) %>%
        dplyr::inner_join(shared_long, by = "key") %>%
        dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, organelle) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          n_tot = dplyr::n(),
          n_lost = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
          fraction_lost = ifelse(n_tot > 0, n_lost / n_tot, NA_real_),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      all_kos <- sort(unique(frac_by_ko_neuron_org$genotype))
      for (g in all_kos) {
        hm_df <- frac_by_ko_neuron_org %>%
          dplyr::filter(genotype == g) %>%
          dplyr::select(organelle, neuron, fraction_lost) %>%
          tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = neuron, values_from = fraction_lost)

        if (!"iN" %in% names(hm_df)) hm_df$iN <- NA_real_
        if (!"iDA" %in% names(hm_df)) hm_df$iDA <- NA_real_

        hm_df <- hm_df %>% dplyr::arrange(organelle)
        rownames_df <- hm_df$organelle
        hm_df$organelle <- NULL

        hm_mat <- as.matrix(hm_df)
        rownames(hm_mat) <- make.unique(rownames_df)
        hm_mat <- hm_mat[, c("iN","iDA"), drop = FALSE]
        if (nrow(hm_mat) == 0) next

        annotation_col <- data.frame(neuron = c("iN","iDA"))
        rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(hm_mat)

        pheatmap::pheatmap(
          mat = hm_mat,
          scale = "none",
          color = colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(101),
          breaks = seq(0, 1, length.out = 102),
          na_col = "grey90",
          cluster_rows = TRUE,
          cluster_cols = FALSE,
          show_rownames = TRUE,
          show_colnames = TRUE,
          use_raster = FALSE,
          annotation_col = annotation_col,
          annotation_colors = list(neuron = neuron_palette),
          angle_col = "90",
          main = paste0("Fraction lost by organelle - ", g, " (iN vs iDA)"),
          fontsize = 6,
          cellwidth = 6,
          cellheight = 6,
          border_color = NA,
          filename = file.path(out_dir, "plots/by_ko", paste0("heatmap_organelle_fraction_lost_", g, ".pdf")), width = 6, height = 9)
      }
    }
  }
}

  df_edges  = baseline_edges_union,
  df_states = ko_edge_states,
  out_dir   = out_dir_ppi_vuln,
  plot_set  = c("global_bar", "global_scatter", "global_corr","global_corr_combined","organelle"),
  neuron    = "both",
  disease_class_df = disease_class_df
)
```

## Plotting function for stacked bargraphs for organelle PPI impact
```{r}
# --- Prepare shared_long and correctly named disease_class_df ---
shared_long <- {
  org1_cols <- grep("_prot1$", names(baseline_edges_union), value = TRUE)
  org2_cols <- grep("_prot2$", names(baseline_edges_union), value = TRUE)
  stopifnot(length(org1_cols) == length(org2_cols), length(org1_cols) > 0)
  tags <- sub("_prot1$", "", org1_cols)

  m1 <- baseline_edges_union[, org1_cols] |> lapply(function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x))) |> as.data.frame()
  m2 <- baseline_edges_union[, org2_cols] |> lapply(function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x))) |> as.data.frame()
  shared_mat <- as.matrix(m1) & as.matrix(m2)

  bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(shared_mat)), function(i) {
    idx <- which(shared_mat[i, ])
    if (!length(idx)) return(NULL)
    data.frame(key = baseline_edges_union$key[i], tag = tags[idx], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}

# Ensure correct naming
disease_class_df <- disease_classes_dataframe



# --- Stacked organelle bars (genotypes on x, organelle classes as fill) ---
plot_organelle_stacked_bars <- function(df_states,
                                        shared_long,
                                        annotation_classes_corrgeno,
                                        annotation_class_colors_corrgeno,
                                        out_dir) {
  if (is.null(shared_long) || nrow(shared_long) == 0) {
  message("No shared organelle tags found; skipping organelle stacked bars.")
  return(invisible(NULL))
}

  # Step 1. Tag -> class map
  tag_map <- lapply(names(annotation_classes_corrgeno), function(cls) {
    tags <- annotation_classes_corrgeno[[cls]]
    data.frame(tag = tags, class = cls, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }) |> dplyr::bind_rows()

  # Step 2. Map tags -> classes and summarize per genotype/neuron/class
  shared_class <- shared_long |>
    dplyr::inner_join(tag_map, by = "tag") |>
    dplyr::distinct(key, class)

  loss_by_class <- df_states |>
    dplyr::filter(OrgPair == "same") |>
    dplyr::select(key, genotype, neuron, state) |>
    dplyr::inner_join(shared_class, by = "key") |>
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, class) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_tot   = dplyr::n(),
      n_lost  = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
      frac_lost = ifelse(n_tot > 0, n_lost / n_tot, NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Step 3. Map tags -> classes and summarize per genotype/neuron/class
  shared_class <- shared_long |>
    dplyr::inner_join(tag_map, by = "tag") |>
    dplyr::distinct(key, class)

  loss_by_class <- df_states |>
    dplyr::filter(OrgPair == "same") |>
    dplyr::select(key, genotype, neuron, state) |>
    dplyr::inner_join(shared_class, by = "key") |>
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, class) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_tot   = dplyr::n(),
      n_lost  = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
      frac_lost = ifelse(n_tot > 0, n_lost / n_tot, NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Step 4. Plotting helper (one neuron per PDF; x = genotype; fill = organelle class)
  plot_one_neuron <- function(nt) {
    dd <- loss_by_class |> dplyr::filter(neuron == nt)
    if (nrow(dd) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

    # alphabetical ordering and plotting bars by annotation
      dd <- dd |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          genotype = factor(genotype, levels = sort(unique(genotype))),
          class    = factor(class, levels = names(annotation_class_colors_corrgeno))
        )

    # restrict palette to present classes
    present_classes <- levels(dd$class)
    class_cols <- annotation_class_colors_corrgeno[names(annotation_class_colors_corrgeno) %in% present_classes]
    class_cols <- class_cols[present_classes]  # ensure order matches factor levels

    # Plot 4.1 counts: stacked by organelle class
    p_counts <- ggplot(dd, aes(x = genotype, y = n_lost, fill = class)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.7, position = "stack", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = class_cols, drop = FALSE, name = "Organelle") +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Lost PPIs (count)", title = paste0("Lost PPIs by organelle (", nt, ")")) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
      )
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", paste0("bars_organelle_lost_counts_", nt, ".pdf")), p_counts, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)

    # Plot 4.2 fractions: composition across organelle classes per genotype
    p_frac <- ggplot(dd, aes(x = genotype, y = n_lost, fill = class)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.7, position = "fill", color = "black", linewidth =  0.2) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = class_cols, drop = FALSE, name = "Organelle") +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Fraction of lost PPIs", title = paste0("Composition of lost PPIs by organelle (", nt, ")")) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
      )
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", paste0("bars_organelle_lost_fraction_", nt, ".pdf")), p_frac, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  }

  plot_one_neuron("iN")
  plot_one_neuron("iDA")
  
  #return(shared_long)
  
}


# --- Faceted barplot and pie charts by disease class and organelle tag ---
plot_ppi_diseaseclass_impact <- function(df_states, shared_long, disease_class_df, out_dir, disease_class_palette) {

  # Step 1: Extract unique key-tag pairs from shared_long
  shared_tags <- shared_long |>
    dplyr::distinct(key, tag)

  # Step 2: Prepare disease_class_df with uppercase sample column
  disease_map <- disease_class_df |>
    dplyr::mutate(sample = toupper(sample)) |>
    dplyr::select(sample, DiseaseClass) |>
    dplyr::distinct()

  # Step 3: Merge shared tags and disease class info into df_states
  df_tagged <- df_states |>
    dplyr::filter(OrgPair == "same") |>
    dplyr::mutate(KO = toupper(gsub("(_.*)$", "", genotype))) |>
    dplyr::left_join(shared_tags, by = "key") |>
    dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("KO" = "sample"))

  # Step 4: Ensure at least one valid DiseaseClass column exists
  stopifnot(any(grepl("^DiseaseClass(\\.|$)", colnames(df_tagged))))

  # Step 5: Keep rows with both tag and DiseaseClass (from either suffix)
  df_tagged <- df_tagged |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag), !is.na(DiseaseClass.x) | !is.na(DiseaseClass.y)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(DiseaseClass = dplyr::coalesce(DiseaseClass.x, DiseaseClass.y))

  # Step 6: Aggregated bar data (tag × disease class × neuron)
  tag_disease_loss <- df_tagged |>
    dplyr::group_by(neuron, DiseaseClass, tag) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::filter(n > 0)

  # add order from disease palette
  tag_disease_loss$DiseaseClass <- factor(tag_disease_loss$DiseaseClass, levels = names(disease_class_palette))
  
  
 # ---- plotting calls of data ---- 
  # Plot 1: faceted stacked barplot by tag
  p_bar <- ggplot(tag_disease_loss, aes(x = DiseaseClass, y = n, fill = DiseaseClass)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~tag, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = disease_class_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Lost PPIs", title = "Lost PPIs by organelle tag and disease class") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", "bars_organelle_tag_by_diseaseclass.pdf"), p_bar, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)

  
  # Plot 2: Normalized Bar Charts by organelle tag and disease class
  bar_norm_tag_df <- df_tagged |>
    dplyr::filter(state == "lost") |>
    dplyr::group_by(neuron, DiseaseClass, tag) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n_lost = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      df_tagged |> 
        dplyr::distinct(KO, DiseaseClass, tag, neuron) |> 
        dplyr::count(DiseaseClass, tag, neuron, name = "n_KOs"),
      by = c("DiseaseClass", "tag", "neuron")
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(n_norm = n_lost / n_KOs) |>
    dplyr::filter(n_KOs > 0)
  
  # add order from disease palette
  bar_norm_tag_df$DiseaseClass <- factor(bar_norm_tag_df$DiseaseClass, levels = names(disease_class_palette))
  
  # Plot function: one faceted barplot per neuron
  plot_normed_bar_by_tag <- function(nt) {
    dd <- bar_norm_tag_df |> dplyr::filter(neuron == nt)
    if (nrow(dd) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  
    p <- ggplot(dd, aes(x = DiseaseClass, y = n_norm, fill = DiseaseClass)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      facet_wrap(~tag, scales = "free_y") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = disease_class_palette, drop = FALSE) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Normalized PPI loss per KO by tag –", nt),
        x = NULL,
        y = "Lost PPIs per KO"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)
      )
  
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", paste0("bars_organelle_tag_by_diseaseclass_perKO_", nt, ".pdf")),p, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  }
  
  plot_normed_bar_by_tag("iN")
  plot_normed_bar_by_tag("iDA")
  
  
  # Plot 3: Pie charts iN / iDA
  pie_df <- df_tagged |>
    dplyr::filter(state == "lost") |>
    dplyr::group_by(neuron, DiseaseClass) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

  # add order from disease palette
  pie_df$DiseaseClass <- factor(pie_df$DiseaseClass, levels = names(disease_class_palette))
  
  # Plot function: pie charts for neurons / disease class
  plot_one_pie <- function(nt) {
    dd <- pie_df |> dplyr::filter(neuron == nt)
    if (nrow(dd) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

    dd$fraction <- dd$n / sum(dd$n)

    pie <- ggplot(dd, aes(x = "", y = fraction, fill = DiseaseClass)) +
      geom_col(width = 1, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      coord_polar("y") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = disease_class_palette, drop = FALSE) +
      labs(title = paste("PPI loss composition –", nt), fill = "Disease class") +
      theme_void(base_size = 6)

    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", paste0("pie_ppi_loss_diseaseclass_", nt, ".pdf")),pie, width = 4.5, height = 4.5, device = cairo_pdf)
  }

  plot_one_pie("iN")
  plot_one_pie("iDA")
  
}


# ---- Call (creates 4 PDFs: counts+fractions for iN and iDA) ----
plot_organelle_stacked_bars(
  df_states = ko_edge_states,
  shared_long = shared_long,
  annotation_classes_corrgeno = annotation_classes_corrgeno,
  annotation_class_colors_corrgeno = annotation_class_colors_corrgeno,
  out_dir = out_dir_ppi_vuln
)

plot_ppi_diseaseclass_impact(

  shared_long = shared_long,
  disease_class_df = disease_class_df,
  out_dir = out_dir_ppi_vuln,
  disease_class_palette = disease_class_palette
)
```
