## Radar / Spider plot for lost PPI / per annotation / per disease class
```{r}
# =========================================================================
# Radar/Spider Plots: PPI Vulnerability Profile by Disease Class
# One plot per neuron type, overlaid disease classes
# =========================================================================

# --- Make Output Directory ---
out_dir_radar <- file.path(out_dir_PPI, "Radarplot")
dir.create(out_dir_radar, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_radar, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


# --- Define your 12 annotations in desired order (clockwise from top)  ---
radar_annotations <- c(
  "Lysosome", "Endo_iN_curated_Hundley", "EarlyEndosome", "RecyclingEndosome",
  "Mito", "MitoMatrix", "OXPHOS", "Golgi",
  "SynapseSVs","SVfusion","Presynaptic", "Postsynaptic"
)

# ("Mito", "MitoIMS", "MitoMatrix", "MitoMIM", "MitoMOM", "OXPHOS",
#                      "mtComplexI", "Golgi", "Lysosome", "ER", "Cytoplasm", "Nucleus",
#                      "Autophagy", "SynGO", "Endo_iN_curated_Hundley", "SynapseSVs",
#                      "Presynaptic",  "NeuroDev", "EndoLyso", "EarlyEndosome",
#                      "RecyclingEndosome", "SVfusion", "Svendocytosis", "Svexocytosis", "vATPase")

# Load required package
if (!requireNamespace("fmsb", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("fmsb")
}
library(fmsb)


# --- Prepare data for radar plot ---
# Need: rows = disease classes, columns = annotations, values = normalized PPI loss

prepare_radar_data <- function(df_states, shared_long, disease_class_df, neuron_type) {
  
  shared_tags <- shared_long %>% dplyr::distinct(key, tag)
  
  df_tagged <- df_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == neuron_type) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(KO = toupper(genotype)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(shared_tags, by = "key", relationship = "many-to-many")
  
  if (!"DiseaseClass" %in% colnames(df_tagged)) {
    disease_map <- disease_class_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(sample = toupper(sample)) %>%
      dplyr::select(sample, DiseaseClass) %>%
      dplyr::distinct()
    
    df_tagged <- df_tagged %>%
      dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("KO" = "sample"))
  }
  
  df_tagged <- df_tagged %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag), !is.na(DiseaseClass))
  
  radar_data <- df_tagged %>%
    dplyr::filter(state == "lost") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(DiseaseClass, tag) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_lost = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      df_tagged %>% dplyr::distinct(KO, DiseaseClass) %>% dplyr::count(DiseaseClass, name = "n_KOs"),
      by = "DiseaseClass"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(loss_per_KO = n_lost / n_KOs) %>%
    dplyr::select(DiseaseClass, tag, loss_per_KO) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = tag, values_from = loss_per_KO, values_fill = 0)
  
  return(radar_data)
}


# --- Plot radar chart ---
plot_radar_ppi <- function(radar_data, disease_class_palette, neuron_type, out_dir) {
  
  # fmsb requires: row 1 = max values, row 2 = min values, row 3+ = data
  # Get annotation columns (all except DiseaseClass)
  annot_cols <- setdiff(colnames(radar_data), "DiseaseClass")
  
  # User Selected annotations
  if (!is.null(radar_annotations)) {
    annot_cols <- intersect(radar_annotations, annot_cols)
    radar_data <- radar_data %>% dplyr::select(DiseaseClass, all_of(annot_cols))
  }
    
  # Prepare matrix for fmsb
  data_matrix <- as.data.frame(radar_data[, annot_cols])
  rownames(data_matrix) <- radar_data$DiseaseClass
  
  # Add max and min rows
  max_val <- max(data_matrix, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1
  min_val <- 0
  
  radar_df <- rbind(
    rep(max_val, ncol(data_matrix)),  # max
    rep(min_val, ncol(data_matrix)),  # min
    data_matrix
  )
  colnames(radar_df) <- annot_cols
  
  # Get colors for disease classes (with transparency for fill)
  disease_classes <- radar_data$DiseaseClass
  line_colors <- disease_class_palette[disease_classes]
  fill_colors <- adjustcolor(line_colors, alpha.f = 0.15)
  
  # Plot
  pdf(file.path(out_dir, paste0("FSMDradar_ppi_vulnerability_", neuron_type, ".pdf")), width = 8, height = 8)
  
  par(mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1))
  
  fmsb::radarchart(
    radar_df,
    axistype = 1,
    pcol = line_colors,
    pfcol = fill_colors,
    plwd = 2,
    plty = 1,
    cglcol = "grey70",
    cglty = 1,
    cglwd = 0.8,
    axislabcol = "grey30",
    vlcex = 0.7,
    calcex = 0.6,
    title = paste0("PPI Vulnerability Profile by Disease Class (", neuron_type, ")\nNormalized lost PPIs per KO")
  )
  
  # Add legend
  legend(
    "topright",
    legend = disease_classes,
    col = line_colors,
    lwd = 2,
    lty = 1,
    bty = "n",
    cex = 0.7
  )
  
  dev.off()
  
  message("Saved radar plot: ", file.path(out_dir, paste0("radar_ppi_vulnerability_", neuron_type, ".pdf")))
}



# --- Run for both neuron types ---
# iN
radar_data_iN <- prepare_radar_data(
  df_states = ko_edge_states,
  shared_long = shared_long,
  disease_class_df = disease_class_df,
  neuron_type = "iN"
)

plot_radar_ppi(radar_data_iN, disease_class_palette, "iN", out_dir_radar)


# iDA
radar_data_iDA <- prepare_radar_data(
  df_states = ko_edge_states,
  shared_long = shared_long,
  disease_class_df = disease_class_df,
  neuron_type = "iDA"
)

plot_radar_ppi(radar_data_iDA, disease_class_palette, "iDA", out_dir_radar)



# --- Save radar data tables ---

write_csv(radar_data_iDA, file.path(out_dir_radar, "tables", "radar_ppi_data_iDA.csv"))
```

```{r}
# =========================================================================
# Radar/Spider Plots: PPI Vulnerability Profile 
# One plot per disease class per neuron type
# Each plot shows all genotypes within that class
# iN = grey shades, iDA = blue shades
# =========================================================================

# --- Make Output Directory ---
out_dir_radarDisClass <- file.path(out_dir_radar, "DisClassDetailed")
dir.create(out_dir_radarDisClass, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Prepare data for radar plot (genotype-level) ---
prepare_radar_data_by_genotype <- function(df_states, shared_long, disease_class_df, neuron_type) {
  
  shared_tags <- shared_long %>% dplyr::distinct(key, tag)
  
  df_tagged <- df_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == neuron_type) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(KO = toupper(genotype)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(shared_tags, by = "key", relationship = "many-to-many")
  
  if (!"DiseaseClass" %in% colnames(df_tagged)) {
    disease_map <- disease_class_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(sample = toupper(sample)) %>%
      dplyr::select(sample, DiseaseClass) %>%
      dplyr::distinct()
    
    df_tagged <- df_tagged %>%
      dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("KO" = "sample"))
  }
  
  df_tagged <- df_tagged %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag), !is.na(DiseaseClass))
  
  radar_data <- df_tagged %>%
    dplyr::filter(state == "lost") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, DiseaseClass, tag) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_lost = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = tag, values_from = n_lost, values_fill = 0)
  
  return(radar_data)
}

# --- Plot radar chart for one disease class, one neuron type ---
plot_radar_diseaseclass <- function(radar_data, disease_class, neuron_type, radar_annotations = NULL, out_dir) {
  
  # Filter to disease class
  data_sub <- radar_data %>% dplyr::filter(DiseaseClass == disease_class)
  
  if (nrow(data_sub) == 0) {
    message("No data for ", disease_class, " (", neuron_type, "); skipping.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # Get annotation columns
  annot_cols <- setdiff(colnames(radar_data), c("genotype", "DiseaseClass"))
  
  # Filter to user-specified annotations if provided
  if (!is.null(radar_annotations)) {
    annot_cols <- intersect(radar_annotations, annot_cols)
  }
  
  # Prepare matrix for fmsb (rows = genotypes)
  data_matrix <- as.data.frame(data_sub[, annot_cols])
  rownames(data_matrix) <- data_sub$genotype
  
  # Add max/min rows for fmsb
  max_val <- max(data_matrix, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1
  if (max_val == 0) max_val <- 1
  
  radar_df <- rbind(
    rep(max_val, ncol(data_matrix)),
    rep(0, ncol(data_matrix)),
    data_matrix
  )
  colnames(radar_df) <- annot_cols
  
  # Generate colors: grey shades for iN, blue shades for iDA
  n_genotypes <- nrow(data_sub)
  if (neuron_type == "iN") {
    line_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("grey30", "grey70"))(n_genotypes)
  } else {
    line_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("navy", "dodgerblue3"))(n_genotypes)
  }
  fill_colors <- adjustcolor(line_colors, alpha.f = 0.1)
  
  # Plot
  pdf_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("radar_", gsub("\\.", "_", disease_class), "_", neuron_type, ".pdf"))
  pdf(pdf_file, width = 9, height = 8)
  
  par(mar = c(1, 1, 3, 1))
  
  fmsb::radarchart(
    radar_df,
    axistype = 1,
    pcol = line_colors,
    pfcol = fill_colors,
    plwd = 1.5,
    plty = 1,
    cglcol = "grey70",
    cglty = 1,
    cglwd = 0.8,
    axislabcol = "grey30",
    vlcex = 0.6,
    calcex = 0.5,
    title = paste0("PPI Vulnerability: ", disease_class, " (", neuron_type, ")")
  )
  
  legend(
    "topright",
    legend = data_sub$genotype,
    col = line_colors,
    lwd = 1.5,
    lty = 1,
    bty = "n",
    cex = 0.6
  )
  
  dev.off()
  message("Saved: ", pdf_file)
}

# --- Define annotations for radar ---
radar_annotations <- c(
  "Lysosome", "Endo_iN_curated_Hundley", "EarlyEndosome", "RecyclingEndosome",
  "Mito", "MitoMatrix", "OXPHOS", "Golgi",
  "SynapseSVs","SVfusion","Presynaptic", "Postsynaptic"
)

# --- Prepare data ---
radar_dataDisClass_iN <- prepare_radar_data_by_genotype(ko_edge_states, shared_long, disease_class_df, "iN")
radar_dataDisClass_iDA <- prepare_radar_data_by_genotype(ko_edge_states, shared_long, disease_class_df, "iDA")

# --- Generate plots for each disease class × neuron type ---
disease_classes_present <- unique(c(radar_dataDisClass_iN$DiseaseClass, radar_dataDisClass_iDA$DiseaseClass))

for (dc in disease_classes_present) {
  plot_radar_diseaseclass(radar_dataDisClass_iN, dc, "iN", radar_annotations, out_dir_radarDisClass)
  plot_radar_diseaseclass(radar_dataDisClass_iDA, dc, "iDA", radar_annotations, out_dir_radarDisClass)
}
```

# Visualization of KO x Neuron x Annotation effect on PPIs
## Per-KO PPI vulnerability profiles by confidence scores
```{r}
### Per-KO PPI vulnerability profiles by confidence scores
# --------- Per-KO PPI loss profiles: confidence score distributions for lost vs retained edges ---------

# --- Step 1: Create output directory structure
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/per_ko_neuron"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


# --- Step 2: Join ko_edge_states with baseline edge properties + organelle tags
# Make sure we're selecting the right columns from baseline_edges_union
ko_ppi_profiles <- ko_edge_states |>
  dplyr::select(key, genotype, neuron, state, genotype_neuron) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    baseline_edges_union |> 
      dplyr::select(key, RFprob, AFprob, AFMprob, Predictome_conf),
    by = "key"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(shared_long, by = "key") |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag), state %in% c("lost", "retained")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    state = factor(state, levels = c("retained", "lost"))
  )

# Check if columns exist
print("Column names in ko_ppi_profiles:")
print(colnames(ko_ppi_profiles))

# Check for missing confidence scores
print("Summary of confidence scores:")
print(summary(ko_ppi_profiles[, c("RFprob", "AFprob", "AFMprob", "Predictome_conf")]))


# --- Step 3: Generate color palettes
n_tags <- length(unique(ko_ppi_profiles$tag))
organelle_colors <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Set3"))(n_tags)
names(organelle_colors) <- sort(unique(ko_ppi_profiles$tag))

state_colors <- c(retained = "grey70", lost = "#C51B7D")


# --- Step 4: Plotting function per KO × neuron
plot_ko_neuron_profile <- function(df, geno, nt, score_col, out_dir, org_colors, state_cols) {
  
  # Check if score_col exists
  if (!score_col %in% colnames(df)) {
    message("Column ", score_col, " not found in data; skipping.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  df_subset <- df |>
    dplyr::filter(genotype == geno, neuron == nt) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[score_col]]))  # Use .data[[]] for dynamic column reference
  
  if (nrow(df_subset) < 10) {
    message("Insufficient data for ", geno, " ", nt, " (", score_col, "); skipping.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  ko_label <- paste0(geno, "_", nt)
  
  # Plot 1: Density by state (lost vs retained)
  p_density_state <- ggplot(df_subset, aes(x = .data[[score_col]], fill = state)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = state_cols, name = "Edge state") +
    labs(
      title = paste(score_col, "– lost vs retained"),
      subtitle = ko_label,
      x = score_col,
      y = "Density"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(ko_label, "_density_", score_col, "_by_state.pdf")),p_density_state, width = 5, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
  
  # Plot 2: Box plot by organelle, faceted by state
  p_box_org <- ggplot(df_subset, aes(x = reorder(tag, .data[[score_col]], median, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                      y = .data[[score_col]], fill = tag)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~state, nrow = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors, guide = "none") +
    labs(
      title = paste(score_col, "by organelle"),
      subtitle = ko_label,
      x = NULL,
      y = score_col
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(ko_label, "_boxplot_", score_col, "_by_organelle.pdf")),p_box_org, width = 5, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
  
  # Plot 3: Histogram faceted by organelle + state overlay
  p_hist_org <- ggplot(df_subset, aes(x = .data[[score_col]], fill = state)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 20, position = "identity", alpha = 0.6, color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
    facet_wrap(~tag, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = state_cols, name = "State") +
    labs(
      title = paste(score_col, "distribution per organelle"),
      subtitle = ko_label,
      x = score_col,
      y = "Count"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(ko_label, "_histogram_", score_col, "_faceted.pdf")),p_hist_org, width = 10, height = 7, device = cairo_pdf)
}
```

## Per-KO x Neuron organelle-specific PPI state
```{r}
# --------- Stacked bars: lost vs retained PPIs per organelle for each KO × neuron ---------

# --- Step 1: Define plotting function for viz PPIs on organelle levels (KO x neurontype)
plot_ko_neuron_organelle_bars <- function(df, out_dir, org_colors) {
  
  # Prepare data: count lost/retained per KO × neuron × organelle
  organelle_state_counts <- df |>
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, tag, state) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::mutate(genotype_neuron = paste(genotype, neuron, sep = "_"))
  
  # Get unique KO × neuron combinations
  ko_neuron_combos <- organelle_state_counts |>
    dplyr::distinct(genotype, neuron, genotype_neuron)
  
  # Plot for each KO × neuron
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(ko_neuron_combos))) {
    geno <- ko_neuron_combos$genotype[i]
    nt   <- ko_neuron_combos$neuron[i]
    ko_label <- ko_neuron_combos$genotype_neuron[i]
    
    df_subset <- organelle_state_counts |>
      dplyr::filter(genotype == geno, neuron == nt)
    
    if (nrow(df_subset) == 0) next
    
    # Plot 1: Stacked counts (absolute)
    p_counts <- ggplot(df_subset, aes(x = reorder(tag, -n, sum), y = n, fill = state)) +
      geom_col(position = "stack", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c(retained = "grey70", lost = "#C51B7D"),
        name = "State"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste("PPI state per organelle –", ko_label),
        x = NULL,
        y = "Number of PPIs"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top"
      )
    
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(ko_label, "_bars_organelle_state_counts.pdf")),p_counts, width = 5, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
    
    # Plot 2: Stacked fractions (proportions)
    p_fractions <- ggplot(df_subset, aes(x = reorder(tag, -n, sum), y = n, fill = state)) +
      geom_col(position = "fill", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c(retained = "grey70", lost = "#C51B7D"),
        name = "State"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste("PPI state composition per organelle –", ko_label),
        x = NULL,
        y = "Fraction of PPIs"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top"
      )
    
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(ko_label, "_bars_organelle_state_fractions.pdf")),p_fractions, width = 5, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  }
  
  # Summary table: counts per KO × neuron × organelle × state
  summary_table <- organelle_state_counts |>
    dplyr::arrange(genotype, neuron, tag, state)
  
  write_csv(summary_table,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables", "ko_neuron_organelle_state_counts.csv"))
  
  invisible(summary_table)
}

  out_dir = file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/per_ko_neuron"),

)



# --------- iN vs iDA bubble plots per KO ---------
# --- Step 3: Bubble plot of iN vs iDA effect on PPIs loss per organelle annotation
plot_ko_bubble_in_vs_ida <- function(df, out_dir, org_colors) {
  
  # --- Step 3.1: Count lost PPIs per KO × neuron × organelle
  organelle_counts <- df |>
    dplyr::filter(state == "lost") |>
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, tag) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n_lost = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  # --- Step 3.2: Count total PPIs per KO × neuron × organelle (for normalization)
  totals <- df |>
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, tag) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n_total = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  # --- Step 3.3: Merge totals and compute fraction lost
  organelle_counts <- organelle_counts |>
    dplyr::left_join(totals, by = c("genotype", "neuron", "tag")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(frac_lost = ifelse(n_total > 0, n_lost / n_total, NA_real_)) |>
    dplyr::filter(tag != "Nucleus")   # optional filter
  
  # --- Step 3.4: Pivot to wide format (iN vs iDA)
  organelle_wide <- organelle_counts |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = neuron,
      values_from = c(n_lost, frac_lost),
      values_fill = 0
    )
  
  # --- Step 3.5: Loop over each KO
  all_kos <- unique(organelle_wide$genotype)
  
  for (geno in all_kos) {
    
    df_ko <- organelle_wide |>
      dplyr::filter(genotype == geno)
    
    if (nrow(df_ko) == 0) next
    
    # ABSOLUTE plot: iN_lost vs iDA_lost
    df_abs <- df_ko |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        total_lost = n_lost_iN + n_lost_iDA
      )
    
    max_val_abs <- max(c(df_abs$n_lost_iN, df_abs$n_lost_iDA), na.rm = TRUE)
    axis_lim_abs <- c(0, max_val_abs * 1.1)
    
    p_abs <- ggplot(df_abs, aes(x = n_lost_iN, y = n_lost_iDA, fill = tag, size = total_lost)) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
      geom_point(shape = 21, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0.2) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = tag), size = 2, max.overlaps = 30, seed = 42) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors, name = "Organelle") +
      scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10), guide = "none") +
      coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = axis_lim_abs, ylim = axis_lim_abs, clip = "on") +
      labs(
        title = paste0(geno, " – Lost PPIs (absolute)"),
        x = "Lost PPIs in iN",
        y = "Lost PPIs in iDA"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
            panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
            legend.position = "right",
            legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"))
    
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(geno, "_bubble_absolute_iN_vs_iDA.pdf")),p_abs, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
    
    
    # RELATIVE plot: normalized by total PPIs per neuron: (iDA_lost / total_iDA) ÷ (iN_lost / total_iN)
    df_rel <- df_ko |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        total_lost = n_lost_iN + n_lost_iDA
      )
    
    max_val_rel <- max(c(df_rel$frac_lost_iN, df_rel$frac_lost_iDA), na.rm = TRUE)
    axis_lim_rel <- c(0, max_val_rel * 1.1)
    
    p_rel <- ggplot(df_rel, aes(x = frac_lost_iN, y = frac_lost_iDA, fill = tag, size = total_lost)) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
      geom_point(shape = 21, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0.2) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = tag), size = 2, max.overlaps = 30, seed = 42) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors, name = "Organelle") +
      scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10), guide = "none") +
      coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = axis_lim_rel, ylim = axis_lim_rel, clip = "on") +
      labs(
        title = paste0(geno, " – Lost PPIs (relative to total)"),
        x = "Fraction lost in iN",
        y = "Fraction lost in iDA"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
            panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
            legend.position = "right",
            legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"))
    
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(geno, "_bubble_relative_iN_vs_iDA.pdf")),p_rel, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  }
}

  out_dir = file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/per_ko_neuron"),
  org_colors = organelle_colors
)
```

## Sankey plot of lost PPIs per KO x neuron compared to baseline
```{r}
# --------- Sankey plot: Lost PPIs per genotype (one plot per KO) ---------
library(ggsankey)

# --- Step 1: Create Sankey plot for a single genotype ---
plot_ppi_loss_sankey_per_genotype <- function(df_states, shared_long, genotype_name, 
                                               out_dir, min_ppis = 10, save = TRUE) {
  
  # Filter to specific genotype and lost PPIs
  lost_ppis <- df_states |>
    dplyr::filter(state == "lost", genotype == genotype_name) |>
    dplyr::select(key, neuron) |>
    dplyr::inner_join(shared_long, by = "key") |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag))
  
  if (nrow(lost_ppis) == 0) {
    message("No lost PPIs found for ", genotype_name)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # Count total lost PPIs per organelle for this genotype
  organelle_counts <- lost_ppis |>
    dplyr::count(tag, name = "total_lost") |>
    dplyr::arrange(desc(total_lost))
  
  message("\n", genotype_name, " - Lost PPIs per organelle:")
  print(organelle_counts)
  
  # Keep major organelles only (adjusted threshold per genotype)
  major_organelles <- organelle_counts |>
    dplyr::filter(total_lost >= min_ppis) |>
    dplyr::pull(tag)
  
  if (length(major_organelles) == 0) {
    message("No organelles with ≥", min_ppis, " lost PPIs for ", genotype_name)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # Aggregate minor organelles
  lost_ppis_clean <- lost_ppis |>
    dplyr::mutate(tag = ifelse(tag %in% major_organelles, tag, "Other"))
  
  # Create individual rows for EACH lost PPI
  flows_ida <- lost_ppis_clean |>
    dplyr::filter(neuron == "iDA") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      iDA = tag,
      Baseline = tag,
      iN = NA_character_
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(iDA, Baseline, iN)
  
  flows_in <- lost_ppis_clean |>
    dplyr::filter(neuron == "iN") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      iDA = NA_character_,
      Baseline = tag,
      iN = tag
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(iDA, Baseline, iN)
  
  # Combine - each row represents ONE lost PPI
  sankey_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(flows_ida, flows_in)
  
  # Convert to long format
  df_long <- sankey_data |>
    make_long(iDA, Baseline, iN)
  
  # Determine position and organelle for coloring
  df_long <- df_long |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      position = dplyr::case_when(
        x == "iDA" ~ "iDA",
        x == "Baseline" ~ "Baseline",
        x == "iN" ~ "iN",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      organelle = node
    )
  
  # Create color palette for organelles using RdYlBu
  unique_organelles <- unique(df_long$organelle[!is.na(df_long$organelle)])
  n_org <- length(unique_organelles)
  
  organelle_colors <- setNames(
    colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdYlBu")))(n_org),
    unique_organelles
  )
  
  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = x, 
                           next_x = next_x, 
                           node = node, 
                           next_node = next_node, 
                           fill = organelle,
                           label = node)) +
    geom_sankey(
      flow.fill = "grey70",       
      flow.alpha = 0.4,           
      flow.color = NA,            
      space = 1,                  
      width = 0.2,                
      node.color = "black",       
      smooth = 8                  
    ) +
    geom_sankey_text(size = 2.5, color = "black", hjust = -0.1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = organelle_colors, na.value = "grey90") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("iDA", "Baseline", "iN")) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Lost PPIs in", genotype_name, ": iDA ← Baseline → iN"),
      subtitle = paste("Organelles with ≥", min_ppis, "lost PPIs shown"),
      fill = "Organelle"
    ) +
    theme_sankey(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, face = "plain"),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "plain", size = 8),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 6, color = "grey40")
    )
  
  if (save) {
    # Clean genotype name for filename
    safe_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", genotype_name)
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plots/by_ko", paste0("sankey_ppi_loss_", safe_name, ".pdf")),p, width = 11, height = 8, device = cairo_pdf)
    message("Sankey plot saved for ", genotype_name)
  }
  
  return(p)
}


# --- Step 2: Loop through all genotypes ---
plot_all_genotype_sankeys <- function(df_states, shared_long, out_dir, 
                                      min_ppis = 10, save = TRUE) {
  
  # Get all unique genotypes
  all_genotypes <- unique(df_states$genotype)
  all_genotypes <- sort(all_genotypes)
  
  message("Creating Sankey plots for ", length(all_genotypes), " genotypes...")
  
  # Create plots for each genotype
  plot_list <- list()
  
  for (geno in all_genotypes) {
    p <- plot_ppi_loss_sankey_per_genotype(
      df_states = df_states,
      shared_long = shared_long,
      genotype_name = geno,
      out_dir = out_dir,
      min_ppis = min_ppis,
      save = save
    )
    
    if (!is.null(p)) {
      plot_list[[geno]] <- p
    }
  }
  
  message("\nCompleted ", length(plot_list), " Sankey plots!")
  
  return(invisible(plot_list))
}


# --- Step 3: Optional - Create summary table of PPI loss by genotype ---
summarize_ppi_loss_by_genotype <- function(df_states, shared_long, out_dir) {
  
  lost_ppis <- df_states |>
    dplyr::filter(state == "lost") |>
    dplyr::select(key, genotype, neuron) |>
    dplyr::inner_join(shared_long, by = "key") |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag))
  
  # Summary per genotype × neuron × organelle
  summary_table <- lost_ppis |>
    dplyr::count(genotype, neuron, tag, name = "n_lost") |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = neuron,
      values_from = n_lost,
      values_fill = 0
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      total = iDA + iN,
      iDA_fraction = iDA / total,
      iN_fraction = iN / total,
      diff = iN - iDA
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(genotype, desc(total))
  
  write_csv(
    summary_table,
    file.path(out_dir, "tables", "Sankey_ppi_loss_summary_by_genotype_organelle.csv")
  )
  
  message("Summary table saved!")
  
  return(summary_table)
}
```

# Ternary plots of PPI loss by organelle class and disease class
## Triangle Plots for user-given select 3 annotations
```{r}
# --- Ternary plots of PPI loss by organelle class and disease class ---

# Generates ternary plots showing PPI loss composition ACROSS THREE ANNOTATIONS
# 3-way combinations of specified annotation tags 
# Each plot shows how lost PPIs
# Plots are distributed among three annotation categories, faceted by disease class and neuron type.

# --------- For select 3 annotations --------- 

# --- Step 0: load R libraray for ternary graph plotting
# https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/Ternary/vignettes/Ternary.html
library(Ternary)

# --- Step 1: define function that plots for any given three annotations the ternary plot.  
plot_ternary_ppi_loss <- function(df_states, shared_long, disease_class_df,
                                   out_dir, disease_class_palette,
                                   tern_classes = c("SynGO", "Mito", "EndoLyso")) {
  
  # Create output directory for ternary plots
  tern_out_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "plots/ternary")
  dir.create(tern_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  # Create filename suffix from tern_classes
  tern_suffix <- paste(tern_classes, collapse = "_")
  
  # Prepare disease class mapping
  disease_map <- disease_class_df |>
    dplyr::mutate(sample = toupper(sample)) |>
    dplyr::select(sample, DiseaseClass) |>
    dplyr::distinct()
  
  # Filter shared_long directly by ternary tags
  shared_class <- shared_long |>
    dplyr::filter(tag %in% tern_classes) |>
    dplyr::rename(class = tag) |>
    dplyr::distinct(key, class)
  
  # Count lost PPIs per KO x neuron x ternary class
  lost_edges <- df_states |>
    dplyr::filter(state == "lost") |>
    dplyr::select(key, genotype, neuron, DiseaseClass) |>
    dplyr::distinct()
  
  # Join with annotation classes
  lost_by_class <- lost_edges |>
    dplyr::inner_join(shared_class, by = "key", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, DiseaseClass, class) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n_lost = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Pivot to wide format
  loss_wide <- lost_by_class |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = class, values_from = n_lost, values_fill = 0)
  
  # Ensure all three columns exist
  for (tc in tern_classes) {
    if (!tc %in% names(loss_wide)) loss_wide[[tc]] <- 0
  }
  
  # Compute proportions
  loss_wide <- loss_wide |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      total = .data[[tern_classes[1]]] + .data[[tern_classes[2]]] + .data[[tern_classes[3]]],
      p_1 = .data[[tern_classes[1]]] / total,
      p_2 = .data[[tern_classes[2]]] / total,
      p_3 = .data[[tern_classes[3]]] / total
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(total > 0, !is.na(DiseaseClass))
  
  message("Ternary data: ", nrow(loss_wide), " KO x neuron combinations")
  message("Disease classes: ", paste(unique(loss_wide$DiseaseClass), collapse = ", "))
  
  # White to red color palette for contours
  contour_cols <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(100)
  
  # --- Plot 1: Combined ternary ---
  pdf(file.path(tern_out_dir, paste0("ternary_combined_", tern_suffix, ".pdf")), width = 6, height = 6)
  TernaryPlot(alab = tern_classes[1], 
              blab = tern_classes[2], 
              clab = tern_classes[3],
              lab.cex = 0.8, 
              grid.lines = 5, 
              grid.lty = "dashed",
              grid.minor.lines = 0,
              axis.cex = 0.6, main = "PPI loss composition - all neurons")
  cols <- disease_class_palette[as.character(loss_wide$DiseaseClass)]
  pch_vec <- ifelse(loss_wide$neuron == "iN", 19, 17)  
  TernaryPoints(loss_wide[, c("p_1", "p_2", "p_3")], 
                col = cols, 
                pch = pch_vec, 
                cex = 1.2)
  legend("topright", legend = names(disease_class_palette), fill = disease_class_palette, cex = 0.5, bty = "n", title = "Disease Class")
  legend("bottomright", legend = c("iN", "iDA"), pch = c(19, 17), cex = 0.6, bty = "n", title = "Neuron")
  dev.off()
  
  
  # --- Plot 2: Faceted grid ---
  # Only include disease classes with >= 3 genotypes per neuron
  disease_class_counts <- loss_wide |>
    dplyr::group_by(DiseaseClass, neuron) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n_geno = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::filter(n_geno >= 3) |>
    dplyr::distinct(DiseaseClass) |>
    dplyr::pull(DiseaseClass)
  
  disease_classes <- intersect(unique(loss_wide$DiseaseClass), disease_class_counts)
  neuron_types <- c("iN", "iDA")
  n_dc <- length(disease_classes)
  
  if (n_dc > 0) {
    pdf(file.path(tern_out_dir, paste0("ternary_faceted_", tern_suffix, ".pdf")), width = 3 * n_dc, height = 6)
    par(mfrow = c(2, n_dc), mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1))
    
    for (nt in neuron_types) {
      for (dc in disease_classes) {
        dd <- loss_wide |> dplyr::filter(neuron == nt, DiseaseClass == dc)
        
        TernaryPlot(alab = tern_classes[1], 
                    blab = tern_classes[2], 
                    clab = tern_classes[3],
                    lab.cex = 0.5, 
                    grid.lines = 4, # number of gridlines 
                    grid.lty = "dashed",
                    grid.minor.lines = 0,
                    axis.cex = 0.5, main = paste0(dc, "\n(", nt, ")"))
        
        if (nrow(dd) >= 3) {
          coords <- as.matrix(dd[, c("p_1", "p_2", "p_3")])
          
          # Density contour if enough points
          if (nrow(coords) >= 5) {
              tryCatch({
                TernaryDensityContour(coords, resolution = 50, col = viridisLite::viridis, nlevels = 10, lwd = 0.25, labcex = 0.4)
              }, error = function(e) NULL)
            }
          
          # Red dots and labels
          TernaryPoints(coords, pch = 19, cex = 0.8, col = "red")
          TernaryText(coords, labels = dd$genotype, cex = 0.5, pos = 3, offset = 0.3)
        }
      }
    }
    dev.off()
  }
  
  # Save summary
  write_csv(loss_wide, file.path(tern_out_dir, paste0("ternary_loss_summary_", tern_suffix, ".csv")))
  
  invisible(loss_wide)
}
```

## Triangle Plots across all annotations
```{r}
# --- Ternary plots of PPI loss by organelle class and disease class ---

# Generates ternary plots showing PPI loss composition ALL ANNOTATIONS / SELECT PLURALITY
# 3-way combinations of specified annotation tags. 
# Each plot shows how lost PPIs
# Plots are distributed among three annotation categories, faceted by disease class and neuron type.

# The contour numbers (1, 2, 3...) are just relative density units - higher = more KOs in that region.
# The dark contours at top show that multiple KOs in this disease class cluster together with similar loss profiles (high EarlyEndosome, low SVfusion/MitoIMS)
# So essentially calculate the relative skew per annotation for the disease class genotypes between the three annotations. and then this is expressed as the density contours


# --------- Across all possible annotations combinations / plurality --------- 

# --- Step 1: define function that plots for any given annotations the ternary plot.  
plot_all_ternary_combinations <- function(df_states, shared_long, disease_class_df,
                                           out_dir, disease_class_palette,
                                           tags = NULL) {
  
 # --- Setup ---
  # Get available tags from shared_long if not specified
  if (is.null(tags)) {
    tags <- unique(shared_long$tag)
  }
  
  # Create subfolder for all combinations
  combo_out_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "plots/ternary/all_combinations")
  dir.create(combo_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  # Generate all 3-way combinations: choose(n_tags, 3)
  combos <- combn(tags, 3, simplify = FALSE)
  n_combos <- length(combos)
  
  message("Generating ", n_combos, " ternary plots from ", length(tags), " tags...")
  
  # --- Loop through each 3-way combination ---
  for (i in seq_along(combos)) {
    tern_classes <- combos[[i]]
    tern_suffix <- paste(tern_classes, collapse = "_")
    
    message("[", i, "/", n_combos, "] ", tern_suffix)
    
    tryCatch({
      
      # --- Data preparation ---
      # Filter shared_long to edges annotated with any of the 3 tags
      shared_class <- shared_long |>
        dplyr::filter(tag %in% tern_classes) |>
        dplyr::rename(class = tag) |>
        dplyr::distinct(key, class)
      
      # Skip if no edges match these tags
      if (nrow(shared_class) == 0) {
        message("  Skipped: no matching edges")
        next
      }
      
      # Prepare disease class mapping (uppercase to match genotype format)
      disease_map <- disease_class_df |>
        dplyr::mutate(sample = toupper(sample)) |>
        dplyr::select(sample, DiseaseClass) |>
        dplyr::distinct()
      
      # Get all lost edges with their metadata
      lost_edges <- df_states |>
        dplyr::filter(state == "lost") |>
        dplyr::select(key, genotype, neuron, DiseaseClass) |>
        dplyr::distinct()
      
      # Count lost PPIs per KO x neuron x annotation class
      # Note: one edge can belong to multiple classes (many-to-many join)
      lost_by_class <- lost_edges |>
        dplyr::inner_join(shared_class, by = "key", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
        dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, DiseaseClass, class) |>
        dplyr::summarise(n_lost = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
      
      # Pivot to wide format: one row per KO x neuron, columns for each tag count
      loss_wide <- lost_by_class |>
        tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = class, values_from = n_lost, values_fill = 0)
      
      # Ensure all three tag columns exist (fill with 0 if missing)
      for (tc in tern_classes) {
        if (!tc %in% names(loss_wide)) loss_wide[[tc]] <- 0
      }
      
      # Compute ternary proportions (must sum to 1)
      loss_wide <- loss_wide |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          total = .data[[tern_classes[1]]] + .data[[tern_classes[2]]] + .data[[tern_classes[3]]],
          p_1 = .data[[tern_classes[1]]] / total,
          p_2 = .data[[tern_classes[2]]] / total,
          p_3 = .data[[tern_classes[3]]] / total
        ) |>
        dplyr::filter(total > 0, !is.na(DiseaseClass))
      
      # Skip if insufficient data points
      if (nrow(loss_wide) < 3) {
        message("  Skipped: insufficient data")
        next
      }
      
      # --- Filter disease classes ---
      # Only include disease classes with >= 3 genotypes in at least one neuron type
      disease_class_counts <- loss_wide |>
        dplyr::group_by(DiseaseClass, neuron) |>
        dplyr::summarise(n_geno = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
        dplyr::filter(n_geno >= 3) |>
        dplyr::distinct(DiseaseClass) |>
        dplyr::pull(DiseaseClass)
      
      disease_classes <- intersect(unique(loss_wide$DiseaseClass), disease_class_counts)
      neuron_types <- c("iN", "iDA")
      n_dc <- length(disease_classes)
      
      # Skip if no disease classes pass filter
      if (n_dc == 0) {
        message("  Skipped: no disease classes with >= 3 genotypes")
        next
      }
      
      # --- Generate faceted ternary plot ---
      # Layout: rows = neuron types (iN, iDA), columns = disease classes
      pdf(file.path(combo_out_dir, paste0("ternary_", tern_suffix, ".pdf")), width = 3 * n_dc, height = 7)
      par(mfrow = c(2, n_dc), mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1), oma = c(0, 0, 3, 0))
      
      for (nt in neuron_types) {
        for (dc in disease_classes) {
          dd <- loss_wide |> dplyr::filter(neuron == nt, DiseaseClass == dc)
          
          # Draw ternary axes
          TernaryPlot(alab = tern_classes[1], 
                      blab = tern_classes[2], 
                      clab = tern_classes[3],
                      lab.cex = 0.5, 
                      grid.lines = 4,
                      grid.lty = "dashed",
                      grid.col = "skyblue",
                      grid.lwd = 0.25,
                      grid.minor.lines = 0,
                      axis.cex = 0.5, 
                      main = paste0(dc, "\n(", nt, ")"))
          
          # Plot data if >= 3 points
          if (nrow(dd) >= 3) {
            coords <- as.matrix(dd[, c("p_1", "p_2", "p_3")])
            
            # Add density contours if >= 3 points
            # add genotype dots in red and also a heatmap (white to dark grey under it)
            if (nrow(coords) >= 3) {
              tryCatch({
                TernaryDensityContour(coords, 
                                      resolution = 50, 
                                      col = function(n) grey.colors(n, start = 1, end = 0.1),
                                      filled = TRUE,
                                      nlevels = 10, 
                                      lwd = 0.25, 
                                      labcex = 0.3)
              }, error = function(e) NULL)
            }
            
            # Overlay KO points and labels
            TernaryPoints(coords, pch = 19, cex = 0.8, col = "red")
            TernaryText(coords, labels = dd$genotype, cex = 0.5, pos = 3, offset = 0.3, col = "red")
          }
        }
      }
      
      # Add overall title
      mtext("Each KO positioned by its % lost PPIs in each annotation. Darker regions = more KOs with similar loss profiles.", 
      outer = TRUE, cex = 0.6, line = 0.5)
      dev.off()
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("  Error: ", e$message)
    })
  }
  
  message("Done. ", n_combos, " combinations processed. Output: ", combo_out_dir)
}


# --- Step 2: Call functions to iterate over the plotting call
# # All combinations from all tags ==> do not do that. will be 25^3 ==> 2300 plots
# plot_all_ternary_combinations(
#   df_states = ko_edge_states,
#   shared_long = shared_long,
#   disease_class_df = disease_class_df,
#   out_dir = out_dir_ppi_vuln,
#   disease_class_palette = disease_class_palette
# )

# Run only on specified subset of tags
plot_all_ternary_combinations(

  out_dir = out_dir_ppi_vuln,

)
```

# GO functional enrichment of lost PPIs on a KO x neuron level
```{r}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# GO term enrichment on proteins involved in lost PPIs per KO × neuron
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# min of 5 lost PPIs per ontology
# focus on Biological process (BP)
# top_30 PPIs lost per KO x neuron

# --- Step 0: Create output directories ---
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/GO"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/GO"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Load required packages
if (!requireNamespace("topGO", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'topGO' is required. Install from Bioconductor:\n",
       "BiocManager::install('topGO')")
}
if (!requireNamespace("org.Hs.eg.db", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'org.Hs.eg.db' is required. Install from Bioconductor:\n",
       "BiocManager::install('org.Hs.eg.db')")
}

library(topGO)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)


# --- Step 1: Define GO enrichment function ---
run_GO_enrichment_for_lost_ppis <- function(gene_set, 
                                             background_genes, 
                                             tag = "KO_neuron", 
                                             out_dir,
                                             ontology = "BP",
                                             top_n = 30) {
  
  # Check if gene set is empty
  if (length(gene_set) < 3) {
    message("Insufficient genes (<3) for ", tag, "; skipping GO enrichment.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Step 1.1: Create geneList for topGO
  geneList <- factor(as.integer(background_genes %in% gene_set))
  names(geneList) <- background_genes
  
  message("  Running GO enrichment for ", tag, " (", length(gene_set), " genes)...")
  
  # Step 1.2: Run topGO Fisher test
  GOdata <- new("topGOdata",
                ontology = ontology,
                allGenes = geneList,
                geneSel = function(x) x == 1,
                annot = annFUN.org,
                mapping = "org.Hs.eg.db",
                ID = "symbol",
                nodeSize = 5)  # Minimum 5 genes per GO term
  
  resultFisher <- runTest(GOdata, algorithm = "elim", statistic = "fisher")
  
  # Step 1.3: Generate GO table
  go_table <- GenTable(GOdata, elimFisher = resultFisher, topNodes = top_n)
  
  # Handle cases where no significant terms found
  if (nrow(go_table) == 0) {
    message("  No significant GO terms found for ", tag)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  go_table <- go_table %>%
    mutate(
      raw_pval     = score(resultFisher)[GO.ID],
      Significant  = as.numeric(Significant),
      Expected     = as.numeric(Expected),
      Enrichment   = ifelse(Expected > 0, Significant / Expected, NA),
      log10P       = -log10(raw_pval),
      tag          = tag
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(raw_pval), !is.na(Enrichment)) %>%
    arrange(raw_pval) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10)
  
  # Step 1.4: Get associated genes per GO term
  go_genes <- genesInTerm(GOdata)
  go_table$Genes <- sapply(go_table$GO.ID, function(go_id) {
    intersect(go_genes[[go_id]], gene_set) %>% paste(collapse = ";")
  })
  
  # Step 1.5: Save GO term table
  write_csv(go_table, file = file.path(out_dir, paste0("GO_results_", tag, ".csv")))
  
  # Step 1.6: Plot dot plot (only if we have results)
  if (nrow(go_table) > 0) {
    p <- ggplot(go_table, aes(x = Enrichment, y = reorder(Term, Enrichment))) +
      geom_point(aes(size = log10P, fill = Enrichment), 
                 shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.25) +
      scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "firebrick") +
      scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8)) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
      labs(
        x = "Fold Enrichment",
        y = "GO Term",
        size = expression(-log[10]*"P"),
        title = paste0("Top GO Terms: ", tag)
      ) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)
      )
    
    # save pdf of GO dot plot per KO x neuron type
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("GO_dotplot_", tag, ".pdf")), p, width = 6, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
  }
  
  return(go_table)
}


# --- Step 2: Extract proteins involved in lost PPIs per KO × neuron ---
# Get unique proteins from lost edges
proteins_in_lost_ppis <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::filter(state == "lost") %>%
  dplyr::select(genotype, neuron, Gene1, Gene2) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(Gene1, Gene2), names_to = "partner", values_to = "Gene") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Gene)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(genotype, neuron, Gene)

# --- Exclude Nucleus-annotated genes before GO analysis ---
# Identify all Nucleus genes from long_subcell_df
nucleus_genes <- long_subcell_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(Localization == "Nucleus") %>%
  dplyr::pull(Genes) %>%
  unique()

# Remove them from ko_edge_states-based background
ko_edge_states <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(Gene1 %in% nucleus_genes | Gene2 %in% nucleus_genes))

message("Excluded ", length(nucleus_genes), " Nucleus-annotated genes from GO evaluation.")

# Background: all neuronal genes in the network (now without Nucleus)
background_genes <- unique(c(ko_edge_states$Gene1, ko_edge_states$Gene2))
background_genes <- background_genes[!is.na(background_genes)]

message("Background genes: ", length(background_genes))


# --- Step 3: Run GO enrichment for each KO × neuron ---
ko_neuron_combos <- proteins_in_lost_ppis %>%
  dplyr::distinct(genotype, neuron)

go_results_all <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(ko_neuron_combos))) {
  geno <- ko_neuron_combos$genotype[i]
  nt   <- ko_neuron_combos$neuron[i]
  
  # Get genes involved in lost PPIs for this KO × neuron
  genes_lost <- proteins_in_lost_ppis %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype == geno, neuron == nt) %>%
    dplyr::pull(Gene) %>%
    unique()
  
  tag <- paste0(geno, "_", nt)
  
  # Run GO enrichment
  go_res <- run_GO_enrichment_for_lost_ppis(
    gene_set = genes_lost,
    background_genes = background_genes,
    tag = tag,
    out_dir = file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/GO"),
    ontology = "BP"
  )
  
  if (!is.null(go_res)) {
    go_results_all[[tag]] <- go_res
  }
}

# Combine all results
go_results_combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(go_results_all)

# save combined csv file
write_csv(go_results_combined,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/GO", "GO_results_all_KO_neuron.csv"))

message("GO enrichment complete! Processed ", length(go_results_all), " KO × neuron combinations.")


# --- Step 4: Compare GO terms between iN and iDA ---
# Find common GO terms across neuron types
go_comparison <- go_results_combined %>%
  dplyr::select(GO.ID, Term, tag, Enrichment, log10P) %>%
  tidyr::separate(tag, into = c("genotype", "neuron"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(GO.ID, Term) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_KOs = n_distinct(genotype),
    n_iN = sum(neuron == "iN"),
    n_iDA = sum(neuron == "iDA"),
    mean_enrichment = mean(Enrichment, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_log10P = max(log10P, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_KOs), desc(mean_enrichment))

# save csv
write_csv(go_comparison,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/GO", "GO_comparison_iN_vs_iDA.csv"))

# Plot: Top GO terms shared across KOs
top_shared_go <- go_comparison %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_KOs >= 3) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 15)

if (nrow(top_shared_go) > 0) {
  p_shared <- ggplot(top_shared_go, 
                     aes(x = mean_enrichment, y = reorder(Term, mean_enrichment))) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = max_log10P), color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "firebrick", name = expression(-log[10]*"P")) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=", n_KOs)), hjust = -0.2, size = 2.5) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    labs(
      x = "Mean Fold Enrichment",
      y = "GO Term",
      title = "Top GO terms disrupted across multiple KOs"
    ) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)
    )
  
  # save pdf
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/GO", "GO_shared_across_KOs.pdf"),p_shared, width = 7, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
}


# --- Step 5: Heatmap of GO term enrichment across KOs ---
# Pivot for heatmap
go_heatmap_data <- go_results_combined %>%
  dplyr::select(GO.ID, Term, tag, Enrichment) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = tag, values_from = Enrichment, values_fill = 0) %>%
  dplyr::filter(rowSums(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric))) > 0)

# Limit to top GO terms (present in multiple KOs)
go_term_counts <- go_results_combined %>%
  dplyr::count(GO.ID, Term) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 30)

go_heatmap_subset <- go_heatmap_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(GO.ID %in% go_term_counts$GO.ID)

if (nrow(go_heatmap_subset) >= 3) {
  go_mat <- as.matrix(go_heatmap_subset[, -c(1:2)])
  rownames(go_mat) <- go_heatmap_subset$Term
  
  # Shorten GO term names for readability

    color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "orange", "firebrick"))(100),
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,
    fontsize = 6,
    cellwidth = 10,
    cellheight = 10,
    border_color = NA,
    main = "GO term enrichment across KO × neuron",
    filename = file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/GO", "heatmap_GO_enrichment_all.pdf"),
    width = 12,
    height = 10
  )
}


# --- Step 6: Disease class-specific GO enrichment ---
proteins_by_disease <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::filter(state == "lost", !is.na(DiseaseClass)) %>%
  dplyr::select(DiseaseClass, genotype, neuron, Gene1, Gene2) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(Gene1, Gene2), values_to = "Gene") %>%

disease_classes <- unique(proteins_by_disease$DiseaseClass)

for (dc in disease_classes) {
```

# Trimer & Multimer PPI Analysis
## Trimer PPI complex analysis
```{r}
# --------- Trimer identification and vulnerability analysis ---------
# --- Step 0: Create output directories ---
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/multimer"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Step 1: Filter to NEURONAL high-confidence PPIs only ---
conf_threshold <- 0.95

# Get neuronal genes (same as used in ko_edge_states)
neuronal_genes <- unique(c(ko_edge_states$Gene1, ko_edge_states$Gene2))
neuronal_genes <- neuronal_genes[!is.na(neuronal_genes)]

message("Number of neuronal genes: ", length(neuronal_genes))

# Filter high-confidence edges to neuronal proteome
high_conf_edges <- baseline_edges_union |>
  dplyr::filter(
    Predictome_conf >= conf_threshold,
    Gene1 %in% neuronal_genes,
    Gene2 %in% neuronal_genes
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(key, Gene1, Gene2, Predictome_conf)

message("High-confidence neuronal edges (≥", conf_threshold, "): ", nrow(high_conf_edges))

# If too few, reduce threshold
if (nrow(high_conf_edges) < 100) {
  conf_threshold <- 0.90
  high_conf_edges <- baseline_edges_union |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Predictome_conf >= conf_threshold,
      Gene1 %in% neuronal_genes,
      Gene2 %in% neuronal_genes
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(key, Gene1, Gene2, Predictome_conf)
  message("Reduced threshold to ", conf_threshold, ": ", nrow(high_conf_edges), " edges")
}

if (nrow(high_conf_edges) < 50) {
  conf_threshold <- 0.85
  high_conf_edges <- baseline_edges_union |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Predictome_conf >= conf_threshold,
      Gene1 %in% neuronal_genes,
      Gene2 %in% neuronal_genes
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(key, Gene1, Gene2, Predictome_conf)
  message("Further reduced threshold to ", conf_threshold, ": ", nrow(high_conf_edges), " edges")
}

# Save high confidence dimers
write_csv(high_conf_edges, file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables", "high_confidence_dimers.csv"))


# --- Step 2: Find all potential trimers (A-B, B-C, A-C all present) ---
# Create adjacency list
edges_df <- high_conf_edges |>
  dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2) |>
  dplyr::distinct()

message("Starting trimer search...")

# Find trimers: for each pair A-B, find all C where B-C and A-C both exist
trimers_list <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(edges_df))) {
  if (i %% 100 == 0) message("  Processed ", i, "/", nrow(edges_df), " edges...")
  
  A <- edges_df$Gene1[i]
  B <- edges_df$Gene2[i]
  
  # Find all C connected to B
  C_via_B <- edges_df |>
    dplyr::filter((Gene1 == B & Gene2 != A) | (Gene2 == B & Gene1 != A)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(C = ifelse(Gene1 == B, Gene2, Gene1)) |>
    dplyr::pull(C) |>
    unique()
  
  if (length(C_via_B) == 0) next
  
  # Check if A-C edge exists for each C
  for (C in C_via_B) {
    ac_exists <- any(
      (edges_df$Gene1 == A & edges_df$Gene2 == C) |
      (edges_df$Gene1 == C & edges_df$Gene2 == A)
    )
    
    if (ac_exists) {
      # Found a trimer! Sort genes to avoid duplicates
      trimer <- sort(c(A, B, C))
      trimer_id <- paste(trimer, collapse = "::")
      trimers_list[[trimer_id]] <- trimer
    }
  }
}

message("Trimer search complete!")

# Convert to dataframe
trimers_baseline <- tibble::tibble(
  trimer_id = names(trimers_list),
  GeneA = sapply(trimers_list, `[`, 1),
  GeneB = sapply(trimers_list, `[`, 2),
  GeneC = sapply(trimers_list, `[`, 3)
)

message("Total trimers found in neuronal baseline: ", nrow(trimers_baseline))

# Save baseline trimers
write_csv(trimers_baseline, file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "baseline_trimers.csv"))


# --- Step 3: Add organelle annotations to trimers ---
gene_to_org <- binary_matrix |>
  dplyr::select(Genes, all_of(organelle_tags))

trimers_annotated <- trimers_baseline |>
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_org, by = c("GeneA" = "Genes")) |>
  dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_A"), all_of(organelle_tags)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_org, by = c("GeneB" = "Genes")) |>
  dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_B"), all_of(organelle_tags)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_org, by = c("GeneC" = "Genes")) |>
  dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_C"), all_of(organelle_tags))

# Determine shared organelle(s) - all three proteins must be in same organelle
trimers_annotated <- trimers_annotated |>
  dplyr::rowwise() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    shared_organelle = {
      org_A <- organelle_tags[which(c_across(paste0(organelle_tags, "_A")))]
      org_B <- organelle_tags[which(c_across(paste0(organelle_tags, "_B")))]
      org_C <- organelle_tags[which(c_across(paste0(organelle_tags, "_C")))]
      
      shared <- Reduce(intersect, list(org_A, org_B, org_C))
      if (length(shared) == 0) "Other" else paste(shared, collapse = ";")
    }
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Summary by organelle
trimer_org_summary <- trimers_annotated |>
  tidyr::separate_rows(shared_organelle, sep = ";") |>
  dplyr::count(shared_organelle, name = "n_trimers") |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_trimers))

message("Trimers by organelle:")
print(trimer_org_summary)

write_csv(trimer_org_summary, file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "baseline_trimers_by_organelle.csv"))



# --- Step 4: Assess trimer integrity per KO × neuron ---
# 4a. Build UniProt→Gene mapping from ko_edge_states
uniprot_to_gene <- ko_edge_states |>
  dplyr::select(Protein1, Gene1) |>
  dplyr::rename(Uniprot = Protein1, Gene = Gene1) |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    ko_edge_states |>
      dplyr::select(Protein2, Gene2) |>
      dplyr::rename(Uniprot = Protein2, Gene = Gene2) |>
      dplyr::distinct()
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct(Uniprot, Gene)

message("UniProt→Gene mapping entries: ", nrow(uniprot_to_gene))


# 4b. Convert ko_ppi_profiles (UniProt keys) to gene-based keys
ko_ppi_profiles_genes <- ko_ppi_profiles |>
  tidyr::separate(key, into = c("UniprotA", "UniprotB"), sep = "::", remove = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::left_join(uniprot_to_gene, by = c("UniprotA" = "Uniprot")) |>
  dplyr::rename(GeneA = Gene) |>
  dplyr::left_join(uniprot_to_gene, by = c("UniprotB" = "Uniprot")) |>
  dplyr::rename(GeneB = Gene) |>
  dplyr::mutate(key_gene = .make_undirected_key(GeneA, GeneB)) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(key_gene))

message("Converted ko_ppi_profiles to gene-level edges: ", nrow(ko_ppi_profiles_genes))


# 4c. Prepare trimer edges
trimers_with_keys <- trimers_annotated |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(GeneA) & !is.na(GeneB) & !is.na(GeneC)) |>
  dplyr::filter(rowSums(is.na(dplyr::across(where(is.logical)))) < ncol(dplyr::across(where(is.logical)))) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    key_AB = .make_undirected_key(GeneA, GeneB),
    key_BC = .make_undirected_key(GeneB, GeneC),
    key_AC = .make_undirected_key(GeneA, GeneC)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(key_AB) & !is.na(key_BC) & !is.na(key_AC))

message("Removed ", nrow(trimers_annotated) - nrow(trimers_with_keys), " trimers with missing edges.")


# 4d. Expand to all KO × neuron contexts
ko_neuron_combos <- ko_ppi_profiles_genes |>
  dplyr::distinct(genotype, neuron)

trimers_expanded <- trimers_with_keys |>
  tidyr::crossing(ko_neuron_combos)

message("Joining edge states for trimers...")


# 4e. Join KO×neuron-level edge states (gene-based)
trimers_ko_states <- trimers_expanded |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    ko_ppi_profiles_genes |> dplyr::select(key_gene, genotype, neuron, state),
    by = c("key_AB" = "key_gene", "genotype", "neuron")
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(state_AB = state) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    ko_ppi_profiles_genes |> dplyr::select(key_gene, genotype, neuron, state),
    by = c("key_BC" = "key_gene", "genotype", "neuron")
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(state_BC = state) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    ko_ppi_profiles_genes |> dplyr::select(key_gene, genotype, neuron, state),
    by = c("key_AC" = "key_gene", "genotype", "neuron")
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(state_AC = state) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    state_AB = tidyr::replace_na(state_AB, "retained"),
    state_BC = tidyr::replace_na(state_BC, "retained"),
    state_AC = tidyr::replace_na(state_AC, "retained"),
    n_lost = (state_AB == "lost") + (state_BC == "lost") + (state_AC == "lost"),
    trimer_state = dplyr::case_when(
      n_lost >= 2 ~ "broken",
      n_lost == 1 ~ "partial",
      n_lost == 0 ~ "intact",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    )
  )

message("Edge states joined successfully!")


# Save detailed trimer states
write_csv(trimers_ko_states,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "trimers_ko_states.csv"))


# --- Step 5: Summary: broken trimers per KO × neuron ---
trimer_ko_summary <- trimers_ko_states |>
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_intact = sum(trimer_state == "intact", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_broken = sum(trimer_state == "broken", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_partial = sum(trimer_state == "partial", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_unknown = sum(trimer_state == "unknown", na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_broken = n_broken / n_total,
    frac_partial = n_partial / n_total,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(frac_broken))

write_csv(trimer_ko_summary,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "trimer_ko_summary.csv"))

message("Trimer breakage summary:")
print(trimer_ko_summary)


# --- Step 5b: Affected trimers by organelle × KO × neuron ---
# Collapse to one row per trimer per KO×neuron
trimers_affected <- trimers_ko_states |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    trimer_affected = ifelse(n_lost >= 1, "affected", "intact")
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct(genotype, neuron, trimer_id, shared_organelle, trimer_affected)

# Count affected vs intact trimers per organelle × KO × neuron
trimer_affected_org_ko <- trimers_affected |>
  tidyr::separate_rows(shared_organelle, sep = ";") |>
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, shared_organelle, trimer_affected) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_trimers = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = trimer_affected,
    values_from = n_trimers,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    total = affected + intact,
    frac_affected = affected / total
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(frac_affected))

write_csv(trimer_affected_org_ko,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "trimer_affected_by_organelle_ko.csv"))

# Summarize across all KOs
trimer_affected_by_org <- trimer_affected_org_ko |>
  dplyr::group_by(shared_organelle) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_affected = sum(affected, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_total = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_affected = n_affected / n_total,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(frac_affected))

write_csv(trimer_affected_by_org,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "trimer_affected_by_organelle_summary.csv"))

message("Affected trimers by organelle (top 20):")
print(head(trimer_affected_org_ko, 20))


# --- Step 6: Broken trimers by organelle × KO × neuron ---
# Broken trimers (2+ edges lost)
trimer_broken_org_ko <- trimers_ko_states |>
  dplyr::filter(trimer_state == "broken") |>
  tidyr::separate_rows(shared_organelle, sep = ";") |>
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, shared_organelle) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_broken = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_broken))

write_csv(trimer_broken_org_ko, file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "trimer_broken_by_organelle_ko.csv"))

# Summary by organelle (across all KOs)
trimer_broken_by_org <- trimer_broken_org_ko |>
  dplyr::group_by(shared_organelle) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_broken = sum(n_broken), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_broken))

write_csv(trimer_broken_by_org,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "trimer_broken_by_organelle_summary.csv"))

# Partial trimers (1 edge lost)
trimer_partial_org_ko <- trimers_ko_states |>
  dplyr::filter(trimer_state == "partial") |>
  tidyr::separate_rows(shared_organelle, sep = ";") |>
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, shared_organelle) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_partial = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_partial))

write_csv(trimer_partial_org_ko,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "trimer_partial_by_organelle_ko.csv"))

# Summary by organelle (across all KOs)
trimer_partial_by_org <- trimer_partial_org_ko |>
  dplyr::group_by(shared_organelle) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_partial = sum(n_partial), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_partial))

write_csv(
  trimer_partial_by_org,
  file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "trimer_partial_by_organelle_summary.csv")
)

message("Broken trimers by organelle (top 20):")
print(head(trimer_broken_org_ko, 20))


# --- Step 7: Visualization - barplot of broken trimers per KO ---
  # Step 7.1: EDGES: Visualization - barplot of broken trimers per KO ---
p_trimer_bar <- ggplot(trimer_ko_summary, aes(x = reorder(genotype, -frac_broken), y = n_broken, fill = neuron)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(iN = "grey60", iDA = "grey80"), name = "Neuron") +
  labs(
    title = "Broken trimers edges per KO",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of broken trimers edges"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
  )

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/multimer", "bars_broken_trimers_per_ko.pdf"),p_trimer_bar, width = 5, height = 4.5, device = cairo_pdf)


  # Step 7b: TRIMERS: Visualization – affected trimers per KO ---
p_trimer_affected_bar <- ggplot(
  trimer_affected_org_ko |> dplyr::filter(shared_organelle != "Other"),
  aes(x = reorder(genotype, -frac_affected), y = affected, fill = neuron)
) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(iN = "grey60", iDA = "grey80"), name = "Neuron") +
  labs(
    title = "Affected trimers per KO",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of affected trimers"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
  )

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/multimer", "bars_affected_trimers_per_ko.pdf"),p_trimer_affected_bar,width = 5, height = 5,device = cairo_pdf)


# --- Step 8: Heatmap - broken trimers by organelle × KO ---
  # Step 8: EDGES: Heatmap - broken trimers by organelle × KO ---
for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {
  trimer_org_wide <- trimer_broken_org_ko |>
    dplyr::filter(neuron == nt) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = shared_organelle,
      values_from = n_broken,
      values_fill = 0
    )
  
  if (nrow(trimer_org_wide) < 2 || ncol(trimer_org_wide) < 3) {
    message("Insufficient data for heatmap (", nt, "); skipping.")
    next
  }
  
  trimer_org_mat <- as.matrix(trimer_org_wide[, -c(1:2)])

  pheatmap::pheatmap(

}

  # Step 8b: TRIMERS: Heatmap – affected trimers by organelle × KO ---
for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {

      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = shared_organelle,
      values_from = n_affected,
      values_fill = 0
    )

  if (nrow(trimer_aff_org_wide) < 2 || ncol(trimer_aff_org_wide) < 3) {
    message("Insufficient data for affected-trimer heatmap (", nt, "); skipping.")
    next
  }

  trimer_aff_mat <- as.matrix(trimer_aff_org_wide[, -1])
  rownames(trimer_aff_mat) <- trimer_aff_org_wide$genotype

  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    trimer_aff_mat,
    scale = "none",
    color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#C51B7D"))(100),
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,
    border_color = NA,

    main = paste("Affected trimers by organelle –", nt),

    width = 10,
    height = 8
  )
}
```

## Multimer Analysis: Dense Subgraph Detection 
```{r}
# --------- Identify protein complexes via community detection ---------
# Find highly interconnected modules using:
# - Louvain community detection
# - Leiden algorithm  
# - MCL (Markov Clustering)
# - Finds real biological complexes, handles partial connectivity
# if 75% of edges lost ==> complex disruped 
# if 25% of edges lost ==> complex affecetd 


# --- Step 0: Load required package ---
if (!requireNamespace("igraph", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'igraph' is required. Install with: install.packages('igraph')")
}
library(igraph)

# --- Step 1: Build baseline network from high-confidence edges ---
message("Building baseline PPI network...")

# Use same high_conf_edges from trimer analysis
baseline_net <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
  d = high_conf_edges |> dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2),
  directed = FALSE,
  vertices = data.frame(name = unique(c(high_conf_edges$Gene1, high_conf_edges$Gene2)))
)

# Add edge weights (confidence scores)
igraph::E(baseline_net)$weight <- high_conf_edges$Predictome_conf

message("Baseline network: ", vcount(baseline_net), " proteins, ", ecount(baseline_net), " edges")


# --- Step 2: Community detection using Louvain algorithm ---
message("Running Louvain community detection...")

louvain_communities <- igraph::cluster_louvain(
  baseline_net,
  weights = igraph::E(baseline_net)$weight
)

# Extract community assignments - convert to integer
protein_communities <- data.frame(
  Gene = igraph::V(baseline_net)$name,
  community_id = as.integer(igraph::membership(louvain_communities)),  # FIXED: convert to integer
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

message("Found ", max(protein_communities$community_id), " communities")


# --- Step 3: Filter to meaningful complexes (size 3-10) ---
community_sizes <- protein_communities |>
  dplyr::count(community_id, name = "size")

valid_communities <- community_sizes |>
  dplyr::filter(size >= 3, size <= 10) |>
  dplyr::pull(community_id)

message("Communities with 3-10 proteins: ", length(valid_communities))

complexes_baseline <- protein_communities |>
  dplyr::filter(community_id %in% valid_communities) |>
  dplyr::arrange(community_id, Gene)

complexes_baseline <- complexes_baseline %>%
  dplyr::mutate(community_id = sprintf("Complex_%04d", as.integer(community_id)))

# Create complex IDs
complexes_baseline <- complexes_baseline %>%
  dplyr::mutate(community_id = as.integer(gsub("Complex_", "", community_id)))

complexes_summary <- complexes_baseline %>%
  dplyr::group_by(community_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    complex_id = paste0("Complex_", sprintf("%04d", community_id[1])),
    n_proteins = n(),
    proteins = paste(Gene, collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_proteins))

# save csv
write_csv(complexes_summary,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "baseline_complexes.csv"))

message("Baseline complexes summary:")
print(head(complexes_summary, 20))


# --- Step 4: Annotate complexes with organelles ---
complexes_annotated <- complexes_baseline |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    protein_communities |> 
      dplyr::left_join(complexes_summary |> dplyr::select(community_id, complex_id), by = "community_id"),
    by = c("Gene", "community_id")
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_org, by = c("Gene" = "Genes"))

# Determine dominant organelle per complex
complex_organelle <- complexes_annotated |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(organelle_tags),
    names_to = "organelle",
    values_to = "present"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(present == TRUE | present == 1) |>
  dplyr::group_by(community_id, organelle) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_proteins = n(), .groups = "drop_last") |>
  dplyr::slice_max(n_proteins, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(organelle = ifelse(is.na(organelle), "Other", organelle))

complexes_summary <- complexes_summary |>
  dplyr::left_join(complex_organelle |> dplyr::select(community_id, organelle), by = "community_id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(organelle = tidyr::replace_na(organelle, "Other"))

# Count by organelle
complex_org_summary <- complexes_summary |>
  dplyr::count(organelle, name = "n_complexes") |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_complexes))

# save csv
write_csv(complex_org_summary,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "baseline_complexes_by_organelle.csv"))

message("Complexes by organelle:")
print(complex_org_summary)


# --- Step 5: Assess complex integrity per KO × neuron ---
message("Assessing complex disruption per KO...")

# Get all edges within each complex
complex_edges_list <- list()

for (cid in valid_communities) {
  complex_genes <- complexes_baseline |>
    dplyr::filter(community_id == cid) |>
    dplyr::pull(Gene)
  
  # Get all edges between proteins in this complex
  complex_edges <- high_conf_edges |>
    dplyr::filter(Gene1 %in% complex_genes, Gene2 %in% complex_genes) |>
    dplyr::mutate(community_id = cid)
  
  complex_edges_list[[as.character(cid)]] <- complex_edges
}

complex_edges_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(complex_edges_list)

# Add complex_id
complex_edges_df <- complex_edges_df |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    complexes_summary |> dplyr::select(community_id, complex_id),
    by = "community_id"
  )

message("Total edges in complexes: ", nrow(complex_edges_df))


# --- Step 6: Match complex edges to KO × neuron states ---
# Convert to gene-based keys
complex_edges_df <- complex_edges_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(key_gene = .make_undirected_key(Gene1, Gene2))

# Expand to all KO × neuron
complexes_expanded <- complex_edges_df |>
  dplyr::select(complex_id, community_id, key_gene) |>
  tidyr::crossing(ko_neuron_combos)

# Join edge states
complexes_ko_states <- complexes_expanded |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    ko_ppi_profiles_genes |> dplyr::select(key_gene, genotype, neuron, state),
    by = c("key_gene", "genotype", "neuron")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    state = tidyr::replace_na(state, "retained"),
    edge_lost = state == "lost"
  )

# Aggregate per complex × KO × neuron
complex_ko_summary <- complexes_ko_states |>
  dplyr::group_by(complex_id, genotype, neuron) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_edges_total = n(),
    n_edges_lost = sum(edge_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_edges_lost = n_edges_lost / n_edges_total,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    complexes_summary |> dplyr::select(complex_id, n_proteins, organelle),
    by = "complex_id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
      complex_state = case_when(
        frac_edges_lost >= 0.75 ~ "disrupted",   # ≥75% edges lost
        frac_edges_lost >= 0.25 ~ "partial",     # 25-75% lost
        TRUE                    ~ "intact"
      )
  )

# save csv
write_csv(complex_ko_summary,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "complexes_ko_states.csv"))


# --- Step 7: Summary statistics ---
# Per KO × neuron
complex_disruption_summary <- complex_ko_summary |>
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_complexes = n(),
    n_intact = sum(complex_state == "intact"),
    n_disrupted = sum(complex_state == "disrupted"),
    n_partial = sum(complex_state == "partial"),
    frac_disrupted = n_disrupted / n_complexes,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(frac_disrupted))

# save csv
write_csv(complex_disruption_summary,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "complex_disruption_summary.csv"))

message("Complex disruption summary:")
print(complex_disruption_summary)


# Per organelle × KO × neuron
complex_org_ko_summary <- complex_ko_summary |>
  dplyr::filter(complex_state == "disrupted", organelle != "Other") |>
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, organelle) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_disrupted = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_disrupted))

write_csv(complex_org_ko_summary,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "complex_disrupted_by_organelle_ko.csv"))

# Summary by organelle
complex_org_disrupted <- complex_org_ko_summary |>
  dplyr::group_by(organelle) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_disrupted = sum(n_disrupted), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_disrupted))

# save csv
write_csv(complex_org_disrupted,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "complex_disrupted_by_organelle_summary.csv"))


# --- Step 8: Visualizations ---
# Barplot: disrupted complexes per KO
p_complex_bar <- ggplot(
  complex_disruption_summary,
  aes(x = reorder(genotype, -frac_disrupted), y = n_disrupted, fill = neuron)
) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(iN = "grey60", iDA = "grey80"), name = "Neuron") +
  labs(
    title = "Disrupted protein complexes per KO",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of disrupted complexes"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
  )

# save plot
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/multimer", "bars_disrupted_complexes_per_ko.pdf"),p_complex_bar, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)


# Heatmap: disrupted complexes by organelle × KO
for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {
  complex_org_wide <- complex_org_ko_summary |>
    dplyr::filter(neuron == nt) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = organelle,
      values_from = n_disrupted,
      values_fill = 0
    )
  
  if (nrow(complex_org_wide) < 2 || ncol(complex_org_wide) < 3) {
    message("Insufficient data for complex heatmap (", nt, "); skipping.")
    next
  }
  
  complex_org_mat <- as.matrix(complex_org_wide[, -c(1:2)])
  rownames(complex_org_mat) <- complex_org_wide$genotype
  
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    complex_org_mat,
    scale = "none",
    color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#C51B7D"))(100),
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,
    border_color = NA,
    fontsize = 6,
    cellwidth = 10,
    cellheight = 10,
    main = paste("Disrupted complexes by organelle –", nt),
    filename = file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/multimer",paste0("heatmap_disrupted_complexes_by_organelle_", nt, ".pdf")),
    width = 10,
    height = 8
  )
}


# --- Step 9: Network visualization of top disrupted complexes (optional) ---
# Visualize the 5 most disrupted complexes
top_disrupted <- complex_ko_summary |>
  dplyr::filter(complex_state == "disrupted") |>
  dplyr::count(complex_id, sort = TRUE) |>
  head(5) |>
  dplyr::pull(complex_id)

for (cid in top_disrupted) {
  # Get complex proteins
  complex_proteins <- complexes_baseline |>

  # Subgraph

message("Complex analysis complete!")
```
