## Barplot for average Disease Class vulnearbility PPI-trimers / PPI-multimers
```{r}
# =========================================================================
# Barplots: Trimer & Complex loss by Disease Class, faceted by annotation
# =========================================================================

# --- Output directories ---
out_dir_trimer_plots <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/multimer/barplots_trimers")
out_dir_complex_plots <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/multimer/barplots_complexes")
out_dir_trimer_tables <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer/barplots_trimers")
out_dir_complex_tables <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer/barplots_complexes")

dir.create(out_dir_trimer_plots, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(out_dir_complex_plots, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(out_dir_trimer_tables, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(out_dir_complex_tables, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Annotations to include ---
selected_annotations <- c(
  "Mito", "MitoIMS", "MitoMatrix", "MitoMIM", "MitoMOM", "OXPHOS",
  "mtComplexI", "Golgi", "Lysosome", "ER", "Cytoplasm", "Nucleus",
  "Autophagy", "SynGO", "Endo_iN_curated_Hundley", "SynapseSVs",
  "Presynaptic", "NeuroDev", "EndoLyso", "EarlyEndosome",
  "RecyclingEndosome", "SVfusion", "Svendocytosis", "Svexocytosis", "vATPase"
)

# --- Disease class map (bare genotype -> DiseaseClass) ---
disease_map <- disease_class_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sample = toupper(gsub("_(iN|iDA)$", "", sample))) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, DiseaseClass) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE)


# =========================================================================
# TRIMERS
# =========================================================================

plot_trimer_diseaseclass_bars <- function(trimers_ko_states, 
                                          disease_map, 
                                          disease_class_palette,
                                          selected_annotations, 
                                          out_dir_plots, 
                                          out_dir_tables) {

  df <- trimers_ko_states %>%
    dplyr::mutate(KO = toupper(genotype)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("KO" = "sample")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(DiseaseClass), !is.na(shared_organelle), shared_organelle != "Other") %>%
    tidyr::separate_rows(shared_organelle, sep = ";") %>%
    dplyr::filter(shared_organelle %in% selected_annotations)

  df$DiseaseClass <- factor(df$DiseaseClass, levels = names(disease_class_palette))
  df$shared_organelle <- factor(df$shared_organelle, levels = selected_annotations)

  n_kos <- df %>% dplyr::distinct(KO, DiseaseClass, neuron) %>% dplyr::count(DiseaseClass, neuron, name = "n_KOs")

  # --- Broken trimers ---
  broken_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(trimer_state == "broken") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(neuron, DiseaseClass, shared_organelle) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(n > 0)

  broken_norm <- broken_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(n_kos, by = c("DiseaseClass", "neuron")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(n_norm = n / n_KOs)

  write_csv(broken_norm, file.path(out_dir_tables, "sourcedata_trimers_broken_by_diseaseclass.csv"))

  for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {
    dd <- broken_norm %>% dplyr::filter(neuron == nt, !is.na(shared_organelle))
    if (nrow(dd) == 0) next

    dd$shared_organelle <- factor(dd$shared_organelle, levels = selected_annotations)
    
    p <- ggplot(dd, aes(x = DiseaseClass, y = n_norm, fill = DiseaseClass)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      facet_wrap(~shared_organelle, ncol = 5, drop = FALSE, scales = "free_y") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = disease_class_palette, drop = FALSE) +
      labs(title = paste("Broken trimers per KO by annotation -", nt), x = NULL, y = "Broken trimers per KO") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)
      )

    ggsave(file.path(out_dir_plots, paste0("bars_trimers_broken_by_diseaseclass_", nt, ".pdf")), p, width = 12, height = 12, device = cairo_pdf)
  }

  # --- Partial trimers ---
  partial_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(trimer_state == "partial") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(neuron, DiseaseClass, shared_organelle) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(n > 0)

  partial_norm <- partial_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(n_kos, by = c("DiseaseClass", "neuron")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(n_norm = n / n_KOs)

  write_csv(partial_norm, file.path(out_dir_tables, "sourcedata_trimers_partial_by_diseaseclass.csv"))

  for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {
    dd <- partial_norm %>% dplyr::filter(neuron == nt, !is.na(shared_organelle))
    if (nrow(dd) == 0) next

    dd$shared_organelle <- factor(dd$shared_organelle, levels = selected_annotations)

    p <- ggplot(dd, aes(x = DiseaseClass, y = n_norm, fill = DiseaseClass)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      facet_wrap(~shared_organelle, ncol = 5, drop = FALSE, scales = "free_y") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = disease_class_palette, drop = FALSE) +
      labs(title = paste("Partial trimers per KO by annotation -", nt), x = NULL, y = "Partial trimers per KO") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)
      )

    ggsave(file.path(out_dir_plots, paste0("bars_trimers_partial_by_diseaseclass_", nt, ".pdf")), p, width = 12, height = 12, device = cairo_pdf)
  }
}


# =========================================================================
# COMPLEXES: Barplots of affected complexes by disease class
# Affected = disrupted (≥75% edges lost) + partial (25-75% edges lost)
# =========================================================================

plot_complex_diseaseclass_bars <- function(complex_ko_summary, disease_map, disease_class_palette,
                                           selected_annotations, out_dir_plots, out_dir_tables) {
  
  # Prepare data: join disease class, filter to valid organelles
  df <- complex_ko_summary %>%
    dplyr::mutate(KO = toupper(genotype)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("KO" = "sample")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(DiseaseClass), !is.na(organelle), organelle != "Other") %>%
    dplyr::filter(organelle %in% selected_annotations)
  
  # Set factor levels for consistent ordering
  df$DiseaseClass <- factor(df$DiseaseClass, levels = names(disease_class_palette))
  df$organelle <- factor(df$organelle, levels = selected_annotations)
  
  # Count KOs per disease class × neuron (for normalization)
  n_kos <- df %>% 
    dplyr::distinct(KO, DiseaseClass, neuron) %>% 
    dplyr::count(DiseaseClass, neuron, name = "n_KOs")
  
  # Aggregate affected complexes (disrupted + partial)
  affected_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(complex_state %in% c("disrupted", "partial")) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(neuron, DiseaseClass, organelle) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(n > 0)
  
  # Normalize by number of KOs per disease class
  affected_norm <- affected_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(n_kos, by = c("DiseaseClass", "neuron")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(n_norm = n / n_KOs)
  
  # Save source data
  write_csv(affected_norm, file.path(out_dir_tables, "sourcedata_complexes_affected_by_diseaseclass.csv"))
  
  # Plot: one PDF per neuron type
  for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {
    dd <- affected_norm %>% dplyr::filter(neuron == nt, !is.na(organelle))
    if (nrow(dd) == 0) next
    
    # Set factor levels for empty facets
    dd$organelle <- factor(dd$organelle, levels = selected_annotations)
    
    p <- ggplot(dd, aes(x = DiseaseClass, y = n_norm, fill = DiseaseClass)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      facet_wrap(~organelle, ncol = 5, drop = FALSE, scales = "free_y") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = disease_class_palette, drop = FALSE) +
      labs(title = paste("Affected complexes per KO by annotation -", nt), 
           x = NULL, 
           y = "Affected complexes per KO") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)
      )
    
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir_plots, paste0("bars_complexes_affected_by_diseaseclass_", nt, ".pdf")), 
           p, width = 12, height = 12, device = cairo_pdf)
  }
}


# =========================================================================
# RUN
# =========================================================================

plot_trimer_diseaseclass_bars(
  trimers_ko_states = trimers_ko_states,
  disease_map = disease_map,
  disease_class_palette = disease_class_palette,
  selected_annotations = selected_annotations,
  out_dir_plots = out_dir_trimer_plots,
  out_dir_tables = out_dir_trimer_tables
)

plot_complex_diseaseclass_bars(
  complex_ko_summary = complex_ko_summary,
  disease_map = disease_map,
  disease_class_palette = disease_class_palette,
  selected_annotations = selected_annotations,
  out_dir_plots = out_dir_complex_plots,
  out_dir_tables = out_dir_complex_tables
)
```

## Structural complex vulnearbility evaluation
```{r}
# ==========================================================================
# Prepare Protein Complexes for AlphaFold3 Structure Prediction
# Generates WT and KO structure files for disrupted/partial complexes
# ==========================================================================

library(httr)
library(jsonlite)

out_dir_structures <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "structures")
dir.create(out_dir_structures, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


# --- Step 1: Select target complexes ---
# Top 10 per KO x neuron + top 50 global

top_per_ko <- complex_ko_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(complex_state %in% c("disrupted", "partial")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(frac_edges_lost, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

top_global <- complex_ko_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(complex_state %in% c("disrupted", "partial")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(complex_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_frac_lost = mean(frac_edges_lost, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(mean_frac_lost, n = 50, with_ties = FALSE)

# Union: all complex x KO x neuron combinations from both sets
target_contexts <- complex_ko_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(complex_state %in% c("disrupted", "partial")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(complex_id %in% top_global$complex_id | 
                paste(complex_id, genotype, neuron) %in% paste(top_per_ko$complex_id, top_per_ko$genotype, top_per_ko$neuron))

message("Target contexts: ", nrow(target_contexts), " (complex x KO x neuron combinations)")
message("Unique complexes: ", n_distinct(target_contexts$complex_id))


# --- Step 2: Build protein-level data for target complexes ---
# Join complex membership with per-KO expression data

complex_proteins_base <- complexes_baseline %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(complexes_summary %>% dplyr::select(community_id, complex_id), by = "community_id") %>%
  dplyr::filter(complex_id %in% target_contexts$complex_id) %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_id, Gene)

# Expand to all KO x neuron contexts and add expression
complex_protein_states <- target_contexts %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_id, genotype, neuron, complex_state, frac_edges_lost) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(complex_proteins_base, by = "complex_id", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(prot_long %>% dplyr::select(Genes, genotype, neuron, log2FC), 
                   by = c("Gene" = "Genes", "genotype", "neuron")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(is_broken = !is.na(log2FC) & log2FC < drop_thresh)

message("Protein-level rows: ", nrow(complex_protein_states))


# --- Step 3: Build UniProt mapping and fetch sequences ---

protein_to_uniprot <- baseline_edges_union %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene1, Protein1) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Gene = Gene1, UniProt = Protein1) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(baseline_edges_union %>% dplyr::select(Gene2, Protein2) %>% dplyr::rename(Gene = Gene2, UniProt = Protein2)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Gene), !is.na(UniProt)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Get all unique genes needing sequences
genes_needed <- unique(complex_protein_states$Gene)
uniprot_ids_needed <- protein_to_uniprot %>% dplyr::filter(Gene %in% genes_needed) %>% dplyr::pull(UniProt) %>% unique()

message("Fetching sequences for ", length(uniprot_ids_needed), " UniProt IDs...")

fetch_uniprot_sequences <- function(uniprot_ids) {
  sequences <- list()
  for (i in seq_along(uniprot_ids)) {
    uid <- uniprot_ids[i]
    if (i %% 50 == 0) message("  Fetched ", i, "/", length(uniprot_ids))
    tryCatch({
      url <- paste0("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/", uid, ".fasta")
      response <- httr::GET(url, httr::timeout(10))
      if (httr::status_code(response) == 200) {
        fasta_text <- httr::content(response, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
        lines <- strsplit(fasta_text, "\n")[[1]]
        sequences[[uid]] <- paste(lines[!grepl("^>", lines)], collapse = "")
      } else {
        sequences[[uid]] <- NA_character_
      }
      Sys.sleep(0.1)
    }, error = function(e) { sequences[[uid]] <- NA_character_ })
  }
  return(sequences)
}

all_sequences <- fetch_uniprot_sequences(uniprot_ids_needed)
message("Successfully fetched: ", sum(!is.na(all_sequences)), "/", length(all_sequences))


# --- Step 4: Add UniProt IDs and sequences to protein states ---

complex_protein_states <- complex_protein_states %>%
  dplyr::left_join(protein_to_uniprot, by = "Gene") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sequence = sapply(UniProt, function(x) if (!is.na(x) && x %in% names(all_sequences)) all_sequences[[x]] else NA_character_))

# Summary stats per complex x KO x neuron
complex_context_summary <- complex_protein_states %>%
  dplyr::group_by(complex_id, genotype, neuron, complex_state, frac_edges_lost) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_proteins_total = n(),
    n_proteins_broken = sum(is_broken, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_proteins_retained = sum(!is_broken, na.rm = TRUE),
    proteins_broken = paste(Gene[is_broken], collapse = ";"),
    proteins_retained = paste(Gene[!is_broken], collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    structure_status = dplyr::case_when(
      n_proteins_retained >= 2 & n_proteins_broken > 0 ~ "WT_and_KO",
      n_proteins_retained < 2 & n_proteins_broken > 0 ~ "WT_only",
      n_proteins_broken == 0 ~ "intact",
      TRUE ~ "no_structure"
    )
  )


# --- Step 5: Write master CSV ---

master_csv <- complex_protein_states %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_id, genotype, neuron, complex_state, frac_edges_lost, Gene, UniProt, sequence, log2FC, is_broken) %>%
  dplyr::rename(protein = Gene, uniprot_id = UniProt) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(complex_context_summary %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, genotype, neuron, n_proteins_total, n_proteins_broken, n_proteins_retained, structure_status), 
                   by = c("complex_id", "genotype", "neuron")) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(complex_id, genotype, neuron, desc(is_broken), protein)

write_csv(master_csv, file.path(out_dir_structures, "master_complex_proteins.csv"))
message("Wrote master CSV: ", nrow(master_csv), " rows")


# --- Step 6: Helper functions for file generation ---

make_af3_json <- function(proteins_df, complex_name) {
  # AlphaFold Server schema: top-level list, with dialect and version
  chains <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(proteins_df)), function(i) {
    list(proteinChain = list(sequence = proteins_df$sequence[i], count = 1L))
  })
  job <- list(
    name = complex_name,
    modelSeeds = list(),
    sequences = chains,
    dialect = "alphafoldserver",
    version = 1L
  )
  return(list(job))  # Must be wrapped in a list
}

write_fasta <- function(proteins_df, filepath) {
  lines <- unlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(proteins_df)), function(i) {
    c(paste0(">", proteins_df$UniProt[i], "|", proteins_df$Gene[i]), proteins_df$sequence[i])
  }))
  writeLines(lines, filepath)
}

make_chimerax_script <- function(proteins_df, complex_name) {
  # Color broken proteins red, retained proteins steel blue
  lines <- c(
    paste0("# ChimeraX coloring script for ", complex_name),
    paste0("# Generated: ", Sys.time()),
    "",
    "# Chain color assignments (WT structure):",
    "# Broken proteins = red, Retained proteins = steel blue",
    ""
  )
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(proteins_df))) {
    chain_id <- LETTERS[i]
    color <- if (proteins_df$is_broken[i]) "red" else "dodgerblue3"
    lfc <- if (!is.na(proteins_df$log2FC[i])) round(proteins_df$log2FC[i], 2) else "NA"
    lines <- c(lines, 
      paste0("# Chain ", chain_id, ": ", proteins_df$Gene[i], " (log2FC=", lfc, ", broken=", proteins_df$is_broken[i], ")"),
      paste0("color /", chain_id, " ", color))
  }
  lines <- c(lines, "", "# Surface representation (optional):", "# surface", "# color surface /A-Z fromAtoms")
  return(lines)
}


# --- Step 7: Generate structure files ---
# One WT per complex, KO versions per context where broken proteins differ

unique_complexes <- unique(target_contexts$complex_id)
message("Generating WT files for ", length(unique_complexes), " complexes...")

# Step 7a: Generate one WT per complex
for (cid in unique_complexes) {
  
  # Get all proteins for this complex (from any context, they're the same)
  wt_proteins <- complex_protein_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(complex_id == cid) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene, UniProt, sequence) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(sequence), nchar(sequence) > 0)
  
  if (nrow(wt_proteins) < 2) next
  
  # Create complex directory
  complex_dir <- file.path(out_dir_structures, cid)
  dir.create(complex_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  # WT files
  wt_json <- make_af3_json(wt_proteins, paste0(cid, "_WT"))
  write_json(wt_json, file.path(complex_dir, paste0(cid, "_WT.json")), pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
  write_fasta(wt_proteins, file.path(complex_dir, paste0(cid, "_WT.fasta")))
}

# Step 7b: Generate KO versions per context (only where proteins differ)
contexts_to_process <- complex_context_summary %>% dplyr::filter(n_proteins_retained > 0, n_proteins_broken > 0)
message("Generating KO files for ", nrow(contexts_to_process), " contexts...")

# Track unique KO protein sets to avoid duplicates
ko_signatures_done <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(contexts_to_process))) {
  ctx <- contexts_to_process[i, ]
  
  # Get retained proteins for this context
  ko_proteins <- complex_protein_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(complex_id == ctx$complex_id, genotype == ctx$genotype, neuron == ctx$neuron, !is_broken, !is.na(sequence), nchar(sequence) > 0)
  
  if (nrow(ko_proteins) < 2) next
  
  # Check if we already generated this exact KO (same proteins missing)
  ko_signature <- paste(ctx$complex_id, paste(sort(ko_proteins$Gene), collapse = ";"), sep = ":")
  if (ko_signature %in% names(ko_signatures_done)) next
  ko_signatures_done[[ko_signature]] <- TRUE
  
  complex_dir <- file.path(out_dir_structures, ctx$complex_id)
  prefix <- paste(ctx$complex_id, ctx$genotype, ctx$neuron, sep = "_")
  
  # KO files
  ko_json <- make_af3_json(ko_proteins, paste0(prefix, "_KO"))
  write_json(ko_json, file.path(complex_dir, paste0(prefix, "_KO.json")), pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
  write_fasta(ko_proteins, file.path(complex_dir, paste0(prefix, "_KO.fasta")))
  
  # ChimeraX script (colors broken proteins on WT structure)
  wt_proteins_annotated <- complex_protein_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(complex_id == ctx$complex_id, genotype == ctx$genotype, neuron == ctx$neuron, !is.na(sequence), nchar(sequence) > 0)
  chimerax_lines <- make_chimerax_script(wt_proteins_annotated, prefix)
  writeLines(chimerax_lines, file.path(complex_dir, paste0(prefix, "_chimerax.cxc")))
}

message("Generated ", length(unique_complexes), " WT structures and ", length(ko_signatures_done), " unique KO structures")


# --- Step 8: Write summary files ---

# Context-level summary with full complex metadata
complex_context_summary <- complex_context_summary %>%
  dplyr::left_join(complexes_summary %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, proteins, organelle), by = "complex_id") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(complex_id, genotype, neuron)

write_csv(complex_context_summary, file.path(out_dir_structures, "complex_context_summary.csv"))

# Per-complex summary (aggregated across KOs)
complex_summary_agg <- complex_context_summary %>%
  dplyr::group_by(complex_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_contexts = n(),
    n_disrupted = sum(complex_state == "disrupted"),
    n_partial = sum(complex_state == "partial"),
    mean_frac_lost = mean(frac_edges_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_frac_lost = max(frac_edges_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
    kos_affected = paste(unique(genotype), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(complexes_summary %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, n_proteins, proteins, organelle), by = "complex_id") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(mean_frac_lost))

write_csv(complex_summary_agg, file.path(out_dir_structures, "complex_summary_aggregated.csv"))


# --- Step 9: README ---

readme_lines <- c(
  "# Protein Complex Structure Prediction Files",
  paste0("# Generated: ", Sys.time()),
  "",
  "## Overview",
  paste0("Total complexes: ", length(unique_complexes)),
  paste0("Total KO contexts: ", length(ko_signatures_done)),
  "",
  "## File descriptions",

  "master_complex_proteins.csv",
  "  Per-protein data for all target complexes. Columns:",
  "  complex_id, genotype, neuron, complex_state, frac_edges_lost,",
  "  protein, uniprot_id, sequence, log2FC, is_broken, n_proteins_total, n_proteins_broken",
  "",
  "complex_context_summary.csv",
  "  Per-context summary (one row per complex x KO x neuron)",
  "  Use this to see which KOs affect each complex and which proteins are broken",

  "complex_summary_aggregated.csv",
  "  Per-complex summary with list of affected KOs",

  "## Per-complex directories",

  "Each Complex_XXXX/ folder contains:",
  "  {complex}_WT.json              - AF3 input with all proteins (one per complex)",
  "  {complex}_WT.fasta             - FASTA for WT",
  "  {complex}_{genotype}_{neuron}_KO.json   - AF3 input without broken proteins",
  "  {complex}_{genotype}_{neuron}_KO.fasta  - FASTA for KO",
  "  {complex}_{genotype}_{neuron}_chimerax.cxc - ChimeraX coloring script",
  "",
  "## Workflow",

  "1. Run AF3 on {complex}_WT.json to get the baseline structure",
  "2. Optionally run AF3 on KO versions to see structural impact of missing proteins",
  "3. Use ChimeraX scripts to color broken proteins on the WT structure",

writeLines(readme_lines, file.path(out_dir_structures, "README.txt"))


# --- Step 10: Dot plot visualization of complex disruption ---

# Prepare data: order complexes by mean frac_edges_lost
complex_order <- complex_context_summary %>%
```

### ChimeraX Automation for Complex Structure Comparison
```{r}
# ==========================================================================
# ChimeraX Automation for Complex Structure Comparison
# Generates .cxc command files for WT vs KO structure visualization
# Generate ChimeraX command scripts (.cxc) for automated WT vs KO structure comparison.
# Colors WT retained chains grey, broken chain(s) red, and KO structure blue to visualize complex disruption.
# ==========================================================================

# --- Step 1: Setup ---
out_dir_chimerax <- file.path(out_dir_structures, "chimerax_scripts")
dir.create(out_dir_chimerax, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


# --- Step 2: Add sequence prefix to protein data ---
# First 10 amino acids for chain matching in ChimeraX
master_csv <- read_csv(file.path(out_dir_structures, "master_complex_proteins.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

master_csv <- master_csv %>%
  dplyr::mutate(seq_prefix = substr(sequence, 1, 10))


# --- Step 3: Build chain mapping reference ---
# For each complex, map protein -> expected chain order (based on JSON order)
# First get unique proteins per complex, then assign chain IDs

complex_chain_map <- master_csv %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(sequence)) %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_id, protein, seq_prefix) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(complex_id) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(complex_id, protein) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Proteins are ordered alphabetically in our JSON generation
    wt_chain_expected = LETTERS[row_number()]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()


# --- Step 4: Function to generate ChimeraX script ---
generate_chimerax_script <- function(complex_id, genotype, neuron, 
                                      proteins_df, broken_proteins,
                                      wt_path, ko_path, output_path) {
  
  # Get chain info for this complex
  chain_info <- proteins_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      is_broken = protein %in% broken_proteins,
      status = ifelse(is_broken, "BROKEN", "retained")
    )
  
  # Build script lines
  lines <- c(
    paste0("# =========================================================="),
    paste0("# ChimeraX script for ", complex_id, " - ", genotype, " ", neuron),
    paste0("# Generated: ", Sys.time()),
    paste0("# =========================================================="),
    "",
    "# --- Chain mapping (verify by sequence prefix) ---",
    paste0("# Proteins in complex:")
  )
  
  # Add chain mapping comments
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(chain_info))) {
    row <- chain_info[i, ]
    lines <- c(lines, paste0(
      "#   Chain ", row$wt_chain_expected, ": ", row$protein, 
      " [", row$status, "] - starts with ", row$seq_prefix
    ))
  }
  
  # Get broken chain IDs
  broken_chains <- chain_info %>%
    dplyr::filter(is_broken) %>%
    dplyr::pull(wt_chain_expected)
  
  retained_chains <- chain_info %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is_broken) %>%
    dplyr::pull(wt_chain_expected)
  
  lines <- c(lines,
    "",
    "# --- Load structures ---",
    "# UPDATE THESE PATHS to your local AF3 output locations",
    paste0("# open ", wt_path),
    paste0("# open ", ko_path),
    "",
    "# After loading, structures will be #1 (WT) and #2 (KO)",
    "# Uncomment the lines below once paths are set:",
    "",
    "# --- Align structures ---",
    "matchmaker #2 to #1",
    "",
    "# --- Color scheme ---",
    "# WT structure: grey for retained, red for broken chain(s)",
    "# KO structure: dodgerblue3",
    "",
    "color #1 darkgrey"
  )
  
  # Add commands to color broken chains red
  for (chain in broken_chains) {
    lines <- c(lines, paste0("color #1/", chain, " red"))
  }
  
  lines <- c(lines,
    "",
    "color #2 dodgerblue3",
    "",
    "# --- Display settings ---",
    "set bgColor white",
    "lighting soft",
    "graphics silhouettes true",
    "",
    "# --- Orient view ---",
    "view orient",
    "",
    "# --- Optional: show cartoon only ---",
    "# hide atoms",
    "# show cartoons",
    "",
    "# --- Save image ---",
    paste0("# save ", complex_id, "_", genotype, "_", neuron, "_overlay.png width 2000 height 2000"),
    "",
    "# --- RMSD info will appear in Log panel after matchmaker ---",
    "",
    "# ==========================================================",
    "# Quick commands to paste:",
    "# ==========================================================",
    paste0("# matchmaker #2 to #1"),
    paste0("# color #1 darkgrey"),
    paste0("# color #1/", paste(broken_chains, collapse = " red; color #1/"), " red"),
    paste0("# color #2 dodgerblue3"),
    paste0("# set bgColor white"),
    paste0("# lighting soft"),
    paste0("# view orient")
  )
  
  writeLines(lines, output_path)
  return(TRUE)
}


# --- Step 5: Generate scripts for all WT_and_KO entries ---
context_summary <- read_csv(file.path(out_dir_structures, "complex_context_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

wt_and_ko_contexts <- context_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(structure_status == "WT_and_KO")

message("Generating ChimeraX scripts for ", nrow(wt_and_ko_contexts), " WT vs KO comparisons...")

scripts_generated <- 0

for (i in seq_len(nrow(wt_and_ko_contexts))) {
  ctx <- wt_and_ko_contexts[i, ]
  
  # Get protein info for this complex
  proteins_df <- complex_chain_map %>%
    dplyr::filter(complex_id == ctx$complex_id)
  
  if (nrow(proteins_df) == 0) next
  
  # Parse broken proteins
  broken_proteins <- unlist(strsplit(ctx$proteins_broken, ";"))
  
  # Define paths (placeholders - user updates)
  wt_path <- paste0("path/to/", ctx$complex_id, "_WT_model_0.cif")
  ko_path <- paste0("path/to/", ctx$complex_id, "_", ctx$genotype, "_", ctx$neuron, "_KO_model_0.cif")
  
  # Output path
  script_path <- file.path(out_dir_chimerax, 
                           paste0(ctx$complex_id, "_", ctx$genotype, "_", ctx$neuron, ".cxc"))
  
  # Generate script
  success <- generate_chimerax_script(
    complex_id = ctx$complex_id,
    genotype = ctx$genotype,
    neuron = ctx$neuron,
    proteins_df = proteins_df,
    broken_proteins = broken_proteins,
    wt_path = wt_path,
    ko_path = ko_path,
    output_path = script_path
  )
  
  if (success) scripts_generated <- scripts_generated + 1
}

message("Generated ", scripts_generated, " ChimeraX scripts")


# --- Step 6: Generate master script for batch processing ---
master_script <- c(
  "# ==========================================================",
  "# Master ChimeraX Script - Complex Structure Comparisons",
  paste0("# Generated: ", Sys.time()),
  "# ==========================================================",
  "",
  "# This script lists all available comparisons.",
  "# Update the BASE_PATH variable to your AF3 output directory.",
  "",
  "# BASE_PATH = /path/to/your/af3_outputs/",
  "",
  "# Available comparisons:",
  ""
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(wt_and_ko_contexts))) {
  ctx <- wt_and_ko_contexts[i, ]
  master_script <- c(master_script,
    paste0("# ", ctx$complex_id, " - ", ctx$genotype, " ", ctx$neuron, 
           " (", ctx$n_proteins_broken, "/", ctx$n_proteins_total, " broken, ",
           "frac_lost=", round(ctx$frac_edges_lost, 2), ")"))
}

writeLines(master_script, file.path(out_dir_chimerax, "00_master_list.txt"))


# --- Step 7: Save chain mapping reference ---
write_csv(complex_chain_map, file.path(out_dir_chimerax, "chain_mapping_reference.csv"))


message("")
message("=== ChimeraX automation complete ===")
message("Output directory: ", out_dir_chimerax)
message("Scripts generated: ", scripts_generated)
message("Chain mapping: chain_mapping_reference.csv")
message("")
message("Usage:")
message("1. Open ChimeraX")
message("2. Load WT structure: open /path/to/Complex_XXXX_WT_model_0.cif")
message("3. Load KO structure: open /path/to/Complex_XXXX_genotype_neuron_KO_model_0.cif")
message("4. File > Open > Complex_XXXX_genotype_neuron.cxc")
message("5. Or paste commands from script into ChimeraX command line")
```

```{r}
  dplyr::arrange(min_val, max_val)|>
  dplyr::mutate(
    genotype = factor(genotype, levels = unique(genotype))
  )

# plot compelx dumbbell
p_complex_dumbbell <- ggplot(complex_dumbbell_data) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = iN, xend = iDA, y = genotype, yend = genotype),

    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_point(

    size = 3
  ) +

  ) +
  labs(

  ) +

  ) +

  annotate("text", x = 13.5, y = 2, label = "iN", hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.5) +
  annotate("point", x = 13, y = 1, color = "dodgerblue4", size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 13.5, y = 1, label = "iDA", hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.5)

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/multimer", "dumbbell_disrupted_complexes_per_ko.pdf"), p_complex_dumbbell, width = 4, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
```

# Loss of PPIs timecourse evaluation ASAH1 d30,d50,d70
(with d70 baseline correction)
```{r}
# =========================================================================
# PPI Loss Analysis: ASAH1 Timecourse (d30, d50, d70)
# With day 70 baseline correction for batch effects
# =========================================================================

# --- Step 0: Setup output directories ---
out_dir_timecourse <- file.path(out_dir_PPI, "timecourseASAH1")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "plots"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Color palette
neuron_palette <- c(iN = "grey60", iDA = "grey80")
day_palette <- c(d30 = "#4575b4", d50 = "#91bfdb", d70 = "#e0f3f8")


# --- Step 1: Prepare timecourse proteome data ---
# Build long format with day, neuron, gene, log2FC
prepare_timecourse_proteome <- function() {
  
  # Day 30
  d30_long <- complete_data_annotated_day30 %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, ASAH1_iN_log2_fold_change, ASAH1_iDA_log2_fold_change) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(ASAH1_iN_log2_fold_change, ASAH1_iDA_log2_fold_change),
      names_to = "sample",
      values_to = "log2FC"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      day = "d30",
      neuron = ifelse(grepl("_iN_", sample), "iN", "iDA")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, day, neuron, log2FC)
  
  # Day 50
  d50_long <- complete_data_annotated_day50 %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, ASAH1_iN_log2_fold_change, ASAH1_iDA_log2_fold_change) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(ASAH1_iN_log2_fold_change, ASAH1_iDA_log2_fold_change),
      names_to = "sample",
      values_to = "log2FC"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      day = "d50",
      neuron = ifelse(grepl("_iN_", sample), "iN", "iDA")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, day, neuron, log2FC)
  
  # Day 70
  d70_long <- diff132_d70_df_annotated %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, d70_iN_log2fc_ASAH1, d70_iDA_log2fc_ASAH1) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(d70_iN_log2fc_ASAH1, d70_iDA_log2fc_ASAH1),
      names_to = "sample",
      values_to = "log2FC"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      day = "d70",
      neuron = ifelse(grepl("_iN_", sample), "iN", "iDA")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, day, neuron, log2FC)
  
  # Combine
  timecourse_proteome <- dplyr::bind_rows(d30_long, d50_long, d70_long) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Genes), Genes != "", !is.na(log2FC))
  
  return(timecourse_proteome)
}

timecourse_prot_long <- prepare_timecourse_proteome()

# save csv
write_csv(timecourse_prot_long, file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "tables", "timecourse_proteome_long.csv"))


# --- Step 1b: Create d70-specific baseline ---
message("\n=== Creating day 70 specific baseline ===")

# Extract d70 control data (detected proteins)
d70_detected_genes <- diff132_d70_df_annotated %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Genes), Genes != "") %>%
  dplyr::pull(Genes) %>%
  unique()

# Filter baseline edges to only include genes detected at d70
baseline_edges_d70 <- baseline_edges_union %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene1 %in% d70_detected_genes, Gene2 %in% d70_detected_genes)

message("Original baseline edges: ", nrow(baseline_edges_union))
message("Day 70 baseline edges: ", nrow(baseline_edges_d70))
message("Genes in d70 baseline: ", length(unique(c(baseline_edges_d70$Gene1, baseline_edges_d70$Gene2))))

# save csv
write_csv(baseline_edges_d70, file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "tables", "baseline_edges_d70.csv"))


# --- Step 2: Compute PPI edge states per day × neuron ---
# Now using different baselines for d70 vs d30/d50
compute_timecourse_edge_states <- function(baseline_edges, 
                                            baseline_edges_d70,
                                            prot_long, 
                                            drop_thresh = -0.5) {
  
  # Get neuronal genes per day
  neuronal_genes <- unique(prot_long$Genes)
  
  # For d30 and d50: use original baseline
  baseline_filtered_d30d50 <- baseline_edges %>%
    dplyr::filter(Gene1 %in% neuronal_genes, Gene2 %in% neuronal_genes)
  
  # Expand to d30 and d50
  day_neuron_grid_d30d50 <- expand_grid(
    day = c("d30", "d50"),
    neuron = c("iN", "iDA")
  )
  
  baseline_expanded_d30d50 <- baseline_filtered_d30d50 %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dummy = 1) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      day_neuron_grid_d30d50 %>% dplyr::mutate(dummy = 1),
      by = "dummy",
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-dummy)
  
  # For d70: use d70-specific baseline
  day_neuron_grid_d70 <- expand_grid(
    day = "d70",
    neuron = c("iN", "iDA")
  )
  
  baseline_expanded_d70 <- baseline_edges_d70 %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dummy = 1) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      day_neuron_grid_d70 %>% dplyr::mutate(dummy = 1),
      by = "dummy",
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-dummy)
  
  # Combine both baselines
  baseline_expanded <- dplyr::bind_rows(baseline_expanded_d30d50, baseline_expanded_d70)
  
  # Join proteome data for both partners
  edge_states <- baseline_expanded %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      prot_long %>% dplyr::select(Genes, day, neuron, log2FC),
      by = c("Gene1" = "Genes", "day", "neuron")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(dA = log2FC) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      prot_long %>% dplyr::select(Genes, day, neuron, log2FC),
      by = c("Gene2" = "Genes", "day", "neuron")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(dB = log2FC) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      state = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(dA) & dA < drop_thresh ~ "lost",
        !is.na(dB) & dB < drop_thresh ~ "lost",
        (!is.na(dA) | !is.na(dB))     ~ "retained",
        TRUE                          ~ "unknown"
      ),
      day_neuron = paste(day, neuron, sep = "_"),
      baseline_used = ifelse(day == "d70", "d70_specific", "original")
    )
  
  return(edge_states)
}

timecourse_edge_states <- compute_timecourse_edge_states(
  baseline_edges = baseline_edges_union,
  baseline_edges_d70 = baseline_edges_d70,
  prot_long = timecourse_prot_long,
  drop_thresh = -0.5
)

# save csv
write_csv(timecourse_edge_states, file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "tables", "timecourse_edge_states.csv"))

# Print baseline usage summary
message("\nBaseline usage summary:")
timecourse_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::group_by(day, baseline_used) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_edges = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  print()


# --- Step 3: Global summary: total lost PPIs per day × neuron ---
timecourse_summary <- timecourse_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::group_by(day, neuron) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_edges = n(),
    n_lost = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_retained = sum(state == "retained", na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_lost = n_lost / total_edges,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    day = factor(day, levels = c("d30", "d50", "d70"))
  )

# save csv
write_csv(timecourse_summary, file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "tables", "timecourse_ppi_summary.csv"))

message("\nTimecourse summary:")
print(timecourse_summary)


# --- Step 4: Stacked barplot - total lost PPIs over time ---
p_timecourse_bars <- ggplot(timecourse_summary, aes(x = day, y = n_lost, fill = neuron)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_lost), position = position_dodge(0.7), vjust = -0.5, size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = neuron_palette, name = "Neuron") +
  labs(
    title = "Lost PPIs in ASAH1 over time (d70 baseline-corrected)",
    x = "Differentiation day",
    y = "Number of lost PPIs"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "plots", "bars_lost_ppis_timecourse.pdf"), p_timecourse_bars, width = 4, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)


# --- Step 5: By-annotation breakdown ---
# Add organelle tags to edge states
timecourse_edge_states_annotated <- timecourse_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::left_join(shared_long, by = "key") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag))

# Count lost PPIs per annotation × day × neuron
timecourse_by_annotation <- timecourse_edge_states_annotated %>%
  dplyr::filter(state == "lost") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(day, neuron, tag) %>%

    day = factor(day, levels = c("d30", "d50", "d70"))
  )

# save csv
write_csv(timecourse_by_annotation, file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "tables", "timecourse_lost_ppis_by_annotation.csv"))


# --- Step 6: Heatmap - lost PPIs per annotation over time ---
for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {
  
  heatmap_data <- timecourse_by_annotation %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == nt) %>%

      names_from = day,

    message("Insufficient data for heatmap (", nt, "); skipping.")

  heatmap_mat <- as.matrix(heatmap_data[, -c(1:2)])

    heatmap_mat,

    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,
    border_color = NA,
    fontsize = 6,

    main = paste("Lost PPIs by annotation over time –", nt),
    filename = file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "plots", paste0("heatmap_lost_ppis_by_annotation_", nt, ".pdf")),
    width = 5,
    height = 8
  )
}


# --- Step 7: Line plots for selected annotations ---
selected_annotations <- c("Mito", "OXPHOS", "MitoMIM", "SynGO", 
                          "Svexocytosis", "SynapseSVs")

# Filter to selected annotations

# Compute mean and SD per annotation × day

# Line plot

  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +

# --- Step 8: Line plot with SD ribbon ---
timecourse_with_sd <- timecourse_selected %>%
  dplyr::group_by(day, neuron, tag) %>%

    n_lost_sd = sqrt(pmax(n_lost_mean, 1)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

p_timecourse_ribbon <- ggplot(timecourse_with_sd, aes(x = day_numeric, y = n_lost_mean, color = neuron, fill = neuron, group = neuron)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmax(0, n_lost_mean - n_lost_sd), ymax = n_lost_mean + n_lost_sd), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ tag, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = neuron_palette, name = "Neuron") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = neuron_palette, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(30, 50, 70), labels = c("d30", "d50", "d70")) +
  labs(
    title = "Lost PPIs over time with uncertainty (selected annotations)",

  ) +

    panel.grid = element_blank(),

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "plots", "lines_lost_ppis_with_ribbon.pdf"), p_timecourse_ribbon, width = 9, height = 6, device = cairo_pdf)


# --- Step 9: Trimer analysis for timecourse ---
message("\n=== Trimer analysis for timecourse ===")

if (!exists("trimers_baseline")) {
  stop("trimers_baseline not found. Run the trimer analysis section first.")
}

# Convert timecourse edge states to gene-based keys
timecourse_edge_genes <- timecourse_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::select(key, Gene1, Gene2, day, neuron, state) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(key_gene = .make_undirected_key(Gene1, Gene2))

# Assess trimer states per day × neuron
assess_timecourse_trimers <- function(baseline_trimers, edge_states) {
  
  # Prepare trimer edges with keys
  trimers_with_keys <- baseline_trimers %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      key_AB = .make_undirected_key(GeneA, GeneB),
      key_BC = .make_undirected_key(GeneB, GeneC),
      key_AC = .make_undirected_key(GeneA, GeneC)
    )
  
  # Expand to all day × neuron
  day_neuron_combos <- edge_states %>%
    dplyr::distinct(day, neuron)
  
  trimers_expanded <- trimers_with_keys %>%
    tidyr::crossing(day_neuron_combos)
  
  # Join edge states
  trimers_states <- trimers_expanded %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      edge_states %>% dplyr::select(key_gene, day, neuron, state),
      by = c("key_AB" = "key_gene", "day", "neuron")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(state_AB = state) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      edge_states %>% dplyr::select(key_gene, day, neuron, state),
      by = c("key_BC" = "key_gene", "day", "neuron")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(state_BC = state) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      edge_states %>% dplyr::select(key_gene, day, neuron, state),
      by = c("key_AC" = "key_gene", "day", "neuron")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(state_AC = state) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      state_AB = tidyr::replace_na(state_AB, "retained"),
      state_BC = tidyr::replace_na(state_BC, "retained"),
      state_AC = tidyr::replace_na(state_AC, "retained"),
      n_lost = (state_AB == "lost") + (state_BC == "lost") + (state_AC == "lost"),
      trimer_state = dplyr::case_when(
        n_lost >= 2 ~ "broken",
        n_lost == 1 ~ "partial",
        n_lost == 0 ~ "intact",
        TRUE ~ "unknown"
      )
    )
  
  return(trimers_states)
}

timecourse_trimer_states <- assess_timecourse_trimers(
  baseline_trimers = trimers_baseline,
  edge_states = timecourse_edge_genes
)

# save csv
write_csv(timecourse_trimer_states, file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "tables", "timecourse_trimer_states.csv"))

# Summary
timecourse_trimer_summary <- timecourse_trimer_states %>%
  dplyr::group_by(day, neuron) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_intact = sum(trimer_state == "intact", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_broken = sum(trimer_state == "broken", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_partial = sum(trimer_state == "partial", na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_broken = n_broken / n_total,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(day = factor(day, levels = c("d30", "d50", "d70")))

# save csv
write_csv(timecourse_trimer_summary, file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "tables", "timecourse_trimer_summary.csv"))

# Barplot - broken trimers over time
p_trimer_bars <- ggplot(timecourse_trimer_summary, aes(x = day, y = n_broken, fill = neuron)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_broken), position = position_dodge(0.7), vjust = -0.5, size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = neuron_palette, name = "Neuron") +
  labs(
    title = "Broken trimers in ASAH1 over time",
    x = "Differentiation day",
    y = "Number of broken trimers"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "plots", "bars_broken_trimers_timecourse.pdf"), p_trimer_bars, width = 4, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)

# Heatmap - trimer states over time
for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {
  heatmap_data <- timecourse_trimer_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == nt) %>%
    dplyr::select(day, n_broken, n_partial, n_intact) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(n_broken, n_partial, n_intact),
                       names_to = "state", values_to = "count") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = day, values_from = count)
  
  heatmap_mat <- as.matrix(heatmap_data[, -1])
  rownames(heatmap_mat) <- heatmap_data$state
  
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    heatmap_mat,
    scale = "none",
    color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#C51B7D"))(100),
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    display_numbers = TRUE,
    number_format = "%.0f",
    fontsize_number = 6,
    border_color = NA,
    cellwidth = 18,
    cellheight = 18,
    main = paste("Trimer states over time –", nt),
    filename = file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "plots", paste0("heatmap_trimer_states_", nt, ".pdf")),
    width = 3,
    height = 3
  )
}


# --- Step 10: Complex/multimer analysis for timecourse ---
message("\n=== Complex analysis for timecourse ===")

if (!exists("complexes_summary")) {
  message("complexes_summary not found. Run complex detection section first.")
} else {
  
  # Get complex edges
  complex_edges_list <- list()
  
  for (cid in unique(complexes_summary$community_id)) {
    complex_genes <- complexes_baseline %>%
      dplyr::filter(community_id == cid) %>%
      dplyr::pull(Gene)
    
    complex_edges <- high_conf_edges %>%
      dplyr::filter(Gene1 %in% complex_genes, Gene2 %in% complex_genes) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        community_id = cid,
        key_gene = .make_undirected_key(Gene1, Gene2)
      )
    
    complex_edges_list[[as.character(cid)]] <- complex_edges
  }
  
  complex_edges_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(complex_edges_list) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      complexes_summary %>% dplyr::select(community_id, complex_id),
      by = "community_id"
    )
  
  # Expand to all day × neuron
  day_neuron_combos <- timecourse_edge_genes %>%
    dplyr::distinct(day, neuron)
  
  complexes_expanded <- complex_edges_df %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, community_id, key_gene) %>%
    tidyr::crossing(day_neuron_combos)
  
  # Join edge states
  complexes_timecourse_states <- complexes_expanded %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      timecourse_edge_genes %>% dplyr::select(key_gene, day, neuron, state),
      by = c("key_gene", "day", "neuron")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      state = tidyr::replace_na(state, "retained"),
      edge_lost = state == "lost"
    )
  
  # Aggregate per complex × day × neuron
  complex_timecourse_summary <- complexes_timecourse_states %>%
    dplyr::group_by(complex_id, day, neuron) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_edges_total = n(),
      n_edges_lost = sum(edge_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
      frac_edges_lost = n_edges_lost / n_edges_total,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      complexes_summary %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, n_proteins, organelle),
      by = "complex_id"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      complex_state = dplyr::case_when(
        frac_edges_lost >= 0.75 ~ "disrupted",
        frac_edges_lost >= 0.25 ~ "partial",
        TRUE ~ "intact"
      ),
      day = factor(day, levels = c("d30", "d50", "d70"))
    )
  
  # save csv
  write_csv(complex_timecourse_summary, file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "tables", "timecourse_complex_states.csv"))
  
  # Summary statistics
  complex_disruption_timecourse <- complex_timecourse_summary %>%
    dplyr::group_by(day, neuron) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_complexes = n(),
      n_intact = sum(complex_state == "intact"),
      n_disrupted = sum(complex_state == "disrupted"),
      n_partial = sum(complex_state == "partial"),
      frac_disrupted = n_disrupted / n_complexes,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # save csv
  write_csv(complex_disruption_timecourse, file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "tables", "timecourse_complex_disruption_summary.csv"))
  
  # Barplot
  p_complex_bars <- ggplot(complex_disruption_timecourse, aes(x = day, y = n_disrupted, fill = neuron)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n_disrupted), position = position_dodge(0.7),
              vjust = -0.5, size = 2.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = neuron_palette, name = "Neuron") +
    labs(
      title = "Disrupted complexes in ASAH1 over time",

  # --- Step 11: Heatmaps by annotation for trimers and complexes ---

  # TRIMER heatmaps by annotation

    # Annotate trimers with organelle tags
    timecourse_trimer_annotated <- timecourse_trimer_states %>%

      ) %>%
```

# Loss of PPIs timecourse evaluation d30 & d50 of ASAH1, SMPD1, GBA1, GRN
```{r}
# =========================================================================
# PPI Loss Analysis: Multi-genotype Timecourse (ASAH1, SMPD1, GBA1, GRN)
# Days 30 and 50 comparison
# =========================================================================

# --- Step 0: Setup output directories ---
out_dir_timecourse_multi <- file.path(out_dir_PPI, "timecourse_multi_genotype")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/by_genotype"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/global"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Color palettes
neuron_palette <- c(iN = "grey60", iDA = "grey80")
day_palette <- c(d30 = "#4575b4", d50 = "#91bfdb")
genotype_palette <- c(
  ASAH1 = "#D53E4F",
  SMPD1 = "#F46D43", 
  GBA1 = "#ABDDA4",
  GRN = "#66C2A5"
)


# --- Step 1: Extract timecourse data for all 4 genotypes ---
message("\n=== Extracting timecourse proteome data for 4 genotypes ===")

# Helper function: extract genotype × day × neuron block
.extract_genotype_log2_block <- function(df_wide, genotype, day_label, neuron_label) {
  stopifnot(neuron_label %in% c("iN", "iDA"))
  stopifnot(genotype %in% c("ASAH1", "SMPD1", "GBA1", "GRN"))
  
  log2_col <- paste0(genotype, "_", neuron_label, "_log2_fold_change")
  
  if (!log2_col %in% colnames(df_wide)) {
    message("Column ", log2_col, " not found in dataframe; skipping.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df_wide %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, log2FC = all_of(log2_col)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Genes), Genes != "", !is.na(log2FC)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Genotype = genotype,
      Day = paste0("d", day_label),
      Neuron = neuron_label
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, Genotype, Day, Neuron, log2FC)
}

# Extract all combinations
genotypes <- c("ASAH1", "SMPD1", "GBA1", "GRN")
days <- list(d30 = complete_data_annotated_day30, d50 = complete_data_annotated_day50)
neurons <- c("iN", "iDA")

timecourse_list <- list()

for (geno in genotypes) {
  for (day_name in names(days)) {
    day_num <- as.numeric(gsub("d", "", day_name))
    df_wide <- days[[day_name]]
    
    for (nt in neurons) {
      key <- paste(geno, day_name, nt, sep = "_")
      timecourse_list[[key]] <- .extract_genotype_log2_block(
        df_wide, geno, day_num, nt
      )
    }
  }
}

# Combine all
timecourse_multi_prot_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(timecourse_list) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(log2FC)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Day = factor(Day, levels = c("d30", "d50")),
    Genotype = factor(Genotype, levels = genotypes)
  )

# Save csv
write_csv(timecourse_multi_prot_long, file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "timecourse_multi_proteome_long.csv"))

message("Extracted proteome data:")
print(table(timecourse_multi_prot_long$Genotype, timecourse_multi_prot_long$Day))


# --- Step 2: Compute PPI edge states per genotype × day × neuron ---
message("\n=== Computing PPI edge states for all genotypes ===")

compute_multi_timecourse_edge_states <- function(baseline_edges, 
                                                  prot_long, 
                                                  drop_thresh = -0.5) {
  
  # Get neuronal genes
  neuronal_genes <- unique(prot_long$Genes)
  
  # Filter baseline to neuronal proteome
  baseline_filtered <- baseline_edges %>%
    dplyr::filter(Gene1 %in% neuronal_genes, Gene2 %in% neuronal_genes)
  
  message("Baseline edges in neuronal proteome: ", nrow(baseline_filtered))
  
  # Expand to all genotype × day × neuron combinations
  geno_day_neuron_grid <- prot_long %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Genotype, Day, Neuron)
  
  baseline_expanded <- baseline_filtered %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dummy = 1) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      geno_day_neuron_grid %>% dplyr::mutate(dummy = 1),
      by = "dummy",
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-dummy)
  
  # Join proteome data for both partners
  edge_states <- baseline_expanded %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      prot_long %>% dplyr::select(Genes, Genotype, Day, Neuron, log2FC),
      by = c("Gene1" = "Genes", "Genotype", "Day", "Neuron")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(dA = log2FC) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      prot_long %>% dplyr::select(Genes, Genotype, Day, Neuron, log2FC),
      by = c("Gene2" = "Genes", "Genotype", "Day", "Neuron")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(dB = log2FC) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      state = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(dA) & dA < drop_thresh ~ "lost",
        !is.na(dB) & dB < drop_thresh ~ "lost",
        (!is.na(dA) | !is.na(dB))     ~ "retained",
        TRUE                          ~ "unknown"
      ),
      geno_day_neuron = paste(Genotype, Day, Neuron, sep = "_")
    )
  
  return(edge_states)
}

timecourse_multi_edge_states <- compute_multi_timecourse_edge_states(
  baseline_edges = baseline_edges_union,
  prot_long = timecourse_multi_prot_long,
  drop_thresh = -0.5
)

# Save csv
write_csv(timecourse_multi_edge_states, file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "timecourse_multi_edge_states.csv"))


# --- Step 3: Global summary - lost PPIs per genotype × day × neuron ---
timecourse_multi_summary <- timecourse_multi_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genotype, Day, Neuron) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_edges = n(),
    n_lost = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_retained = sum(state == "retained", na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_lost = n_lost / total_edges,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# save csv
write_csv(timecourse_multi_summary, file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "timecourse_multi_ppi_summary.csv"))

message("\nMulti-genotype timecourse summary:")
print(timecourse_multi_summary)

  geom_text(

    vjust = -0.5,

  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Genotype, ncol = 4, scales = "free_y") +

    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/global", "lines_lost_ppis_genotype_comparison.pdf"), p_lines_genotype_compare, width = 4, height = 3.5, device = cairo_pdf)


# --- Step 6: By-annotation breakdown ---

timecourse_multi_edge_annotated <- timecourse_multi_edge_states %>%

timecourse_multi_by_annotation <- timecourse_multi_edge_annotated %>%

# save csv

# --- Step 7: Heatmaps - lost PPIs per annotation × genotype ---
for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {

    width = 8,
    height = 10
  )

# --- Step 8: Trimer analysis for multi-genotype timecourse ---
message("\n=== Trimer analysis for multi-genotype timecourse ===")

if (!exists("trimers_baseline")) {
  message("trimers_baseline not found. Skipping trimer analysis.")
} else {
  
  # Convert edge states to gene-based keys
  timecourse_multi_edge_genes <- timecourse_multi_edge_states %>%
    dplyr::select(key, Gene1, Gene2, Genotype, Day, Neuron, state) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(key_gene = .make_undirected_key(Gene1, Gene2))
  
  # Assess trimer states
  assess_multi_timecourse_trimers <- function(baseline_trimers, edge_states) {
    
    trimers_with_keys <- baseline_trimers %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        key_AB = .make_undirected_key(GeneA, GeneB),
        key_BC = .make_undirected_key(GeneB, GeneC),
        key_AC = .make_undirected_key(GeneA, GeneC)
      )
    
    # Expand to all genotype × day × neuron
    geno_day_neuron_combos <- edge_states %>%
      dplyr::distinct(Genotype, Day, Neuron)
    
    trimers_expanded <- trimers_with_keys %>%
      tidyr::crossing(geno_day_neuron_combos)
    
    # Join edge states
    trimers_states <- trimers_expanded %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        edge_states %>% dplyr::select(key_gene, Genotype, Day, Neuron, state),
        by = c("key_AB" = "key_gene", "Genotype", "Day", "Neuron")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::rename(state_AB = state) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        edge_states %>% dplyr::select(key_gene, Genotype, Day, Neuron, state),
        by = c("key_BC" = "key_gene", "Genotype", "Day", "Neuron")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::rename(state_BC = state) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        edge_states %>% dplyr::select(key_gene, Genotype, Day, Neuron, state),
        by = c("key_AC" = "key_gene", "Genotype", "Day", "Neuron")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::rename(state_AC = state) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        state_AB = tidyr::replace_na(state_AB, "retained"),
        state_BC = tidyr::replace_na(state_BC, "retained"),
        state_AC = tidyr::replace_na(state_AC, "retained"),
        n_lost = (state_AB == "lost") + (state_BC == "lost") + (state_AC == "lost"),
        trimer_state = dplyr::case_when(
          n_lost >= 2 ~ "broken",
          n_lost == 1 ~ "partial",
          n_lost == 0 ~ "intact",
          TRUE ~ "unknown"
        )
      )
    
    return(trimers_states)
  }
  
  timecourse_multi_trimer_states <- assess_multi_timecourse_trimers(
    baseline_trimers = trimers_baseline,
    edge_states = timecourse_multi_edge_genes
  )
  
  # save csv file of trimer and umultimer states
  write_csv(timecourse_multi_trimer_states, file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "timecourse_multi_trimer_states.csv"))
  
  # Summary
  timecourse_multi_trimer_summary <- timecourse_multi_trimer_states %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Genotype, Day, Neuron) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_total = n(),
      n_intact = sum(trimer_state == "intact", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_broken = sum(trimer_state == "broken", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_partial = sum(trimer_state == "partial", na.rm = TRUE),
      frac_broken = n_broken / n_total,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # save csv file summary of trimer and umultimer states
  write_csv(timecourse_multi_trimer_summary, file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "timecourse_multi_trimer_summary.csv"))
  
  # Barplot
  p_trimer_bars <- ggplot(
    timecourse_multi_trimer_summary,
    aes(x = Day, y = n_broken, fill = Neuron)
  ) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = n_broken),
      position = position_dodge(0.7),
      vjust = -0.5,
      size = 2
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ Genotype, ncol = 4, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = neuron_palette, name = "Neuron") +
    labs(
      title = "Broken trimers across genotypes (d30 vs d50)",
      x = "Differentiation day",
      y = "Number of broken trimers"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/global", "bars_broken_trimers_all_genotypes.pdf"), p_trimer_bars, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  
  # Line plot comparison
  timecourse_multi_trimer_numeric <- timecourse_multi_trimer_summary %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Day_numeric = as.numeric(gsub("d", "", Day)))
  
  p_trimer_lines <- ggplot(
    timecourse_multi_trimer_numeric,
    aes(x = Day_numeric, y = n_broken, color = Genotype, linetype = Neuron,
        group = interaction(Genotype, Neuron))
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = genotype_palette, name = "Genotype") +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(iN = "solid", iDA = "dashed"), name = "Neuron") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(30, 50), labels = c("d30", "d50")) +
    labs(
      title = "Trimer breakage trajectory across genotypes",
      x = "Differentiation day",
      y = "Number of broken trimers"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/global", "lines_broken_trimers_genotype_comparison.pdf"), p_trimer_lines, width = 4, height = 3.5,    device = cairo_pdf)
}


# --- Step 9: Complex analysis for multi-genotype timecourse ---
message("\n=== Complex analysis for multi-genotype timecourse ===")

if (!exists("complexes_summary") || !exists("complex_edges_df")) {
  message("complexes_summary or complex_edges_df not found. Skipping complex analysis.")
} else {
  
  # Expand complexes to all genotype × day × neuron
  geno_day_neuron_combos <- timecourse_multi_edge_genes %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Genotype, Day, Neuron)
  
  complexes_expanded <- complex_edges_df %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, community_id, key_gene) %>%
    tidyr::crossing(geno_day_neuron_combos)
  
  # Join edge states
  complexes_multi_timecourse_states <- complexes_expanded %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      timecourse_multi_edge_genes %>% dplyr::select(key_gene, Genotype, Day, Neuron, state),
      by = c("key_gene", "Genotype", "Day", "Neuron")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      state = tidyr::replace_na(state, "retained"),
      edge_lost = state == "lost"
    )
  
  # Aggregate per complex × genotype × day × neuron
  complex_multi_timecourse_summary <- complexes_multi_timecourse_states %>%
    dplyr::group_by(complex_id, Genotype, Day, Neuron) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_edges_total = n(),
      n_edges_lost = sum(edge_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
      frac_edges_lost = n_edges_lost / n_edges_total,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      complexes_summary %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, n_proteins, organelle),
      by = "complex_id"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      complex_state = dplyr::case_when(
        frac_edges_lost >= 0.75 ~ "disrupted",
        frac_edges_lost >= 0.25 ~ "partial",
        TRUE ~ "intact"
      )
    )
  
  # save csv
  write_csv(complex_multi_timecourse_summary,file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "timecourse_multi_complex_states.csv"))
  
  
  # Summary statistics
  complex_disruption_multi_timecourse <- complex_multi_timecourse_summary %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Genotype, Day, Neuron) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_complexes = n(),
      n_intact = sum(complex_state == "intact"),
      n_disrupted = sum(complex_state == "disrupted"),
      n_partial = sum(complex_state == "partial"),
      frac_disrupted = n_disrupted / n_complexes,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  write_csv(
    complex_disruption_multi_timecourse,
    file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "timecourse_multi_complex_disruption_summary.csv")
  )
  
  # Barplot
  p_complex_bars <- ggplot(
    complex_disruption_multi_timecourse,
    aes(x = Day, y = n_disrupted, fill = Neuron)
  ) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = n_disrupted),
      position = position_dodge(0.7),
      vjust = -0.5,
      size = 2
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ Genotype, ncol = 4, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = neuron_palette, name = "Neuron") +
    labs(
      title = "Disrupted complexes across genotypes (d30 vs d50)",
      x = "Differentiation day",
      y = "Number of disrupted complexes"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/global", "bars_disrupted_complexes_all_genotypes.pdf"), p_complex_bars, width = 6, height = 5,    device = cairo_pdf)
  
  # Line plot comparison
  complex_disruption_multi_numeric <- complex_disruption_multi_timecourse %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Day_numeric = as.numeric(gsub("d", "", Day)))
  
  p_complex_lines <- ggplot(
    complex_disruption_multi_numeric,
    aes(x = Day_numeric, y = n_disrupted, color = Genotype, linetype = Neuron,
        group = interaction(Genotype, Neuron))
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = genotype_palette, name = "Genotype") +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(iN = "solid", iDA = "dashed"), name = "Neuron") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(30, 50), labels = c("d30", "d50")) +
    labs(
      title = "Complex disruption trajectory across genotypes",
      x = "Differentiation day",
      y = "Number of disrupted complexes"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/global", "lines_disrupted_complexes_genotype_comparison.pdf"), p_complex_lines,width = 4,height = 3.5, device = cairo_pdf)
}


# --- Step 10: Per-genotype detailed plots ---
message("\n=== Creating per-genotype detailed plots ===")

for (geno in genotypes) {
  
  # Filter data
  geno_summary <- timecourse_multi_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(Genotype == geno)
  
  if (nrow(geno_summary) == 0) next
  
  # Per-genotype barplot
  p_geno_bar <- ggplot(geno_summary, aes(x = Day, y = n_lost, fill = Neuron)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = n_lost),
      position = position_dodge(0.7),
      vjust = -0.5,
      size = 2.5
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = neuron_palette, name = "Neuron") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Lost PPIs in", geno, "(d30 vs d50)"),
      x = "Differentiation day",
      y = "Number of lost PPIs"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/by_genotype", paste0("bars_lost_ppis_", geno, ".pdf")), p_geno_bar, width = 4, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
  
  
  
 # Per-genotype annotation heatmaps
  for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {

    heatmap_data <- timecourse_multi_by_annotation %>%
      # fix: ensure matching types before filtering
      dplyr::mutate(Genotype = as.character(Genotype)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(Genotype == geno, Neuron == nt) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
        id_cols = tag, # Only keep 'tag' as the row identifier
        names_from = Day,
        values_from = n_lost,
        values_fill = 0
      )

    if (nrow(heatmap_data) < 2) {
      message("Insufficient data for ", geno, " ", nt, " annotation heatmap; skipping.")
      next
    }

    # convert to numeric (only d30, d50)
    heatmap_data <- heatmap_data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(across(-tag, ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(trimws(as.character(.))))))

    # create matrix
    heatmap_mat <- as.matrix(heatmap_data[, -1])
    rownames(heatmap_mat) <- heatmap_data$tag

    # skip if all values are NA or non-finite
    if (all(is.na(heatmap_mat)) || !any(is.finite(heatmap_mat))) {
      message("No finite values for ", geno, " ", nt, " heatmap; skipping.")
      next
    }

    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      heatmap_mat,
      scale = "none",
      color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#C51B7D"))(100),
      cluster_rows = TRUE,
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      show_rownames = TRUE,
      show_colnames = TRUE,
      border_color = NA,
      fontsize = 6,
      cellwidth = 8,
      cellheight = 8,
      main = paste("Lost PPIs by annotation -", geno, nt),
      filename = file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/by_genotype", paste0("heatmap_lost_ppis_by_annotation_", geno, "_", nt, ".pdf")),
      width = 4,
      height = 8
    )
  }
}


# --- Step 11: Bubble plots - iDA vs iN for each genotype ---

# --- Step 12: Delta analysis (d50 - d30) ---
message("\n=== Computing delta (d50 - d30) ===")

delta_analysis <- timecourse_multi_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(Genotype, Day, Neuron, n_lost) %>%

    names_from = Day,

  ) %>%

  )

# save csv

# Barplot of delta
p_delta <- ggplot(
  delta_analysis,
  aes(x = reorder(Genotype, -abs_delta), y = delta, fill = Neuron)
) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = neuron_palette, name = "Neuron") +
  labs(
    title = "Change in lost PPIs (d50 - d30)",

  ) +

    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    legend.position = "top"

# --- Step 13: Annotation-specific delta analysis ---
delta_by_annotation <- timecourse_multi_by_annotation %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Day,
    values_from = n_lost,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    delta = d50 - d30
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Genotype, Neuron, desc(abs(delta)))

# save csv
write_csv(delta_by_annotation, file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "delta_by_annotation.csv"))

# --- Heatmap of delta per annotation ---
for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {
  
  heatmap_delta <- delta_by_annotation %>%
    dplyr::filter(Neuron == nt) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = Genotype,
      values_from = delta,
      values_fill = 0
    )
  
  if (nrow(heatmap_delta) < 2) {
    message("Insufficient data for delta heatmap (", nt, "); skipping.")
    next
  }

  # Remove raw count columns and duplicates
  heatmap_delta <- heatmap_delta %>%
    dplyr::select(-c(d30, d50)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(tag, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(across(-c(Neuron, tag), ~ as.numeric(.)))

  # Create numeric matrix with unique rownames
  heatmap_mat <- heatmap_delta %>%
    dplyr::select(-Neuron) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("tag") %>%
    as.matrix()

  # Center color scale at 0
  max_abs <- max(abs(heatmap_mat), na.rm = TRUE)

  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    heatmap_mat,
    scale = "none",
    color = colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(101),
    breaks = seq(-max_abs, max_abs, length.out = 102),
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,
    border_color = NA,
    fontsize = 6,
    cellwidth = 8,
    cellheight = 8,
    main = paste("delta Lost PPIs by annotation (d50 - d30) -", nt),
    filename = file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/global", paste0("heatmap_delta_by_annotation_", nt, ".pdf")),
    width = 6,
    height = 10
  )
}


# --- Step 14: Top changing annotations (ranked by absolute delta) ---

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(mean_abs_delta)) %>%

# save csv

# Lollipop plot

) +

  geom_segment(
    aes(xend = tag, yend = 0),
    linewidth = 3

  labs(
    title = "Top 20 annotations with largest change (d50 - d30)",
```
