```{r}
    y = "Mean Δ Lost PPIs"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/global", "lollipop_top_changing_annotations.pdf"),p_top_changing,width = 3,height = 3, device = cairo_pdf)



# --- Step 15: Summary statistics table ---
summary_stats <- timecourse_multi_summary %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genotype, Neuron) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    d30_lost = n_lost[Day == "d30"],
    d50_lost = n_lost[Day == "d50"],
    delta = d50_lost - d30_lost,
    pct_change = (delta / d30_lost) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(delta)))

# save csv
write_csv(summary_stats, file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "summary_statistics.csv"))

message("\nSummary statistics:")
print(summary_stats)



# --- Step 16: Ratio plots (iDA/iN) ---
ratio_data <- timecourse_multi_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(Genotype, Day, Neuron, n_lost) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Neuron,
    values_from = n_lost
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ratio_iDA_iN = iDA / iN
  )

# save csv
write_csv(ratio_data, file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "ratio_iDA_to_iN.csv"))

# Barplot of ratios
p_ratio <- ggplot(
  ratio_data,
  aes(x = Genotype, y = ratio_iDA_iN, fill = Day)
) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = day_palette, name = "Day") +
  labs(
    title = "Ratio of lost PPIs: iDA / iN",
    x = NULL,
    y = "iDA / iN ratio"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/global", "bars_ratio_iDA_to_iN.pdf"), p_ratio, width = 3, height = 3, device = cairo_pdf)


# --- Final summary message ---
message("\nResults saved to: ", out_dir_timecourse_multi)
message("  - Genotypes analyzed: ", paste(genotypes, collapse = ", "))
message("  - Timepoints: d30, d50")
message("  - Total edge states computed: ", nrow(timecourse_multi_edge_states))
message("  - Trimers assessed: ", ifelse(exists("timecourse_multi_trimer_states"), "Yes", "No"))
message("  - Complexes assessed: ", ifelse(exists("complex_multi_timecourse_summary"), "Yes", "No"))
message("\nKey outputs:")
message("  - Global comparison plots in: plots/global/")
message("  - Per-genotype plots in: plots/by_genotype/")
message("  - Summary tables in: tables/")
```



# PPI Network Connectivity Analysis
```{r}
# =========================================================================
# PPI Network Connectivity Analysis
# Quantify network topology disruption per KO × neuron
# =========================================================================

# --- Master Output Directory ---
out_dir_network <- file.path(out_dir_PPI, "Network_evaluation")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_network, "Step0_baseline"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_network, "M1_hub_vulnerability"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_network, "M2_fragmentation"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_network, "M3_interorganelle_bridges"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_network, "M4_disease_convergence"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Load igraph
library(igraph)


# =========================================================================
# STEP 0: BUILD BASELINE NETWORK & COMPUTE TOPOLOGY
# =========================================================================
message("\n", strrep("=", 70))
message("STEP 0: Building baseline network and computing topology")
message(strrep("=", 70))

# --- 0.1 Create igraph object from baseline edges ---
baseline_net <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
d = baseline_edges_union %>% dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2, key, Predictome_conf, IntAct_present),
directed = FALSE,
vertices = data.frame(name = unique(c(baseline_edges_union$Gene1, baseline_edges_union$Gene2)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
)

message("Baseline network: ", vcount(baseline_net), " proteins, ", ecount(baseline_net), " edges")


# --- 0.2 Add organelle annotations to nodes ---
# Filter organelle tags - remove redundant/detailed annotations
organelle_tags_exclude <- c("EndoLyso", "EndoDetailLoac", "Autophagy_det")
organelle_tags <- setdiff(colnames(binary_matrix)[-1], organelle_tags_exclude)

# Build gene -> organelle mapping (can have multiple annotations per gene)
gene_annotations <- binary_matrix %>%
dplyr::select(Genes, all_of(organelle_tags)) %>%
tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = all_of(organelle_tags), names_to = "annotation", values_to = "present") %>%
dplyr::filter(present == TRUE | present == 1) %>%
dplyr::select(Genes, annotation)

# For network: assign primary annotation (most specific, or first if multiple)
gene_primary_annotation <- gene_annotations %>%
dplyr::group_by(Genes) %>%
dplyr::summarise(annotations = paste(annotation, collapse = ";"), primary_annotation = dplyr::first(annotation), n_annotations = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

# --- Define organelle colors (dynamic) ---
all_annotations <- unique(gene_primary_annotation$primary_annotation)
all_annotations <- all_annotations[all_annotations != "Unannotated"]
organelle_colors <- setNames(colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))(length(all_annotations)), all_annotations)


# Add to network vertices
V(baseline_net)$primary_annotation <- gene_primary_annotation$primary_annotation[match(V(baseline_net)$name, gene_primary_annotation$Genes)]
V(baseline_net)$all_annotations <- gene_primary_annotation$annotations[match(V(baseline_net)$name, gene_primary_annotation$Genes)]
V(baseline_net)$n_annotations <- gene_primary_annotation$n_annotations[match(V(baseline_net)$name, gene_primary_annotation$Genes)]

# Fill NA with "Unannotated"
V(baseline_net)$primary_annotation[is.na(V(baseline_net)$primary_annotation)] <- "Unannotated"
V(baseline_net)$all_annotations[is.na(V(baseline_net)$all_annotations)] <- "Unannotated"
V(baseline_net)$n_annotations[is.na(V(baseline_net)$n_annotations)] <- 0


# --- 0.3 Compute node-level topology metrics ---
message("Computing node topology metrics...")

# Degree (number of interaction partners)
V(baseline_net)$degree <- igraph::degree(baseline_net)

# Betweenness centrality (how often node lies on shortest paths)
V(baseline_net)$betweenness <- igraph::betweenness(baseline_net, normalized = TRUE)

# Clustering coefficient (how connected are neighbors to each other)
V(baseline_net)$clustering_coef <- igraph::transitivity(baseline_net, type = "local")

# Identify hubs: top 10% by degree
degree_threshold_top10 <- quantile(V(baseline_net)$degree, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE)
degree_threshold_top5 <- quantile(V(baseline_net)$degree, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
V(baseline_net)$is_hub_top10 <- V(baseline_net)$degree >= degree_threshold_top10
V(baseline_net)$is_hub_top5 <- V(baseline_net)$degree >= degree_threshold_top5

message("  Hub threshold (top 10%): degree >= ", degree_threshold_top10)
message("  Hub threshold (top 5%): degree >= ", degree_threshold_top5)
message("  Number of top-10% hubs: ", sum(V(baseline_net)$is_hub_top10))
message("  Number of top-5% hubs: ", sum(V(baseline_net)$is_hub_top5))


# --- 0.4 Compute connected components ---
components_baseline <- igraph::components(baseline_net)
message("  Connected components: ", components_baseline$no)
message("  Largest component size: ", max(components_baseline$csize), " proteins (", round(max(components_baseline$csize)/vcount(baseline_net)*100, 1), "%)")

V(baseline_net)$component_id <- components_baseline$membership


# --- 0.5 Classify edges as intra- vs inter-organelle ---
message("Classifying edges by organelle relationship...")

# Get endpoint annotations for each edge
edge_df <- igraph::as_data_frame(baseline_net, what = "edges") %>%
dplyr::left_join(gene_primary_annotation %>% dplyr::select(Genes, primary_annotation), by = c("from" = "Genes")) %>%
dplyr::rename(annotation_from = primary_annotation) %>%
dplyr::left_join(gene_primary_annotation %>% dplyr::select(Genes, primary_annotation), by = c("to" = "Genes")) %>%
dplyr::rename(annotation_to = primary_annotation) %>%
dplyr::mutate(
  annotation_from = tidyr::replace_na(annotation_from, "Unannotated"),
  annotation_to = tidyr::replace_na(annotation_to, "Unannotated"),
  edge_type = dplyr::case_when(
    annotation_from == annotation_to ~ "intra",
    annotation_from == "Unannotated" | annotation_to == "Unannotated" ~ "unknown",
    TRUE ~ "inter"
  ),
  annotation_pair = ifelse(annotation_from <= annotation_to, paste(annotation_from, annotation_to, sep = "::"), paste(annotation_to, annotation_from, sep = "::"))
)

# Add edge attributes
E(baseline_net)$edge_type <- edge_df$edge_type
E(baseline_net)$annotation_pair <- edge_df$annotation_pair

# Summary
edge_type_summary <- table(edge_df$edge_type)
message("  Intra-organelle edges: ", edge_type_summary["intra"])
message("  Inter-organelle edges: ", edge_type_summary["inter"])
message("  Unknown (unannotated): ", edge_type_summary["unknown"])


# --- 0.6 Build inter-organelle edge matrix (baseline) ---
inter_organelle_baseline <- edge_df %>%
dplyr::filter(edge_type == "inter") %>%
dplyr::count(annotation_pair, name = "n_edges_baseline") %>%
dplyr::filter(n_edges_baseline > 10) %>%
tidyr::separate(annotation_pair, into = c("annot_A", "annot_B"), sep = "::", remove = FALSE)

# Also create matrix format
annotation_pairs_all <- edge_df %>%
dplyr::filter(edge_type %in% c("intra", "inter")) %>%
dplyr::count(annotation_from, annotation_to, name = "n_edges") %>%
dplyr::mutate(annotation_from = factor(annotation_from), annotation_to = factor(annotation_to))

# For matrix: only annotations with >10 total edges
annotation_edge_totals <- edge_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(edge_type %in% c("intra", "inter"), annotation_from != "Unannotated", annotation_to != "Unannotated") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(annotation_from, annotation_to), values_to = "annotation") %>%
  dplyr::count(annotation, name = "total_edges") %>%
  dplyr::filter(total_edges > 10)

all_annots <- annotation_edge_totals$annotation

# Symmetric matrix
all_annots <- unique(c(edge_df$annotation_from, edge_df$annotation_to))
all_annots <- all_annots[all_annots != "Unannotated"]
inter_matrix_baseline <- matrix(0, nrow = length(all_annots), ncol = length(all_annots), dimnames = list(all_annots, all_annots))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(annotation_pairs_all))) {
a1 <- as.character(annotation_pairs_all$annotation_from[i])
a2 <- as.character(annotation_pairs_all$annotation_to[i])
if (a1 %in% all_annots && a2 %in% all_annots) {
  inter_matrix_baseline[a1, a2] <- inter_matrix_baseline[a1, a2] + annotation_pairs_all$n_edges[i]
  if (a1 != a2) inter_matrix_baseline[a2, a1] <- inter_matrix_baseline[a2, a1] + annotation_pairs_all$n_edges[i]
}
}


# --- 0.7 Save baseline topology summaries ---
# Node metrics
node_metrics_baseline <- data.frame(
Gene = V(baseline_net)$name,
degree = V(baseline_net)$degree,
betweenness = V(baseline_net)$betweenness,
clustering_coef = V(baseline_net)$clustering_coef,
is_hub_top10 = V(baseline_net)$is_hub_top10,
is_hub_top5 = V(baseline_net)$is_hub_top5,
primary_annotation = V(baseline_net)$primary_annotation,
all_annotations = V(baseline_net)$all_annotations,
component_id = V(baseline_net)$component_id,
stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>% dplyr::arrange(desc(degree))

write_csv(node_metrics_baseline, file.path(out_dir_network, "Step0_baseline", "node_metrics_baseline.csv"))

# Edge classification
write_csv(edge_df, file.path(out_dir_network, "Step0_baseline", "edge_classification_baseline.csv"))

# Inter-organelle matrix
write.csv(inter_matrix_baseline, file.path(out_dir_network, "Step0_baseline", "inter_organelle_matrix_baseline.csv"))

# Summary stats
baseline_summary <- list(
n_proteins = vcount(baseline_net),
n_edges = ecount(baseline_net),
n_components = components_baseline$no,
largest_component_size = max(components_baseline$csize),
largest_component_pct = round(max(components_baseline$csize)/vcount(baseline_net)*100, 2),
n_hubs_top10 = sum(V(baseline_net)$is_hub_top10),
n_hubs_top5 = sum(V(baseline_net)$is_hub_top5),
hub_degree_threshold_top10 = degree_threshold_top10,
hub_degree_threshold_top5 = degree_threshold_top5,
n_intra_edges = as.numeric(edge_type_summary["intra"]),
n_inter_edges = as.numeric(edge_type_summary["inter"]),
mean_degree = mean(V(baseline_net)$degree),
median_degree = median(V(baseline_net)$degree),
max_degree = max(V(baseline_net)$degree)
)
# save database as rds file
saveRDS(baseline_summary, file.path(out_dir_network, "Step0_baseline", "baseline_summary.rds"))


# --- 0.8 Baseline visualizations ---
message("Generating baseline visualizations...")

# Degree distribution
p_degree_dist <- ggplot(node_metrics_baseline, aes(x = degree)) +
geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "dodgerblue3", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
geom_vline(xintercept = degree_threshold_top10, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
annotate("text", x = degree_threshold_top10 + 5, y = Inf, label = "Top 10%", vjust = 2, hjust = 0, size = 2.5, color = "red") +
scale_x_log10() +
labs(title = "Baseline degree distribution", x = "Degree (log10) | Number of Interaction per hub", y = "Count") +
theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), 
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))

# save as pdf
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_network, "Step0_baseline", "degree_distribution.pdf"), p_degree_dist, width = 3, height = 3, device = cairo_pdf)

# Degree by annotation
p_degree_by_annot <- ggplot(node_metrics_baseline %>% dplyr::filter(primary_annotation != "Unannotated"), aes(x = reorder(primary_annotation, degree, median), y = degree, fill = primary_annotation)) +
geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3, linewidth = 0.3) +
scale_y_log10() +
scale_fill_manual(values = organelle_colors, guide = "none") +
coord_flip() +
labs(
  title = "Degree distribution (Number of interactions) by annotation", 
  x = NULL, y = "Degree (log10) | Number of Interaction per hub") +
theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), 
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))

# save as pdf
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_network, "Step0_baseline", "degree_by_annotation.pdf"), p_degree_by_annot, width = 5, height = 6, device = cairo_pdf)

# Inter-organelle heatmap
# Filter to annotations with meaningful edges
annots_with_edges <- rownames(inter_matrix_baseline)[rowSums(inter_matrix_baseline) > 10]
inter_matrix_filtered <- inter_matrix_baseline[annots_with_edges, annots_with_edges]

if (nrow(inter_matrix_filtered) >= 2) {
pheatmap::pheatmap(
  inter_matrix_filtered,
  scale = "none",
  color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "dodgerblue", "dodgerblue4"))(100),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.0f",
  fontsize = 6,
  fontsize_number = 5,
  cellwidth = 12,
  cellheight = 12,
  border_color = NA,
  main = "Baseline inter-organelle edge counts",
  filename = file.path(out_dir_network, "Step0_baseline", "heatmap_inter_organelle_baseline.pdf"),
  width = 10, height = 9
)
}

# Top hubs table
top_hubs <- node_metrics_baseline %>%
dplyr::filter(is_hub_top5) %>%
dplyr::arrange(desc(degree)) %>%
dplyr::slice_head(n = 50)

write_csv(top_hubs, file.path(out_dir_network, "Step0_baseline", "top_hubs_baseline.csv"))

message("Step 0 complete. Baseline network built with ", vcount(baseline_net), " nodes and ", ecount(baseline_net), " edges.")


# --- 0.9 Annotation-level summary network ---
# Collapse proteins to annotation nodes, edge width = number of PPIs
message("Building annotation-level summary network...")

# Count edges between annotation pairs (including intra)
annotation_edge_counts <- edge_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(annotation_from != "Unannotated", annotation_to != "Unannotated") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(annotation_from, annotation_to) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_edges = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_edges >= 15)  # minimum threshold for visibility

# Count proteins per annotation
annotation_node_sizes <- gene_primary_annotation %>%
  dplyr::filter(primary_annotation != "Unannotated") %>%
  dplyr::count(primary_annotation, name = "n_proteins")

# Build annotation-level graph
annot_net <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
  d = annotation_edge_counts,
  directed = FALSE,
  vertices = annotation_node_sizes
)

# Remove self-loops for cleaner visualization
# First, keep track of inter-annotation edges only (no self-loops)
inter_annotation_edges <- annotation_edge_counts %>%
  dplyr::filter(annotation_from != annotation_to)

# Get only annotations that  have inter-annotation edges
connected_annots <- unique(c(inter_annotation_edges$annotation_from, inter_annotation_edges$annotation_to))

# Filter to only connected annotations
annotation_node_sizes_connected <- annotation_node_sizes %>%
  dplyr::filter(primary_annotation %in% connected_annots)

# Rebuild graph - now no orphans
annot_net_no_loops <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
  d = inter_annotation_edges,
  directed = FALSE,
  vertices = annotation_node_sizes_connected
)

# Set visual attributes
V(annot_net_no_loops)$size <- sqrt(V(annot_net_no_loops)$n_proteins) * 2
V(annot_net_no_loops)$color <- organelle_colors[V(annot_net_no_loops)$name]
V(annot_net_no_loops)$color[is.na(V(annot_net_no_loops)$color)] <- "grey70"
V(annot_net_no_loops)$label <- V(annot_net_no_loops)$name
V(annot_net_no_loops)$label.cex <- 0.5
V(annot_net_no_loops)$label.color <- "black"

# Edge width proportional to number of PPIs (n_edges is preserved from edge list)
E(annot_net_no_loops)$width <- log10(E(annot_net_no_loops)$n_edges + 1) * 1.5
E(annot_net_no_loops)$color <- "grey60"

# Plot annotation network
pdf(file.path(out_dir_network, "Step0_baseline", "network_annotation_level.pdf"), width = 10, height = 10)
set.seed(42)
layout_fr <- igraph::layout_with_fr(annot_net_no_loops)

# Build color vector matching vertex order
node_colors <- organelle_colors[V(annot_net_no_loops)$name]
node_colors[is.na(node_colors)] <- "grey70"

plot(annot_net_no_loops,
     layout = layout_fr,
     vertex.frame.color = "black",
     vertex.frame.width = 0.5,
     edge.curved = 0.1,
     main = "Annotation-level PPI network\n(node size = # proteins, edge width = # PPIs)")
dev.off()

# Also create a cleaner circular layout version
pdf(file.path(out_dir_network, "Step0_baseline", "network_annotation_circular.pdf"), width = 10, height = 10)
layout_circle <- igraph::layout_in_circle(annot_net_no_loops)
plot(annot_net_no_loops,
     layout = layout_circle,
     vertex.size = sqrt(V(annot_net_no_loops)$n_proteins) * 1.3,  # smaller multiplier
     vertex.label.dist = 1,  # push labels away from nodes
     vertex.label.cex = 0.4,  # smaller labels
     vertex.frame.color = "black",
     vertex.frame.width = 0.5,
     edge.curved = 0.2,
     main = "Annotation-level PPI network (circular)\n(node size = # proteins, edge width = # PPIs)")
dev.off()

# Save annotation network summary
annotation_network_summary <- data.frame(
  annotation = V(annot_net_no_loops)$name,
  n_proteins = V(annot_net_no_loops)$n_proteins,
  degree_in_annot_net = igraph::degree(annot_net_no_loops),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>% dplyr::arrange(desc(n_proteins))

write_csv(annotation_network_summary, file.path(out_dir_network, "Step0_baseline", "annotation_network_summary.csv"))

message("  Annotation network: ", vcount(annot_net_no_loops), " annotation nodes, ", ecount(annot_net_no_loops), " inter-annotation edges")





# =========================================================================
# MODULE 1: HUB VULNERABILITY
# =========================================================================
message("\n", strrep("=", 70))
message("MODULE 1: Hub Vulnerability Analysis")
message(strrep("=", 70))

# For each KO × neuron: calculate how many partners each hub loses

# --- 1.1 Get baseline degree for all proteins ---
baseline_degree <- data.frame(Gene = V(baseline_net)$name, baseline_degree = V(baseline_net)$degree, is_hub_top10 = V(baseline_net)$is_hub_top10, is_hub_top5 = V(baseline_net)$is_hub_top5, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


# --- 1.2 Calculate retained degree per KO × neuron ---
message("Calculating hub vulnerability per KO × neuron...")

hub_vulnerability_list <- list()

ko_neuron_combos <- ko_edge_states %>% dplyr::distinct(genotype, neuron)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(ko_neuron_combos))) {
geno <- ko_neuron_combos$genotype[i]
nt <- ko_neuron_combos$neuron[i]

# Get retained edges for this KO × neuron
retained_edges <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::filter(genotype == geno, neuron == nt, state == "retained") %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2)

# Build subgraph from retained edges
if (nrow(retained_edges) > 0) {
  retained_net <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(retained_edges, directed = FALSE, vertices = data.frame(name = unique(c(retained_edges$Gene1, retained_edges$Gene2))))
  
  # Calculate degree in retained network
  retained_degree <- data.frame(Gene = V(retained_net)$name, retained_degree = igraph::degree(retained_net), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
} else {
  retained_degree <- data.frame(Gene = character(0), retained_degree = integer(0), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# Join with baseline
hub_vuln <- baseline_degree %>%
  dplyr::left_join(retained_degree, by = "Gene") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    retained_degree = tidyr::replace_na(retained_degree, 0),
    lost_degree = baseline_degree - retained_degree,
    frac_degree_lost = ifelse(baseline_degree > 0, lost_degree / baseline_degree, 0),
    genotype = geno,
    neuron = nt
  )

hub_vulnerability_list[[paste(geno, nt, sep = "_")]] <- hub_vuln
}

hub_vulnerability_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(hub_vulnerability_list)

# Save full table
write_csv(hub_vulnerability_all, file.path(out_dir_network, "M1_hub_vulnerability", "hub_vulnerability_all_proteins.csv"))


# --- 1.3 Summary: hub vulnerability per KO × neuron ---
hub_vuln_summary <- hub_vulnerability_all %>%
dplyr::filter(is_hub_top10) %>%
dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron) %>%
dplyr::summarise(
  n_hubs = dplyr::n(),
  mean_frac_lost = mean(frac_degree_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_frac_lost = median(frac_degree_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
  total_degree_lost = sum(lost_degree, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_hubs_50pct_lost = sum(frac_degree_lost >= 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
  .groups = "drop"
) %>%
dplyr::left_join(disease_classes_dataframe, by = c("genotype" = "sample")) %>%
dplyr::arrange(desc(mean_frac_lost))

# save hub vulnearbility as csv
write_csv(hub_vuln_summary, file.path(out_dir_network, "M1_hub_vulnerability", "hub_vulnerability_summary.csv"))


# --- 1.4 Identify recurrently vulnerable hubs ---
recurrent_vulnerable_hubs <- hub_vulnerability_all %>%
dplyr::filter(is_hub_top10, frac_degree_lost >= 0.3) %>%
dplyr::group_by(Gene) %>%
dplyr::summarise(
  n_KOs_affected = dplyr::n_distinct(genotype),
  mean_frac_lost = mean(frac_degree_lost),
  baseline_degree = dplyr::first(baseline_degree),
  .groups = "drop"
) %>%
dplyr::filter(n_KOs_affected >= 3) %>%
dplyr::arrange(desc(n_KOs_affected), desc(mean_frac_lost))

# save recurring vulnearbility as csv

# =========================================================================
# MODULE 2: NETWORK FRAGMENTATION
# =========================================================================
message("\n", strrep("=", 70))
message("MODULE 2: Network Fragmentation Analysis")
message(strrep("=", 70))

# --- 2.1 Calculate fragmentation metrics per KO × neuron ---
fragmentation_list <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(ko_neuron_combos))) {
geno <- ko_neuron_combos$genotype[i]
nt <- ko_neuron_combos$neuron[i]

# Get retained edges
retained_edges <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::filter(genotype == geno, neuron == nt, state == "retained") %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2)

if (nrow(retained_edges) > 0) {
  # Build retained network (keep all original vertices to detect orphans)
  retained_net <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
    retained_edges,
    directed = FALSE,
    vertices = data.frame(name = V(baseline_net)$name)
  )
  
  # Calculate components
  comp <- igraph::components(retained_net)
  
  # Orphans = degree 0, since has no interaction partners in structure prediction
  orphans <- sum(igraph::degree(retained_net) == 0)
  
  frag_metrics <- data.frame(
    genotype = geno,
    neuron = nt,
    n_components = comp$no,
    largest_component_size = max(comp$csize),
    largest_component_pct = max(comp$csize) / vcount(retained_net) * 100,
    n_orphans = orphans,
    orphan_pct = orphans / vcount(retained_net) * 100,
    n_edges_retained = ecount(retained_net),
    n_edges_lost = ecount(baseline_net) - ecount(retained_net),
    frac_edges_lost = (ecount(baseline_net) - ecount(retained_net)) / ecount(baseline_net),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
} else {
  frag_metrics <- data.frame(
    genotype = geno,
    neuron = nt,
    n_components = vcount(baseline_net),
    largest_component_size = 1,
    largest_component_pct = 1 / vcount(baseline_net) * 100,
    n_orphans = vcount(baseline_net),
    orphan_pct = 100,
    n_edges_retained = 0,
    n_edges_lost = ecount(baseline_net),
    frac_edges_lost = 1,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

fragmentation_list[[paste(geno, nt, sep = "_")]] <- frag_metrics
}

fragmentation_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(fragmentation_list) %>%
dplyr::mutate(
  delta_components = n_components - baseline_summary$n_components,
  delta_largest_pct = baseline_summary$largest_component_pct - largest_component_pct,
  fragmentation_score = (delta_components / baseline_summary$n_components) + (delta_largest_pct / 100) + (orphan_pct / 100)
) %>%
dplyr::left_join(disease_classes_dataframe, by = c("genotype" = "sample")) %>%
dplyr::arrange(desc(fragmentation_score))

# save general network fragmentation list as csv
write_csv(fragmentation_all, file.path(out_dir_network, "M2_fragmentation", "fragmentation_metrics.csv"))


# --- 2.2 Visualizations ---
# Barplot: fragmentation score per KO
p_frag_bar <- ggplot(fragmentation_all, aes(x = reorder(genotype, -fragmentation_score), y = fragmentation_score, fill = neuron)) +
geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, width = 0.7) +
scale_fill_manual(values = c(iN = "grey60", iDA = "grey80"), name = "Neuron") +
labs(title = "Network fragmentation per KO", x = NULL, y = "Fragmentation score") +
theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), 
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA), 
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_network, "M2_fragmentation", "barplot_fragmentation_per_KO.pdf"), p_frag_bar, width = 4.5, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)

# Scatter: orphans vs components

geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 0.3) +
ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = genotype), size = 2, max.overlaps = 20) +

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_network, "M2_fragmentation", "scatter_orphans_vs_components.pdf"), p_frag_scatter, width = 7, height = 3.5, device = cairo_pdf)

# Largest component % retained

geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, width = 0.7) +

     x = NULL,

theme_bw(base_size = 6) +

# =========================================================================
# MODULE 3: INTER-ORGANELLE BRIDGE DISRUPTION
# =========================================================================

#n_KOs_gt30pct_lost == number of KO × neuron combinations where >30% of that annotation pair's edges were lost. It's a count of "how many genotypes severely disrupt this connection."

message("\n", strrep("=", 70))
message("MODULE 3: Inter-organelle Bridge Analysis")
message(strrep("=", 70))

# --- 3.1 Calculate inter-organelle edges per KO × neuron ---
inter_organelle_ko_list <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(ko_neuron_combos))) {
geno <- ko_neuron_combos$genotype[i]
nt <- ko_neuron_combos$neuron[i]

# Get edge states for this KO
edge_states_ko <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::filter(genotype == geno, neuron == nt) %>%
  dplyr::select(key, state)

# Join with edge classification
edges_with_state <- edge_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(edge_states_ko, by = "key") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(state = tidyr::replace_na(state, "unknown"))

# Count inter-organelle edges by state
inter_summary <- edges_with_state %>%
  dplyr::filter(edge_type == "inter") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(annotation_pair) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_baseline = dplyr::n(),
    n_retained = sum(state == "retained", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_lost = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_lost = n_lost / n_baseline,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(genotype = geno, neuron = nt)

inter_organelle_ko_list[[paste(geno, nt, sep = "_")]] <- inter_summary
}

inter_organelle_ko_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(inter_organelle_ko_list) %>%
tidyr::separate(annotation_pair, into = c("annot_A", "annot_B"), sep = "::", remove = FALSE) %>%
dplyr::left_join(disease_classes_dataframe, by = c("genotype" = "sample"))

# csv by KO for organelle edges / bridges lost 
write_csv(inter_organelle_ko_all, file.path(out_dir_network, "M3_interorganelle_bridges", "inter_organelle_edges_per_KO.csv"))


# --- 3.2 Summary: most disrupted annotation pairs ---
inter_organelle_summary <- inter_organelle_ko_all %>%
dplyr::group_by(annotation_pair, annot_A, annot_B) %>%
dplyr::summarise(
  mean_frac_lost = mean(frac_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_frac_lost = median(frac_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
  total_baseline = sum(n_baseline) / dplyr::n_distinct(paste(genotype, neuron)),
  n_KOs_gt30pct_lost = sum(frac_lost > 0.3),
  .groups = "drop"
) %>%
dplyr::arrange(desc(mean_frac_lost))

# save disrupted annotation pairs as csv
write_csv(inter_organelle_summary, file.path(out_dir_network, "M3_interorganelle_bridges", "inter_organelle_summary.csv"))


# --- 3.3 Build inter-organelle loss matrix per KO × neuron ---
# Create heatmaps showing which organelle pairs lose connectivity

build_inter_matrix_ko <- function(inter_ko_df, all_annots) {
mat <- matrix(0, nrow = length(all_annots), ncol = length(all_annots), dimnames = list(all_annots, all_annots))

for (j in seq_len(nrow(inter_ko_df))) {
  a1 <- inter_ko_df$annot_A[j]
  a2 <- inter_ko_df$annot_B[j]
  if (a1 %in% all_annots && a2 %in% all_annots) {
    mat[a1, a2] <- inter_ko_df$frac_lost[j]
    mat[a2, a1] <- inter_ko_df$frac_lost[j]
  }
}
return(mat)
}

# Get annotation list (exclude unannotated, keep only those with edges)
annots_for_matrix <- unique(c(inter_organelle_ko_all$annot_A, inter_organelle_ko_all$annot_B))
annots_for_matrix <- annots_for_matrix[!is.na(annots_for_matrix) & annots_for_matrix != "Unannotated"]



# --- 3.4 Visualizations ---
# Heatmap: mean % lost per annotation pair (across all KOs)
mean_loss_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = length(annots_for_matrix), ncol = length(annots_for_matrix), dimnames = list(annots_for_matrix, annots_for_matrix))

for (ap in unique(inter_organelle_summary$annotation_pair)) {
row_data <- inter_organelle_summary %>% dplyr::filter(annotation_pair == ap)
a1 <- row_data$annot_A
a2 <- row_data$annot_B
if (a1 %in% annots_for_matrix && a2 %in% annots_for_matrix) {
  mean_loss_matrix[a1, a2] <- row_data$mean_frac_lost
  mean_loss_matrix[a2, a1] <- row_data$mean_frac_lost
}
}

# Filter to pairs with meaningful baseline edges
pairs_with_edges <- inter_organelle_summary %>% dplyr::filter(total_baseline >= 5) %>% dplyr::pull(annotation_pair)
annots_with_edges <- unique(c(inter_organelle_summary$annot_A[inter_organelle_summary$annotation_pair %in% pairs_with_edges], inter_organelle_summary$annot_B[inter_organelle_summary$annotation_pair %in% pairs_with_edges]))
mean_loss_matrix_filtered <- mean_loss_matrix[annots_with_edges, annots_with_edges]

if (nrow(mean_loss_matrix_filtered) >= 2) {
# Custom heatmap: lower triangle = color, upper triangle = numbers
# Use corrplot-style or manual approach
library(corrplot)

pdf(file.path(out_dir_network, "M3_interorganelle_bridges", "heatmap_mean_inter_organelle_loss.pdf"), width = 5, height = 5)
corrplot(mean_loss_matrix_filtered,
         method = "color",
         type = "lower",
         col = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#FDAE61", "#D53E4F"))(100),
         is.corr = FALSE,
         cl.lim = c(0, max(mean_loss_matrix_filtered, na.rm = TRUE)),
         tl.col = "black",
         tl.cex = 0.6,
         cl.cex = 0.6,
         addCoef.col = NULL,
         title = "Mean fraction inter-organelle edges lost (all KOs)",
         mar = c(0, 0, 2, 0))
# Add numbers to upper triangle
corrplot(mean_loss_matrix_filtered,
         method = "number",
         type = "upper",
         col = "black",
         is.corr = FALSE,
         number.cex = 0.5,
         tl.pos = "n",
         cl.pos = "n",
         add = TRUE)
dev.off()

# Also save standard pheatmap version with clustering
pheatmap::pheatmap(
  mean_loss_matrix_filtered,
  scale = "none",
  color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#FDAE61", "#D53E4F"))(100),
  breaks = seq(0, max(mean_loss_matrix_filtered, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1, length.out = 101),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.2f",
  fontsize = 6,
  fontsize_number = 5,
  cellwidth = 8,
  cellheight = 8,
  border_color = NA,
  main = "Mean fraction inter-organelle edges lost (clustered)",
  filename = file.path(out_dir_network, "M3_interorganelle_bridges", "heatmap_mean_inter_organelle_loss_clustered.pdf"),
  width = 10, height = 9
)
}

# Per-KO heatmaps for selected KOs (top 10 most disruptive)
top_disruptive_kos <- fragmentation_all %>%
dplyr::arrange(desc(fragmentation_score)) %>%
dplyr::slice_head(n = 10) %>%
dplyr::pull(genotype) %>%
unique() %>%
head(10)

for (geno in top_disruptive_kos) {
for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {
  inter_ko_df <- inter_organelle_ko_all %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype == geno, neuron == nt)
  
  if (nrow(inter_ko_df) < 2) next
  
  mat_ko <- build_inter_matrix_ko(inter_ko_df, annots_with_edges)
  
  # Check if matrix has enough non-zero values for clustering
  n_nonzero_rows <- sum(rowSums(mat_ko, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
  do_cluster <- n_nonzero_rows >= 3
  
  # Custom heatmap: lower triangle = color, upper triangle = numbers
  pdf(file.path(out_dir_network, "M3_interorganelle_bridges", paste0("heatmap_", geno, "_", nt, ".pdf")), width = 5, height = 5)
  
  # Reorder matrix if clustering is desired
  if (do_cluster && nrow(mat_ko) >= 3) {
    # Hierarchical clustering for ordering
    hc <- hclust(as.dist(1 - mat_ko), method = "ward.D2")
    mat_ko_ordered <- mat_ko[hc$order, hc$order]
  } else {
    mat_ko_ordered <- mat_ko
  }
  
  corrplot(mat_ko_ordered,
           method = "color",
           type = "lower",
           col = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#FDAE61", "#D53E4F"))(100),
           is.corr = FALSE,
           cl.lim = c(0, 1),
           tl.col = "black",
           tl.cex = 0.6,
           cl.cex = 0.6,
           addCoef.col = NULL,
           title = paste0("Inter-organelle edge loss: ", geno, " ", nt, ifelse(!do_cluster, " (no clustering)", "")),
           mar = c(0, 0, 2, 0))
  # Add numbers to upper triangle
  corrplot(mat_ko_ordered,
           method = "number",
           type = "upper",
           col = "black",
           is.corr = FALSE,
           number.cex = 0.5,
           tl.pos = "n",
           cl.pos = "n",
           add = TRUE)
  dev.off()
}
}

# Hub vulnerability by disease class
```

# Ceramide Pathway Disruption Analysis
```{r}
# ==========================================================================
# Ceramide Pathway Disruption Analysis
# Compare PPI/complex disruption across sphingolipidosis genes
# ==========================================================================
# 
# Hypothesis: Enzymes proximal to ceramide (ASAH1, GBA1, SMPD1) show 
# convergent PPI/complex disruption despite acting on different substrates,
# because they all affect ceramide homeostasis.
#
# Approach:
# 1. Encode sphingolipid pathway as branch + depth from ceramide
# 2. Compute Jaccard similarity of lost PPIs between all sphingolipidosis KOs
# 3. Compute correlation of complex disruption profiles
# 4. Test if ceramide-proximal enzymes cluster together
# 5. Identify shared disrupted complexes (ceramide-sensitive machinery)
#
# Key comparisons:
# - ASAH1 vs GBA1: Both affect ceramide, opposite directions
# - HEXA vs HEXB: Same substrate (GM2), positive control
# - GBA1 vs SMPD1: Both produce ceramide, different branches

# Jaccard similarity as measure:
# - Jaccard measures overlap of binary sets (lost vs not lost).
# - PPI loss is binary (edge lost or not)
# - Handles sparse data well (most PPIs are not lost in any given KO)
# - Intuitive: intersection / union = what fraction of affected PPIs are shared
# ==========================================================================

# --- Step 1: Define pathway structure ---
sphingo_pathway <- data.frame(
  gene = c("HEXA", "HEXB", "GBA1", "SMPD1", "ASAH1", "PSAP"),
  branch = c("ganglioside", "ganglioside", "glucocerebroside", "sphingomyelin", "downstream", "activator"),
  depth_from_ceramide = c(3, 3, 1, 1, -1, 0),
  substrate = c("GM2", "GM2", "Glucocerebroside", "Sphingomyelin", "Ceramide", "multiple"),
  product = c("GM3", "GM3", "Ceramide", "Ceramide", "Sphingosine", "multiple"),
  disease = c("Tay-Sachs", "Sandhoff", "Gaucher", "Niemann-Pick", "Farber", "Saposin deficiency"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

message("Sphingolipidosis pathway genes:")
print(sphingo_pathway)


# --- Step 2: Extract PPI loss profiles for sphingolipidosis KOs ---
# Filter ko_edge_states to sphingolipidosis genes
sphingo_genes <- sphingo_pathway$gene
sphingo_edge_states <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::filter(genotype %in% sphingo_genes)

message("Edge states for sphingolipidosis KOs: ", nrow(sphingo_edge_states))

# Create binary loss matrix: rows = PPI edges (key), cols = genotype_neuron
sphingo_loss_wide <- sphingo_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::select(key, genotype, neuron, state) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lost = as.integer(state == "lost"),
                sample = paste(genotype, neuron, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(key, sample, lost) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = lost, values_fill = 0)

message("PPI loss matrix: ", nrow(sphingo_loss_wide), " edges x ", ncol(sphingo_loss_wide) - 1, " samples")


# --- Step 3: Compute pairwise Jaccard similarity of lost PPIs ---
compute_jaccard <- function(x, y) {
  intersection <- sum(x == 1 & y == 1)
  union <- sum(x == 1 | y == 1)
  if (union == 0) return(NA)
  return(intersection / union)
}

# Get sample columns
sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(sphingo_loss_wide), "key")
loss_mat <- as.matrix(sphingo_loss_wide[, sample_cols])

# Compute Jaccard matrix
n_samples <- length(sample_cols)
jaccard_mat <- matrix(NA, n_samples, n_samples, dimnames = list(sample_cols, sample_cols))

for (i in 1:n_samples) {
  for (j in 1:n_samples) {
    jaccard_mat[i, j] <- compute_jaccard(loss_mat[, i], loss_mat[, j])
  }
}

message("Jaccard similarity matrix computed")


# --- Step 4: Compute correlation of frac_edges_lost per complex ---
# Get complex-level disruption for sphingolipidosis KOs
sphingo_complex <- complex_ko_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(genotype %in% sphingo_genes) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sample = paste(genotype, neuron, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(complex_id, sample, frac_edges_lost)

# Pivot to wide format
sphingo_complex_wide <- sphingo_complex %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = frac_edges_lost, values_fill = 0)

complex_mat <- as.matrix(sphingo_complex_wide[, -1])
correlation_mat <- cor(complex_mat, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

message("Complex disruption correlation matrix computed")


# --- Step 5: Key comparisons ---
comparisons <- list(
  # Same substrate (should be highest)
  "HEXA_vs_HEXB" = list(a = "HEXA", b = "HEXB", hypothesis = "Same substrate (GM2), expect high similarity"),
  # Both produce ceramide
  "GBA1_vs_SMPD1" = list(a = "GBA1", b = "SMPD1", hypothesis = "Both produce ceramide, different branches"),
  # Main question: ceramide convergence
  "ASAH1_vs_GBA1" = list(a = "ASAH1", b = "GBA1", hypothesis = "Both affect ceramide levels"),
  "ASAH1_vs_SMPD1" = list(a = "ASAH1", b = "SMPD1", hypothesis = "Both affect ceramide levels"),
  # Upstream vs downstream
  "HEXA_vs_ASAH1" = list(a = "HEXA", b = "ASAH1", hypothesis = "Distal upstream vs downstream of ceramide"),
  # PSAP as GBA1 activator
  "PSAP_vs_GBA1" = list(a = "PSAP", b = "GBA1", hypothesis = "PSAP activates GBA1, expect similarity")
)

# Function to extract similarity for a gene pair across neuron types
get_pair_similarity <- function(gene_a, gene_b, sim_mat, neuron = "iN") {
  sample_a <- paste(gene_a, neuron, sep = "_")
  sample_b <- paste(gene_b, neuron, sep = "_")
  if (sample_a %in% rownames(sim_mat) && sample_b %in% colnames(sim_mat)) {
    return(sim_mat[sample_a, sample_b])
  }
  return(NA)
}

# Compute similarities for key comparisons
comparison_results <- data.frame(
  comparison = names(comparisons),
  hypothesis = sapply(comparisons, function(x) x$hypothesis),
  jaccard_iN = sapply(comparisons, function(x) get_pair_similarity(x$a, x$b, jaccard_mat, "iN")),
  jaccard_iDA = sapply(comparisons, function(x) get_pair_similarity(x$a, x$b, jaccard_mat, "iDA")),
  corr_iN = sapply(comparisons, function(x) get_pair_similarity(x$a, x$b, correlation_mat, "iN")),
  corr_iDA = sapply(comparisons, function(x) get_pair_similarity(x$a, x$b, correlation_mat, "iDA")),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

message("\nKey pathway comparisons:")
print(comparison_results)


# --- Step 6: Visualize similarity matrices ---
out_dir_ceramide <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "ceramide_pathway")
dir.create(out_dir_ceramide, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Heatmap of Jaccard similarity
pheatmap::pheatmap(
  jaccard_mat,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#2166AC"))(100),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.2f",
  fontsize = 6,
  fontsize_number = 5,
  border_color = NA,
  main = "Jaccard similarity of lost PPIs\n(Sphingolipidosis KOs)",
  filename = file.path(out_dir_ceramide, "jaccard_similarity_heatmap.pdf"),
  width = 6,
  height = 6
)

# Heatmap of complex correlation
pheatmap::pheatmap(
  correlation_mat,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#B2182B", "white", "#2166AC"))(100),
  breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.2f",
  fontsize = 6,
  fontsize_number = 5,
  border_color = NA,
  main = "Correlation of complex disruption\n(Sphingolipidosis KOs)",
  filename = file.path(out_dir_ceramide, "complex_correlation_heatmap.pdf"),
  width = 6,
  height = 6
)


# --- Step 7: Compare to non-sphingolipidosis KOs (background) ---

# Get all pairwise Jaccard values for sphingo vs sphingo
sphingo_samples_iN <- paste(sphingo_genes, "iN", sep = "_")
sphingo_samples_iN <- sphingo_samples_iN[sphingo_samples_iN %in% sample_cols]

sphingo_pairs <- c()
for (i in 1:(length(sphingo_samples_iN) - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):length(sphingo_samples_iN)) {
    sphingo_pairs <- c(sphingo_pairs, jaccard_mat[sphingo_samples_iN[i], sphingo_samples_iN[j]])
  }
}

# Compare ASAH1-GBA1 to distribution
asah1_gba1_jaccard <- get_pair_similarity("ASAH1", "GBA1", jaccard_mat, "iN")

message("\n--- Ceramide convergence test ---")
message("ASAH1 vs GBA1 Jaccard (iN): ", round(asah1_gba1_jaccard, 3))
message("Mean sphingolipidosis pair Jaccard: ", round(mean(sphingo_pairs, na.rm = TRUE), 3))
message("Range: ", round(min(sphingo_pairs, na.rm = TRUE), 3), " - ", round(max(sphingo_pairs, na.rm = TRUE), 3))


# --- Step 8: Shared disrupted complexes for high-similarity pairs (Jaccard > 0.25) ---

jaccard_threshold <- 0.25

# Get high-similarity pairs
high_sim_pairs <- all_pairs %>%
  dplyr::filter(jaccard_iN > jaccard_threshold) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(jaccard_iN))

message("\nHigh-similarity pairs (Jaccard > ", jaccard_threshold, "):")
print(high_sim_pairs %>% dplyr::select(gene_a, gene_b, jaccard_iN))

# Function to get shared disrupted complexes for a gene pair
get_shared_complexes <- function(gene_a, gene_b, complex_summary, complexes_info) {
  
  disrupted_a <- complex_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype == gene_a, complex_state %in% c("disrupted", "partial")) %>%
    dplyr::pull(complex_id) %>% unique()
  
  disrupted_b <- complex_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype == gene_b, complex_state %in% c("disrupted", "partial")) %>%
    dplyr::pull(complex_id) %>% unique()
  
  shared <- intersect(disrupted_a, disrupted_b)
  
  if (length(shared) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  complexes_info %>%
    dplyr::filter(complex_id %in% shared) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(gene_pair = paste(gene_a, gene_b, sep = "_vs_"))
}

# Compute shared complexes for all high-similarity pairs
shared_complexes_list <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(high_sim_pairs))) {
  pair <- high_sim_pairs[i, ]
  shared <- get_shared_complexes(pair$gene_a, pair$gene_b, complex_ko_summary, complexes_summary)
  if (!is.null(shared)) {
    shared_complexes_list[[paste(pair$gene_a, pair$gene_b, sep = "_vs_")]] <- shared
  }
}

# Combine into single dataframe
shared_complexes_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(shared_complexes_list)

if (nrow(shared_complexes_all) > 0) {
  write_csv(shared_complexes_all, file.path(out_dir_ceramide, "shared_disrupted_high_similarity_pairs.csv"))
  
  message("\nShared disrupted complexes by pair:")
  shared_complexes_all %>%
    dplyr::count(gene_pair, name = "n_shared_complexes") %>%
    print()
}

# Three-way intersection: ASAH1 ∩ GBA1 ∩ SMPD1 (ceramide core)
asah1_disrupted <- complex_ko_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(genotype == "ASAH1", complex_state %in% c("disrupted", "partial")) %>%
  dplyr::pull(complex_id) %>% unique()

gba1_disrupted <- complex_ko_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(genotype == "GBA1", complex_state %in% c("disrupted", "partial")) %>%
  dplyr::pull(complex_id) %>% unique()

smpd1_disrupted <- complex_ko_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(genotype == "SMPD1", complex_state %in% c("disrupted", "partial")) %>%
  dplyr::pull(complex_id) %>% unique()

ceramide_core <- Reduce(intersect, list(asah1_disrupted, gba1_disrupted, smpd1_disrupted))

message("\n--- Ceramide core complexes (ASAH1 ∩ GBA1 ∩ SMPD1) ---")
message("  ASAH1 disrupted: ", length(asah1_disrupted))
message("  GBA1 disrupted: ", length(gba1_disrupted))
message("  SMPD1 disrupted: ", length(smpd1_disrupted))
message("  Three-way intersection: ", length(ceramide_core))

if (length(ceramide_core) > 0) {
  ceramide_core_details <- complexes_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(complex_id %in% ceramide_core) %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, n_proteins, proteins, organelle)
  
  write_csv(ceramide_core_details, file.path(out_dir_ceramide, "ceramide_core_complexes.csv"))
  
  message("\nCeramide core complexes:")
  print(ceramide_core_details)
}


# --- Step 9: Pathway distance vs similarity ---
# Compute pathway distance between all pairs
pathway_dist <- function(gene_a, gene_b, pathway_df) {
  depth_a <- pathway_df$depth_from_ceramide[pathway_df$gene == gene_a]
  depth_b <- pathway_df$depth_from_ceramide[pathway_df$gene == gene_b]
  if (length(depth_a) == 0 || length(depth_b) == 0) return(NA)
  return(abs(depth_a - depth_b))
}

# Build comparison dataframe with pathway distances
all_pairs <- expand.grid(gene_a = sphingo_genes, gene_b = sphingo_genes, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene_a < gene_b) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pathway_distance = pathway_dist(gene_a, gene_b, sphingo_pathway),
    same_branch = sphingo_pathway$branch[sphingo_pathway$gene == gene_a] == 
                  sphingo_pathway$branch[sphingo_pathway$gene == gene_b],
    jaccard_iN = get_pair_similarity(gene_a, gene_b, jaccard_mat, "iN"),
    corr_iN = get_pair_similarity(gene_a, gene_b, correlation_mat, "iN")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

write_csv(all_pairs, file.path(out_dir_ceramide, "pathway_distance_vs_similarity.csv"))

# Plot pathway distance vs Jaccard similarity
p_dist_jaccard <- ggplot(all_pairs, aes(x = pathway_distance, y = jaccard_iN)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = same_branch), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = paste(gene_a, gene_b, sep = "-")), size = 2, max.overlaps = 20) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#E41A1C", "TRUE" = "#377EB8"), name = "Same branch") +
  labs(
    x = "Pathway distance (Pairwise enzyme distance from ceramide)",
    y = "Jaccard similarity (lost PPIs)",
    title = "Sphingolipidosis pathway: distance vs PPI disruption similarity"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ceramide, "pathway_distance_vs_jaccard.pdf"), p_dist_jaccard, width = 4.5, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)


# --- Step 10: Summary table ---
summary_table <- comparison_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    interpretation = case_when(
      jaccard_iN > 0.5 ~ "High similarity",
      jaccard_iN > 0.3 ~ "Moderate similarity",
      jaccard_iN > 0.1 ~ "Low similarity",
      TRUE ~ "Minimal similarity"
    )
  )

write_csv(summary_table, file.path(out_dir_ceramide, "key_comparisons_summary.csv"))

message("\n=== Ceramide pathway analysis complete ===")
message("Output: ", out_dir_ceramide)
message("Key question: Do ASAH1 and GBA1 show similar PPI disruption despite different mechanisms?")

```




# OXPHOS vulnerability analysis in sphingolipidoses
```{r}
# ==========================================================================
# Module 15: OXPHOS Vulnerability in Sphingolipidoses
# Analyzes mitochondrial and OXPHOS complex disruption across LSD KOs,
# with focus on sphingolipidosis genes and ceramide pathway convergence.
# ==========================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(UpSetR)

# --- Step 0: Setup directories ---

out_dir_mito <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "mito_oxphos_vulnerability")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_mito, "plots"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_mito, "sourcedata"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_mito, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


# --- Step 1: Define Mito annotations and gene groups ---

mito_annotations <- c("Mito", "MitoIMS", "MitoMatrix", "MitoMIM", "MitoMOM", "OXPHOS", "mtComplexI")

sphingolipidosis_genes <- c("ASAH1", "GBA1", "SMPD1", "HEXA", "HEXB", "PSAP")
ceramide_core_genes <- c("ASAH1", "GBA1", "SMPD1")


# --- Step 2: Build Mito annotation lookup per gene ---
# From binary_matrix, get which genes have each Mito annotation

mito_cols_present <- intersect(mito_annotations, colnames(binary_matrix))
message("Mito annotations found: ", paste(mito_cols_present, collapse = ", "))

gene_mito_annotations <- binary_matrix %>%
  dplyr::select(Genes, all_of(mito_cols_present)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Genes, names_to = "mito_compartment", values_to = "is_mito") %>%
  dplyr::filter(is_mito == TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(Genes, mito_compartment)

message("Genes with Mito annotations: ", n_distinct(gene_mito_annotations$Genes))


# --- Step 3: Annotate PPIs with Mito compartments ---
# A PPI is "Mito-associated" if BOTH partners are in the same Mito compartment

ppi_mito_annotated <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_mito_annotations, by = c("Gene1" = "Genes")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(mito_compartment_1 = mito_compartment) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_mito_annotations, by = c("Gene2" = "Genes")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(mito_compartment_2 = mito_compartment) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(mito_compartment_1) & !is.na(mito_compartment_2)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(mito_compartment_1 == mito_compartment_2) %>%
  dplyr::rename(mito_compartment = mito_compartment_1) %>%
  dplyr::select(-mito_compartment_2)

message("Mito-associated PPI entries: ", nrow(ppi_mito_annotated))


# --- Step 4: Summarize broken Mito PPIs per KO x neuron x compartment ---

ppi_mito_summary <- ppi_mito_annotated %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, mito_compartment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_lost = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_retained = sum(state == "retained", na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_lost = round(100 * n_lost / n_total, 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(ppi_mito_summary, file.path(out_dir_mito, "tables", "ppi_mito_summary.csv"))


# --- Step 5: Heatmaps - Broken Mito PPIs ---

for (neuron_type in c("iN", "iDA")) {
  
  # Prepare matrix
  heatmap_data <- ppi_mito_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == neuron_type) %>%
    dplyr::select(genotype, mito_compartment, n_lost) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = mito_compartment, values_from = n_lost, values_fill = 0) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("genotype")
  
  # Order rows by total lost
  row_order <- rowSums(heatmap_data) %>% sort(decreasing = TRUE) %>% names()
  heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[row_order, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # Add disease class annotation
  row_annot <- disease_classes_dataframe %>%
    dplyr::mutate(genotype = sub("_i[ND]A?$", "", sample)) %>%
    dplyr::select(genotype, DiseaseClass) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(genotype, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype %in% rownames(heatmap_data)) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("genotype")
  row_annot <- row_annot[rownames(heatmap_data), , drop = FALSE]
  
  # Save source data
  sourcedata <- heatmap_data %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("genotype") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(row_annot %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("genotype"), by = "genotype")
  write_csv(sourcedata, file.path(out_dir_mito, "sourcedata", paste0("ppi_broken_heatmap_", neuron_type, ".csv")))
  
  # Plot
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    as.matrix(heatmap_data),
    color = colorRampPalette(c("grey90", "#C51B7D"))(100),
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    annotation_row = row_annot,
    fontsize = 6,
    fontsize_row = 5,
    fontsize_col = 5,
    cellwidth = 5,
    cellheight = 5,
    border_color = NA,
    main = paste0("Broken Mito PPIs - ", neuron_type),
    filename = file.path(out_dir_mito, "plots", paste0("ppi_broken_heatmap_", neuron_type, ".pdf"))
  )
}

message("PPI heatmaps generated")


# --- Step 6: Annotate trimers with Mito compartments ---
# A trimer is "Mito-associated" if ALL THREE proteins are in the same Mito compartment

trimers_mito_annotated <- trimers_ko_states %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_mito_annotations, by = c("GeneA" = "Genes")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(mito_A = mito_compartment) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_mito_annotations, by = c("GeneB" = "Genes")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(mito_B = mito_compartment) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_mito_annotations, by = c("GeneC" = "Genes")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(mito_C = mito_compartment) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(mito_A) & !is.na(mito_B) & !is.na(mito_C)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(mito_A == mito_B & mito_B == mito_C) %>%
  dplyr::rename(mito_compartment = mito_A) %>%
  dplyr::select(-mito_B, -mito_C)

message("Mito-associated trimer entries: ", nrow(trimers_mito_annotated))


# --- Step 7: Summarize broken Mito trimers per KO x neuron x compartment ---

trimer_mito_summary <- trimers_mito_annotated %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, mito_compartment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_broken = sum(trimer_state == "broken", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_partial = sum(trimer_state == "partial", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_intact = sum(trimer_state == "intact", na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_broken = round(100 * n_broken / n_total, 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(trimer_mito_summary, file.path(out_dir_mito, "tables", "trimer_mito_summary.csv"))


# --- Step 8: Heatmaps - Broken Mito Trimers ---

for (neuron_type in c("iN", "iDA")) {
  
  heatmap_data <- trimer_mito_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == neuron_type) %>%
    dplyr::select(genotype, mito_compartment, n_broken) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = mito_compartment, values_from = n_broken, values_fill = 0) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("genotype")
  
  if (nrow(heatmap_data) == 0 || ncol(heatmap_data) == 0) {
    message("No Mito trimer data for ", neuron_type, " - skipping")
    next
  }
  
  row_order <- rowSums(heatmap_data) %>% sort(decreasing = TRUE) %>% names()
  heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[row_order, , drop = FALSE]
  
  row_annot <- disease_classes_dataframe %>%
    dplyr::mutate(genotype = sub("_i[ND]A?$", "", sample)) %>%
    dplyr::select(genotype, DiseaseClass) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(genotype, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype %in% rownames(heatmap_data)) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("genotype")
  row_annot <- row_annot[rownames(heatmap_data), , drop = FALSE]
  
  sourcedata <- heatmap_data %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("genotype") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(row_annot %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("genotype"), by = "genotype")
  write_csv(sourcedata, file.path(out_dir_mito, "sourcedata", paste0("trimers_broken_heatmap_", neuron_type, ".csv")))
  
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    as.matrix(heatmap_data),
    color = colorRampPalette(c("grey90", "#C51B7D"))(100),
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    annotation_row = row_annot,
    fontsize = 6,
    fontsize_row = 5,
    fontsize_col = 5,
    cellwidth = 5,
    cellheight = 5,
    border_color = NA,
    main = paste0("Broken Mito Trimers - ", neuron_type),
    filename = file.path(out_dir_mito, "plots", paste0("trimers_broken_heatmap_", neuron_type, ".pdf"))
  )
}

message("Trimer heatmaps generated")


# --- Step 9: Annotate complexes with Mito compartments ---
# Use the organelle annotation from complexes_summary

# Check if we have Mito-annotated complexes
complexes_mito <- complex_ko_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl("Mito", organelle, ignore.case = TRUE))

message("Mito-associated complex entries: ", nrow(complexes_mito))


# --- Step 10: Summarize disrupted Mito complexes per KO x neuron ---

complex_mito_summary <- complexes_mito %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, organelle) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_disrupted = sum(complex_state == "disrupted", na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(complex_mito_summary, file.path(out_dir_mito, "tables", "complex_mito_summary.csv"))


# --- Step 11: Heatmaps - Disrupted Mito Complexes ---

for (neuron_type in c("iN", "iDA")) {
  
  heatmap_data <- complex_mito_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == neuron_type) %>%
    dplyr::select(genotype, organelle, n_disrupted) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = organelle, values_from = n_disrupted, values_fill = 0) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("genotype")
  
  if (nrow(heatmap_data) == 0 || ncol(heatmap_data) == 0) {
    message("No Mito complex data for ", neuron_type, " - skipping")
    next
  }
  
  row_order <- rowSums(heatmap_data) %>% sort(decreasing = TRUE) %>% names()
  heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[row_order, , drop = FALSE]
  
  row_annot <- disease_classes_dataframe %>%
    dplyr::mutate(genotype = sub("_i[ND]A?$", "", sample)) %>%
    dplyr::select(genotype, DiseaseClass) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(genotype, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype %in% rownames(heatmap_data)) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("genotype")
  row_annot <- row_annot[rownames(heatmap_data), , drop = FALSE]
  
  sourcedata <- heatmap_data %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("genotype") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(row_annot %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("genotype"), by = "genotype")
  write_csv(sourcedata, file.path(out_dir_mito, "sourcedata", paste0("complexes_disrupted_heatmap_", neuron_type, ".csv")))
  
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    as.matrix(heatmap_data),
    color = colorRampPalette(c("grey90", "#C51B7D"))(100),

    fontsize_row = 5,
    fontsize_col = 5,

}

message("Complex heatmaps generated")


# --- Step 12: UpSet plots - Ceramide core convergence (ASAH1 ∩ GBA1 ∩ SMPD1) ---

for (neuron_type in c("iN", "iDA")) {
  
  # --- 12a: UpSet for Mito PPIs ---
  ppi_upset_data <- ppi_mito_annotated %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == neuron_type, state == "lost", genotype %in% ceramide_core_genes) %>%
    dplyr::select(key, genotype) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(present = 1) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = genotype, values_from = present, values_fill = 0)
  
  # Need at least 2 sets (columns) and some data
  n_sets <- sum(ceramide_core_genes %in% colnames(ppi_upset_data))
  
  if (nrow(ppi_upset_data) > 0 && n_sets >= 2) {
    # Save source data
    write_csv(ppi_upset_data, file.path(out_dir_mito, "sourcedata", paste0("upset_ppi_ceramide_core_", neuron_type, ".csv")))
    
    # Prepare data for UpSetR (needs numeric matrix without ID column)
    upset_matrix <- ppi_upset_data %>%
      tibble::column_to_rownames("key") %>%
      as.data.frame()
    
    # Plot
    pdf(file.path(out_dir_mito, "plots", paste0("upset_ppi_ceramide_core_", neuron_type, ".pdf")), width = 4, height = 3)
    print(UpSetR::upset(
      upset_matrix,
      sets = intersect(ceramide_core_genes, colnames(upset_matrix)),
      order.by = "freq",
      main.bar.color = "#C51B7D",
      sets.bar.color = "#4575B4",
      text.scale = 0.8
    ))
    dev.off()
    message("UpSet PPI plot generated for ", neuron_type)
  } else {
    message("Insufficient data for UpSet PPI plot (", neuron_type, "): ", n_sets, " sets, ", nrow(ppi_upset_data), " rows")
  }
  
  # --- 12b: UpSet for Mito Trimers ---
  trimer_upset_data <- trimers_mito_annotated %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == neuron_type, trimer_state == "broken", genotype %in% ceramide_core_genes) %>%
    dplyr::select(trimer_id, genotype) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(present = 1) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = genotype, values_from = present, values_fill = 0)
  
  n_sets <- sum(ceramide_core_genes %in% colnames(trimer_upset_data))
  
  if (nrow(trimer_upset_data) > 0 && n_sets >= 2) {
    write_csv(trimer_upset_data, file.path(out_dir_mito, "sourcedata", paste0("upset_trimers_ceramide_core_", neuron_type, ".csv")))
    
    upset_matrix <- trimer_upset_data %>%
      tibble::column_to_rownames("trimer_id") %>%
      as.data.frame()
    
    pdf(file.path(out_dir_mito, "plots", paste0("upset_trimers_ceramide_core_", neuron_type, ".pdf")), width = 4, height = 3)
    print(UpSetR::upset(
      upset_matrix,
      sets = intersect(ceramide_core_genes, colnames(upset_matrix)),
      order.by = "freq",
      main.bar.color = "#C51B7D",
      sets.bar.color = "#4575B4",
      text.scale = 0.8
    ))
    dev.off()
    message("UpSet trimer plot generated for ", neuron_type)
  } else {
    message("Insufficient data for UpSet trimer plot (", neuron_type, "): ", n_sets, " sets, ", nrow(trimer_upset_data), " rows")
  }
  
  # --- 12c: UpSet for Mito Complexes ---
  complex_upset_data <- complexes_mito %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == neuron_type, complex_state %in% c("disrupted", "partial"), genotype %in% ceramide_core_genes) %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, genotype) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(present = 1) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = genotype, values_from = present, values_fill = 0)
  
  n_sets <- sum(ceramide_core_genes %in% colnames(complex_upset_data))
  
  if (nrow(complex_upset_data) > 0 && n_sets >= 2) {
    write_csv(complex_upset_data, file.path(out_dir_mito, "sourcedata", paste0("upset_complexes_ceramide_core_", neuron_type, ".csv")))
    
    upset_matrix <- complex_upset_data %>%
      tibble::column_to_rownames("complex_id") %>%
      as.data.frame()
    
    pdf(file.path(out_dir_mito, "plots", paste0("upset_complexes_ceramide_core_", neuron_type, ".pdf")), width = 4, height = 3)
    print(UpSetR::upset(
      upset_matrix,
      sets = intersect(ceramide_core_genes, colnames(upset_matrix)),
      order.by = "freq",
      main.bar.color = "#C51B7D",
      sets.bar.color = "#4575B4",
      text.scale = 0.8
    ))
    dev.off()
    message("UpSet complex plot generated for ", neuron_type)
  } else {
    message("Insufficient data for UpSet complex plot (", neuron_type, "): ", n_sets, " sets, ", nrow(complex_upset_data), " rows")
  }
}


# --- Step 13: Summary - Ceramide core shared disruptions ---

ceramide_core_summary <- list()

for (neuron_type in c("iN", "iDA")) {
  
  # Shared lost PPIs
  ppi_shared <- ppi_mito_annotated %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == neuron_type, state == "lost", genotype %in% ceramide_core_genes) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(key) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_kos = n_distinct(genotype), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_kos == 3) %>%
    nrow()
  
  # Shared broken trimers
  trimer_shared <- trimers_mito_annotated %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == neuron_type, trimer_state == "broken", genotype %in% ceramide_core_genes) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(trimer_id) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_kos = n_distinct(genotype), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_kos == 3) %>%
    nrow()
  
  # Shared disrupted complexes
  complex_shared <- complexes_mito %>%
    dplyr::filter(neuron == neuron_type, complex_state %in% c("disrupted", "partial"), genotype %in% ceramide_core_genes) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(complex_id) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_kos = n_distinct(genotype), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_kos == 3) %>%
    nrow()
  
  ceramide_core_summary[[neuron_type]] <- tibble::tibble(
    neuron = neuron_type,
    shared_lost_ppi = ppi_shared,
    shared_broken_trimers = trimer_shared,
    shared_disrupted_complexes = complex_shared
  )
}

ceramide_core_summary_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(ceramide_core_summary)
write_csv(ceramide_core_summary_df, file.path(out_dir_mito, "tables", "ceramide_core_shared_disruptions.csv"))

message("")
message("=== OXPHOS Vulnerability Analysis Complete ===")
message("Output directory: ", out_dir_mito)
message("")
message("Ceramide core (ASAH1 ∩ GBA1 ∩ SMPD1) shared Mito disruptions:")



```



# Master PPI Stats output for summary csv
```{r}
# ==========================================================================
# Module 14: PPI Master Stats Summary
# Aggregates PPI, trimer, and complex disruption statistics per KO × neuron.
# ==========================================================================

# --- Step 1: Load summary tables ---
# PPI-level summary (from Module 11)
# ko_summary_global should already be in environment, or load from file:
# ko_summary_global <- read_csv(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables", "ko_summary_global.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Trimer-level summary (from trimer analysis)
# trimer_ko_summary should already be in environment, or load from file:
# trimer_ko_summary <- read_csv(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "trimer_ko_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Complex-level summary (from multimer analysis))
# complex_ko_summary should already be in environment, or load from file:
# complex_ko_summary <- read_csv(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables", "complex_ko_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)


# --- Step 2: Aggregate complex stats per KO × neuron ---
complex_stats <- complex_ko_summary %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    complexes_total = n(),
    complexes_disrupted = sum(complex_state == "disrupted", na.rm = TRUE),
    complexes_partial = sum(complex_state == "partial", na.rm = TRUE),
    complexes_intact = sum(complex_state == "intact", na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_complexes_disrupted = round(100 * complexes_disrupted / complexes_total, 2),
    pct_complexes_affected = round(100 * (complexes_disrupted + complexes_partial) / complexes_total, 2),
    mean_frac_edges_lost = round(mean(frac_edges_lost, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# --- Step 3: Prepare PPI stats ---
ppi_stats <- ko_summary_global %>%
  dplyr::select(genotype, neuron, 
                ppi_total = total_baseline_edges,
                ppi_lost = n_lost,
                ppi_retained = n_retained,
                ppi_unknown = n_unknown) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pct_ppi_lost = round(100 * ppi_lost / ppi_total, 2)
  )


# --- Step 4: Prepare trimer stats ---
trimer_stats <- trimer_ko_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(genotype, neuron,
                trimers_total = n_total,
                trimers_broken = n_broken,
                trimers_partial = n_partial,
                trimers_intact = n_intact) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pct_trimers_broken = round(100 * trimers_broken / trimers_total, 2),
    pct_trimers_affected = round(100 * (trimers_broken + trimers_partial) / trimers_total, 2)
  )


# --- Step 5: Merge all stats into master summary ---
ppi_master_stats <- ppi_stats %>%
  dplyr::left_join(trimer_stats, by = c("genotype", "neuron")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(complex_stats, by = c("genotype", "neuron"))


# --- Step 6: Add control (WT) rows ---
# Get baseline totals from any KO row (all start with same baseline)
baseline_ppi <- ppi_stats$ppi_total[1]
baseline_trimers <- trimer_stats$trimers_total[1]
baseline_complexes <- complex_stats$complexes_total[1]

control_rows <- tibble::tibble(
  genotype = c("WT", "WT"),
  neuron = c("iN", "iDA"),
  ppi_total = baseline_ppi,
  ppi_lost = 0L,
  ppi_retained = baseline_ppi,
  ppi_unknown = 0L,
  pct_ppi_lost = 0,
  trimers_total = baseline_trimers,
  trimers_broken = 0L,
  trimers_partial = 0L,
  trimers_intact = baseline_trimers,
  pct_trimers_broken = 0,
  pct_trimers_affected = 0,
  complexes_total = baseline_complexes,
  complexes_disrupted = 0L,
  complexes_partial = 0L,
  complexes_intact = baseline_complexes,
  pct_complexes_disrupted = 0,
  pct_complexes_affected = 0,
  mean_frac_edges_lost = 0
)

ppi_master_stats <- dplyr::bind_rows(control_rows, ppi_master_stats) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(pct_ppi_lost))


# --- Step 7: Add disease class annotation ---
disease_map <- disease_classes_dataframe %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    genotype = sub("_i[ND]A?$", "", sample),
    neuron = ifelse(grepl("_iDA$", sample), "iDA", "iN")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(genotype, neuron, DiseaseClass) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

ppi_master_stats <- ppi_master_stats %>%
  dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("genotype", "neuron")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(DiseaseClass = ifelse(genotype == "WT", "Control", DiseaseClass)) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(DiseaseClass, .after = neuron)


# --- Step 8: Save output ---
write_csv(ppi_master_stats, file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables", "ppi_master_stats_summary.csv"))

message("=== PPI Master Stats Summary ===")
message("Output: ", file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables", "ppi_master_stats_summary.csv"))
message("Rows: ", nrow(ppi_master_stats))
message("")
message("Columns:")
message("  PPI level: ppi_total, ppi_lost, ppi_retained, pct_ppi_lost")
message("  Trimer level: trimers_total, trimers_broken, trimers_partial, pct_trimers_broken")
message("  Complex level: complexes_total, complexes_disrupted, complexes_partial, pct_complexes_disrupted")
message("")

# Print top 10 most affected KOs
message("Top 10 most affected KOs (by % PPI lost):")
ppi_master_stats %>%
  dplyr::select(genotype, neuron, DiseaseClass, pct_ppi_lost, pct_trimers_broken, pct_complexes_disrupted) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  print()

```

```{r}
# Join proteome data for both partners
hela_edge_states <- baseline_expanded_hela %>%

    relationship = "many-to-one"  # Each edge-genotype should match one Gene2 measurement
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(dB = log2FC) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    state = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(dA) & dA < drop_thresh ~ "lost",
      !is.na(dB) & dB < drop_thresh ~ "lost",
      (!is.na(dA) | !is.na(dB))     ~ "retained",
      TRUE                          ~ "unknown"
    ),

  )

  message("Number of rows for this example: ", nrow(example_rows))
  print(example_rows)
  
  message("Deduplicating by taking first occurrence...")
  hela_edge_states <- hela_edge_states %>%
    dplyr::distinct(key, genotype, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  message("Rows after deduplication: ", nrow(hela_edge_states))
}

# Add disease class information if available
if (exists("disease_classes_dataframe")) {
  # Deduplicate disease classes first
  disease_classes_clean <- disease_classes_dataframe %>%
    dplyr::distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  hela_edge_states <- hela_edge_states %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      disease_classes_clean %>% dplyr::rename(genotype = sample),
      by = "genotype",
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    )
}

# Save edge states
write_csv(hela_edge_states, file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "tables", "hela_edge_states.csv"))

message("Final hela_edge_states rows: ", nrow(hela_edge_states))
message("Expected rows: ", nrow(baseline_edges_hela), " * ", length(ko_list), " = ", nrow(baseline_edges_hela) * length(ko_list))

# Save global summary
```
